zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库
zh.what: 这是一个为 GPT-Image2 图像生成模型打造的提示词工程资源库，包含 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，将提示词视为代码进行管理和复用。项目提供可视化网站用于浏览和复制提示词，并持续更新。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据目录（案例图片与提示词）、源码（网站前端）、模板库、技能提炼文档，以及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript，可能使用前端框架（如 React/Vue）构建可视化网站，依赖 GitHub Pages 或类似服务部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，为 GPT-Image2 用户提供高质量提示词参考，今日新增 409 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: AI 图像生成爱好者：快速获取高质量提示词，提升生成效果。
提示词工程师：学习逆向工程案例，提炼可复用的技能。
产品团队：将提示词作为代码管理，实现工业化生成流程。

en.tag: Industrial prompt engine & template library for GPT-Image2
en.what: This is a prompt engineering resource library for the GPT-Image2 image generation model, featuring 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, treating prompts as code for management and reuse. It provides a visual website for browsing and copying prompts, with continuous updates.
en.content: The repository contains data directories (case images and prompts), source code (website frontend), template library, skill extraction docs, and multilingual README.
en.stack: Primarily based on JavaScript, likely using a frontend framework (e.g., React/Vue) for the visual website, deployed via GitHub Pages or similar.
en.hot: With 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, it offers high-quality prompt references for GPT-Image2 users, gaining 409 stars today and trending on GitHub.
uses: AI image generation enthusiasts: quickly obtain high-quality prompts to improve output.
Prompt engineers: learn from reverse-engineered cases and extract reusable skills.
Product teams: manage prompts as code for industrial generation workflows.

zh.tag: 面向真实工程师的 AI 代理技能集
zh.what: 这是一套由资深工程师设计的 AI 代理技能（skills），旨在帮助开发者进行真正的工程开发，而非简单的“氛围编码”。它提供可组合、易定制的小型技能模块，适用于任何模型，并支持通过 skills.sh 或 Claude Code 插件安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个可选的技能模块（如 /triage、/setup-matt-pocock-skills 等），以及一个快速安装脚本和 Claude Code 插件配置。用户通过 npx 命令选择安装，并运行设置向导完成配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Shell 脚本和 Node.js（npx），可选集成 Claude Code 插件。依赖 skills.sh 生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 18.6 万+ Star 和每日 2251 新增，该项目因解决 AI 编程中“真实工程”痛点而爆火，提供比 GSD、BMAD 等更可控、可定制的方案。
uses: 专业开发者 —— 希望用 AI 辅助真实工程开发，而非简单代码生成
AI 代理用户 —— 使用 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的工程师，需要结构化技能集
技术团队 —— 统一团队 AI 工作流，提升代码质量和可维护性

en.tag: AI agent skills for real engineers
en.what: A set of AI agent skills designed by a senior engineer for real engineering work, not vibe coding. It offers small, composable, and customizable skill modules that work with any model, installable via skills.sh or as a Claude Code plugin.
en.content: The repo contains multiple optional skill modules (e.g., /triage, /setup-matt-pocock-skills), a quick install script, and a Claude Code plugin configuration. Users select skills via npx and run a setup wizard to configure.
en.stack: Built on Shell scripts and Node.js (npx), with optional Claude Code plugin integration. Depends on the skills.sh ecosystem.
en.hot: With 186k+ stars and 2251 daily additions, this project exploded by addressing the pain point of 'real engineering' in AI coding, offering a more controllable and customizable alternative to GSD, BMAD, etc.
uses: Professional developers — who want AI to assist real engineering, not just code generation
AI agent users — engineers using Claude Code, Codex, etc., needing structured skill sets
Tech teams — to standardize AI workflows and improve code quality and maintainability

zh.tag: DHH 出品的精美现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是由 DHH 打造的一款注重美观与现代感的 Linux 发行版，内置大量精选工具和配置，提供开箱即用的体验。它强调“有主见”的设计，通过详尽的官方手册指导用户完成从安装到日常使用的全过程。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个详尽的官方手册（manual/ 目录），涵盖入门、导航、主题、快捷键、应用（终端、Neovim、AI 等）、配置（dotfiles、字体、监控等）以及故障排除等内容。此外还有相关网站和文档的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本，基于 Linux 发行版（如 Fedora 或类似系统），依赖常见的桌面环境组件和工具（如终端、Neovim、窗口管理器等）。
zh.hot: 作为知名开发者 DHH 的新项目，Omarchy 凭借其独特的美学和“有主见”的设计理念迅速吸引了大量关注，GitHub 星标数已接近 2.6 万，本周新增超 1400 星，位列趋势榜第 10。
uses: 喜欢折腾 Linux 桌面、追求美观和高效配置的开发者
希望快速上手一套完整、现代化 Linux 环境的用户
对 DHH 个人开发风格和理念感兴趣的粉丝
需要一份详尽 Linux 配置指南的学习者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution crafted by DHH, focusing on beauty and modernity, with a curated set of tools and configurations for an out-of-the-box experience. It emphasizes an opinionated design, guiding users through everything from installation to daily use with an extensive official manual.
en.content: The repository primarily contains an extensive official manual (in the manual/ directory), covering getting started, navigation, themes, hotkeys, applications (terminal, Neovim, AI, etc.), configuration (dotfiles, fonts, monitors, etc.), and troubleshooting. It also includes links to related websites and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Shell scripts, built on a Linux distribution (likely Fedora or similar), with dependencies on common desktop environment components and tools (terminal, Neovim, window manager, etc.).
en.hot: As a new project by renowned developer DHH, Omarchy quickly gained attention for its unique aesthetics and opinionated design philosophy, amassing nearly 26k stars on GitHub, with over 1,400 stars added this week, ranking #10 on the trending list.
uses: Developers who enjoy tinkering with Linux desktops and seek beautiful, efficient configurations
Users who want to quickly adopt a complete, modern Linux environment
Fans interested in DHH's personal development style and philosophy
Learners who need a comprehensive Linux configuration guide

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢思维协作平台
zh.what: Buzz是一个自托管的团队协作空间，人类和AI代理可以在同一频道中共同工作。所有消息、操作和事件都记录在Nostr中继上，形成统一的审计日志。它让代理像人类队友一样参与代码审查、工作流运行和项目管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust实现的核心中继、客户端界面、文档（愿景、架构等）以及截图示例。提供频道、画布、工作流、语音会议等功能，并支持代理自主操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用Rust编写，基于Nostr协议，依赖大量Rust crate。前端可能使用Web技术，但核心是Rust后端。
zh.hot: 在GitHub Trending月榜排名第一，28.7k星，本月新增301星。它解决了AI代理协作中的信任和审计问题，提供统一的事件日志，吸引了开发者和团队。
uses: 团队希望让AI代理参与开发流程，同时保持完整审计记录。
开发者需要自托管的协作平台，数据完全掌控。
对Nostr协议感兴趣，想探索去中心化社交与工作结合。
研究AI代理安全与权限管理的场景。

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate on a Nostr relay
en.what: Buzz is a self-hosted team workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate in shared channels. Every message, action, and event is recorded on a Nostr relay, creating a unified audit trail. Agents can participate in code review, workflow runs, and project management like human teammates.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-implemented core relay, client UI, documentation (vision, architecture, etc.), and screenshot examples. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and agent autonomy.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Nostr protocol, with a suspicious number of Rust crates. The frontend may use web technologies, but the core is Rust backend.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending monthly with 28.7k stars and +301 this month. It addresses trust and audit in AI agent collaboration with a unified event log, attracting developers and teams.
uses: Teams wanting AI agents in dev workflows with full audit trails.
Developers needing self-hosted collaboration with data ownership.
Those interested in Nostr and decentralized social-work integration.
Researchers exploring AI agent security and permissioning.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: 免费聚合多款 AI 编码代理，每月 13 亿+免费 token
zh.what: 这是一个开源项目，让你免费使用 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、OpenCode 等 9 种编码代理，并接入 49 个合规的模型提供商，每月提供超过 13 亿免费 token。它提供一个统一的搜索界面，支持终端、桌面、IDE 或手机访问，还支持语音和故障转移。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包、CLI 工具、配置文件和文档，支持多种客户端接入，提供模型目录、故障转移和优化功能，如 RTK 过滤和 token 节省。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.14，使用 uv 管理依赖，采用 Pytest 测试、Ruff 格式化、Loguru 日志，并集成多个 AI 代理和提供商 API。
zh.hot: 凭借免费使用高级编码代理和巨额 token 的吸引力，star 数已达 4.7 万，今日新增 1040，登上 GitHub 日榜第 8 名。
uses: 开发者希望免费使用 Claude Code 等高级编码代理，降低 AI 编程成本。
需要跨多个模型提供商进行故障转移，确保编码任务不中断的团队。
在终端、IDE 或手机上灵活使用 AI 编码助手的个人用户。

en.tag: Free multi-agent coding hub with 1.3B+ monthly tokens
en.what: This open-source project lets you use 9 coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode for free, with access to 49 ToS-friendly providers offering 1.3B+ free tokens monthly. It provides a unified searchable UI, works from terminal, desktop, IDE, or phone, and supports voice and automatic failover.
en.content: The repo includes a Python package, CLI tool, configuration files, and docs, supporting multiple clients, with a model catalog, failover, and optimizations like RTK filtering and token savings.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.14, uses uv for dependency management, Pytest for testing, Ruff for formatting, Loguru for logging, and integrates multiple AI agents and provider APIs.
en.hot: With the appeal of free access to premium coding agents and huge token allowances, it has 47k stars, +1040 today, ranking #8 on GitHub daily trending.
uses: Developers who want to use premium coding agents like Claude Code for free, reducing AI coding costs.
Teams needing failover across multiple model providers to ensure uninterrupted coding tasks.
Individuals who prefer flexible AI coding assistance from terminal, IDE, or phone.

zh.tag: 本地优先的个人 AI 超级智能，记忆+编排+深度研究
zh.what: OpenHuman 是一个开源的个人 AI 超级智能，旨在构建你生活的本地优先记忆，并作为智能体舰队和工作流的出色编排器，同时提供深度研究能力。它强调本地优先、简单和强大，让用户拥有自己的 AI 大脑。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 GitBook 文档框架，并集成 Product Hunt 和 Trendshift 徽章。
zh.hot: 凭借 36.5k 星标和每日新增 51 星，OpenHuman 在 GitHub 趋势榜上排名第 9，其本地优先的 AI 超级智能概念和强大的编排能力吸引了大量关注。

智能体编排：管理和协调多个 AI 智能体执行复杂工作流。
深度研究：利用 AI 进行深入的信息检索和分析。
开发者与 AI 爱好者：探索开源 AI 工具链和本地优先架构。

It emphasizes local-first, simplicity, and power, giving users ownership of their AI brain.

en.hot: With 36.5k stars and 51 new stars daily, OpenHuman ranks #9 on GitHub Trending, attracting attention for its local-first AI superintelligence concept and powerful orchestration capabilities.

Agent orchestration: manage and coordinate multiple AI agents for complex workflows.
Deep research: leverage AI for in-depth information retrieval and analysis.
Developers and AI enthusiasts: explore open-source AI toolchains and local-first architecture.

zh.tag: AI 代理性能优化系统，为 Claude Code 等提供技能、记忆与安全
zh.what: ECC 是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor）提供性能优化的系统，集成技能、直觉、记忆、安全防护和研究优先的开发流程。它旨在提升代理的效率和可靠性，支持多种主流代理工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 代码、文档（多语言）、资产（如图片）、GitHub App 集成、npm 包（如 ecc-universal、ecc-agentshield）以及 Discord 社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，依赖 npm 生态，提供 GitHub App 和 npm 包，支持多语言文档。
zh.hot: 今日新增 273 星，总星数 241k，位列 JavaScript 日榜第 3，因其针对热门 AI 代理工具的性能优化和全面功能而广受关注。
uses: 开发者优化 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 代理的性能与安全性
团队集成代理技能、记忆和直觉以提升开发效率
研究导向的开发流程，适合需要可靠代理行为的项目

en.tag: Open-source toolkit to abliterate LLM refusals, a distributed research experiment
en.what: OBLITERATUS is an advanced open-source toolkit for understanding and removing refusal behaviors from large language models. It implements abliteration to identify and surgically remove internal representations responsible for content refusal without retraining or fine-tuning, enabling models to respond to all prompts while preserving core language capabilities. Each run contributes anonymous benchmark data to a crowd-sourced research dataset.
en.content: The repo includes a complete pipeline: probing hidden states to locate refusal directions, multiple extraction strategies (PCA, mean-difference, sparse autoencoder decomposition, whitened SVD), and inference-time intervention. It ships with a Gradio-based HuggingFace Spaces interface for no-code use, plus a Python API for deep control.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, integrated with HuggingFace Spaces and Google Colab, featuring a Gradio interface.
en.hot: With nearly 8k stars and 42 added today, ranking #6 on Python trending, its unique distributed research model and innovative abliteration technique attract attention, making users co-authors of the science.
uses: AI researchers: delve into model internals to study the neural basis of refusal behavior.
Developers: quickly remove refusals to boost response rates without retraining.
Ethics and safety experts: evaluate model behavior and understand compliance tradeoffs.
Enthusiasts: zero-code experience via HuggingFace Spaces, contributing to crowd-sourced research.

zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 用自然语言创建、部署并运行 AI 代理的开放平台
zh.what: AutoGPT 是一个开源平台，允许用户用自然语言描述任务，自动构建并运行 AI 代理来完成完整的工作流程。它提供多种交互方式，包括聊天、可视化构建器和 API，并支持定时或触发运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 AutoGPT 的核心代码、文档、可视化构建器、AutoPilot 聊天界面以及自托管部署指南。还提供了示例、API 参考和社区资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，依赖大型语言模型（如 GPT-4）进行任务分解和执行。支持多种部署方式，包括云平台和自托管。
zh.hot: AutoGPT 拥有超过 18 万星标，是 AI 代理领域的先驱项目，被多位行业领袖（如 Karpathy）称赞。它让非程序员也能轻松创建 AI 代理，因此广受欢迎。
uses: 希望自动化重复性工作流程的个人用户，如报告生成、数据分析等。
开发者想要构建自定义 AI 代理或集成到自己的应用中。
企业需要部署可扩展的 AI 代理平台，用于客户支持、内部流程自动化等。

en.tag: Open-source platform to build, deploy, and run AI agents from plain English
en.what: AutoGPT is an open-source platform that lets users describe tasks in plain English and automatically builds and runs AI agents to complete entire workflows. It offers multiple interfaces including chat, a visual builder, and API, with support for scheduled or trigger-based runs.
en.content: The repository contains the core AutoGPT code, documentation, visual builder, AutoPilot chat interface, and self-hosting guides. It also includes examples, API references, and community resources.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, it relies on large language models (e.g., GPT-4) for task decomposition and execution. Supports various deployment options including cloud and self-hosting.
en.hot: With over 185k stars, AutoGPT is a pioneer in AI agents, praised by industry leaders like Karpathy. Its accessibility to non-programmers has made it hugely popular.
uses: Individuals wanting to automate repetitive workflows like report generation or data analysis.
Developers looking to build custom AI agents or integrate into their own applications.
Enterprises needing a scalable AI agent platform for customer support, internal process automation, and more.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 开源语音与多模态生成式 AI 框架
zh.what: NeMo Speech 是 NVIDIA 推出的可扩展生成式 AI 框架，专为语音识别（ASR）和文本转语音（TTS）等语音 AI 任务设计，同时支持大语言模型和多模态研究。它提供预训练模型、训练工具和推理优化，帮助开发者快速构建和部署语音应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NeMo Speech 框架的源代码、文档、示例和预训练模型权重，并集成了 HuggingFace 模型集合。核心组件包括 FastConformer 架构、流式 ASR 模型、多语言 TTS 模型（如 MagpieTTS）以及语音对话系统（如 Nemotron VoiceChat）。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 开发，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习库，支持 NVIDIA GPU 加速，并利用 NeMo Toolkit 提供训练和推理接口。
zh.hot: 该仓库近期频繁发布新模型（如流式 ASR、多语言 TTS），且支持 40 种语言和低延迟流式推理，吸引了大量语音 AI 研究者。18k 星标表明其作为 NVIDIA 官方语音框架的广泛认可。
uses: 语音 AI 研究者：利用预训练模型和训练工具进行 ASR/TTS 实验与调优
应用开发者：快速集成语音识别和合成能力到产品中，支持流式与多语言场景
多模态 AI 团队：结合 LLM 和语音模型构建语音对话系统或虚拟助手

en.tag: NVIDIA's open-source generative AI framework for speech and multimodal models
en.what: NeMo Speech is NVIDIA's scalable generative AI framework designed for speech AI tasks like ASR and TTS, also supporting large language models and multimodal research. It provides pretrained models, training tools, and inference optimizations to help developers quickly build and deploy speech applications.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, examples, and pretrained model weights for the NeMo Speech framework, with an integrated HuggingFace model collection. Key components include FastConformer architecture, streaming ASR models, multilingual TTS models (e.g., MagpieTTS), and voice chat systems (e.g., Nemotron VoiceChat).
en.stack: Developed in Python, built on PyTorch and other deep learning libraries, optimized for NVIDIA GPUs, and leverages the NeMo Toolkit for training and inference APIs.
en.hot: The repository has been frequently releasing new models (e.g., streaming ASR, multilingual TTS) with support for 40 languages and low-latency streaming inference, attracting many speech AI researchers. The 18k stars reflect its wide recognition as NVIDIA's official speech framework.
uses: Speech AI researchers: use pretrained models and training tools for ASR/TTS experiments and fine-tuning
Application developers: quickly integrate speech recognition and synthesis into products, supporting streaming and multilingual scenarios
Multimodal AI teams: combine LLMs and speech models to build voice chatbots or virtual assistants

zh.tag: 终端里的 AI 编程代理，用自然语言写代码、跑任务、管 Git
zh.what: Claude Code 是一个运行在终端中的 AI 编程代理，能理解你的代码库，通过自然语言指令执行日常编码任务、解释复杂代码、处理 Git 工作流。它支持在终端、IDE 中使用，也可以在 GitHub 上通过 @claude 标签调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Claude Code 的安装脚本、插件目录（扩展自定义命令和代理）、文档链接以及演示 GIF。主要提供安装方式（curl、Homebrew、PowerShell、WinGet 等）和插件使用说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（要求 18+），通过 npm 分发（但已弃用），推荐使用官方安装脚本。核心功能依赖 Claude 模型，与 GitHub 和 IDE 集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方推出的 AI 编程代理，凭借强大的代码理解和自动化能力，Star 数已达 14.2 万，今日新增 153，持续霸榜。
uses: 开发者日常编码：用自然语言快速完成重构、测试、代码解释等任务
团队协作：在 GitHub 上通过 @claude 标签触发 AI 辅助代码审查或修改
学习与探索：通过对话式交互理解复杂代码库，适合新手快速上手项目

en.tag: Agentic coding tool in your terminal: understand codebase, execute tasks, handle git via natural language
en.what: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows through natural language commands. It can be used in the terminal, IDE, or by tagging @claude on GitHub.
en.content: The repository includes installation scripts, a plugins directory for extending functionality with custom commands and agents, documentation links, and a demo GIF. It provides installation methods (curl, Homebrew, PowerShell, WinGet, etc.) and plugin usage instructions.
en.stack: Built on Node.js (18+), distributed via npm (deprecated) but recommended via official install scripts. Core functionality relies on Claude models, integrates with GitHub and IDEs.
en.hot: As Anthropic's official agentic coding tool, it boasts strong code understanding and automation, amassing 142k stars with 153 new today, consistently trending.
uses: Developers: speed up routine coding tasks like refactoring, testing, and code explanation via natural language
Teams: trigger AI-assisted code review or modifications by tagging @claude on GitHub
Learners: understand complex codebases through conversational interaction, ideal for onboarding to new projects

zh.tag: Claude Code 模板与监控 CLI 工具
zh.what: 这是一个命令行工具，用于配置和管理 Claude Code 的模板，并监控其运行状态。它帮助开发者快速创建、管理和复用 Claude Code 的提示词模板，同时提供监控功能以优化使用体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 编写的 CLI 工具，以及相关的模板库和配置示例。它通过 npm 分发，支持模板的创建、列表、编辑和删除，并集成监控功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，通过 npm 发布，依赖 Claude Code 的 API 和命令行接口。
zh.hot: 随着 Claude Code 的流行，开发者需要高效的模板管理和监控工具，该项目正好满足需求，star 数已达 30k，今日新增 22，位列 Python 日榜第 11 名。
uses: 适用于使用 Claude Code 的开发者，希望快速管理提示词模板。
适合团队协作，统一配置和监控 Claude Code 的使用情况。
适用于需要自动化配置和监控 AI 编码助手的 DevOps 工程师。

en.tag: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code
en.what: This is a CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code. It helps developers quickly create, manage, and reuse prompt templates for Claude Code, and provides monitoring capabilities to optimize usage.
en.content: The repository contains a Python-based CLI tool, along with template libraries and configuration examples. It is distributed via npm, supports creating, listing, editing, and deleting templates, and integrates monitoring features.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Python, distributed via npm, and relies on Claude Code's API and CLI.
en.hot: With the popularity of Claude Code, developers need efficient template management and monitoring tools, which this project provides. It has 30k stars, 22 new today, ranking 11th on the Python daily trending list.
uses: For developers using Claude Code who want to manage prompt templates efficiently.
For teams that need to standardize configuration and monitor Claude Code usage.
For DevOps engineers who need to automate configuration and monitoring of AI coding assistants.

zh.tag: 为追求完美且有截止日期的开发者打造的高性能 Python Web 框架
zh.what: Django 是一个高级 Python Web 框架，旨在鼓励快速开发和简洁、实用的设计。它提供了丰富的内置功能，如 ORM、认证、管理后台等，帮助开发者快速构建安全可靠的 Web 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Django 的完整源代码、文档（位于 docs 目录）、测试套件以及贡献指南。文档涵盖安装、教程、部署、主题指南和参考。
zh.stack: Django 使用 Python 编写，依赖多种 Python 库，如 asgiref、sqlparse 等。它支持多种数据库后端，包括 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite 等。
zh.hot: Django 是 Python 最流行的 Web 框架之一，拥有近 9 万星标，持续活跃开发。今日新增 38 星，位列 GitHub 趋势榜 Python 第 12 名，体现了其稳定性和社区支持。
uses: 适合需要快速构建内容管理系统、社交平台或电商网站的全栈开发者。
适合希望使用成熟、安全且自带管理后台的框架的团队。
适合学习 Python Web 开发最佳实践的初学者。

en.tag: High-level Python web framework for perfectionists with deadlines
en.what: Django is a high-level Python web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It includes an ORM, authentication, admin interface, and many other built-in features to help developers build secure and reliable web applications quickly.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation (in the docs directory), test suite, and contribution guidelines. The docs cover installation, tutorials, deployment, topical guides, and reference.
en.stack: Django is written in Python and depends on libraries like asgiref and sqlparse. It supports multiple database backends including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and others.
en.hot: Django is one of the most popular Python web frameworks with nearly 89k stars and active development. With 38 stars today, it ranks #12 on GitHub Trending for Python, reflecting its stability and strong community support.
uses: For full-stack developers building content management systems, social platforms, or e-commerce sites rapidly.
For teams needing a mature, secure framework with a built-in admin interface.
For beginners learning best practices in Python web development.

zh.tag: 本地优先的语音克隆与配音工具，支持646种语言
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地的 ElevenLabs 替代品，提供语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书创作等功能。它支持 646 种语言，无需账户或 API 密钥即可使用核心功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（macOS/Windows/Linux）、本地 REST/SSE/WebSocket API、OpenAI 兼容音频 API 和 MCP 服务器。提供 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，支持 CUDA、Apple Silicon MPS/MLX 等计算后端。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种 TTS/ASR 引擎，支持 CUDA、ROCm、MPS/MLX 等加速。提供跨平台桌面应用和多种 API 接口。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，它吸引了大量关注，GitHub 星标已超过 1.1 万，今日新增 119 星，登上 Python 趋势榜。其无需联网、无需付费的特点满足了用户对隐私和成本控制的需求。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频、播客等生成多语言配音或克隆自己的声音。
隐私敏感用户：希望语音处理完全在本地进行，避免云端数据泄露。
开发者：通过 API 或 MCP 服务器集成语音功能到自己的应用中。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言的 TTS 和 ASR 进行听写和发音练习。

en.tag: Local-first voice cloning, dubbing & transcription in 646 languages
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local alternative to ElevenLabs, offering voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation. It supports 646 languages and requires no account or API key for core workflows.
en.content: The repository includes a desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), local REST/SSE/WebSocket API, OpenAI-compatible audio API, and MCP server. It offers 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, with support for CUDA, Apple Silicon MPS/MLX, and more.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, integrating multiple TTS/ASR engines, with acceleration support for CUDA, ROCm, MPS/MLX. Cross-platform desktop app and multiple API interfaces.
en.hot: As a local-first ElevenLabs alternative, it has gained significant traction with over 11k stars and 119 new stars today, ranking #13 on the Python trending list. Its offline, free nature appeals to users seeking privacy and cost control.
uses: Content creators: need multilingual dubbing or voice cloning for videos and podcasts.
Privacy-conscious users: want fully local voice processing to avoid cloud data exposure.
Developers: integrate voice capabilities into apps via API or MCP server.
Language learners: use TTS/ASR in 646 languages for dictation and pronunciation practice.

zh.tag: Claude Code 插件市场与发现平台
zh.what: Build with Claude 是一个集中式中心，用于发现和安装 Claude Skills、Agents、Commands、Hooks、Plugins 以及 Marketplace 集合，以扩展 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Agent SDK 和 OpenClaw。它提供精选的插件目录和社区驱动的发现功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含精选的插件集合，包括 117 个 Agents、175 个 Commands、28 个 Hooks、26 个 Skills 和 51 个 Plugins，并索引了 20k+ 社区插件、4,500+ MCP 服务器和 1,100+ 插件市场。还提供 Web UI 用于浏览和搜索。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，作为 Claude Code 的插件市场，通过命令行接口（CLI）集成，并可能包含 Web 前端（如 buildwithclaude.com）。
zh.hot: 随着 Claude Code 生态的快速增长，开发者需要一个集中式平台来发现和安装插件。该仓库提供了丰富的精选集合和社区索引，star 数已达 3315，并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。
uses: Claude Code 用户希望扩展功能，快速安装 Agents、Commands 等插件。
开发者需要发现社区贡献的 MCP 服务器和插件市场，以集成外部工具。
团队希望标准化 Claude Code 工作流，通过精选插件提升开发效率。

en.tag: A plugin marketplace and discovery platform for Claude Code
en.what: Build with Claude is a centralized hub for discovering and installing Claude Skills, Agents, Commands, Hooks, Plugins, and Marketplace collections to extend Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Agent SDK, and OpenClaw. It offers curated plugin collections and community-driven discovery.
en.content: The repository contains curated plugin collections including 117 Agents, 175 Commands, 28 Hooks, 26 Skills, and 51 Plugins, and indexes 20k+ community plugins, 4,500+ MCP servers, and 1,100+ plugin marketplaces. It also provides a Web UI for browsing and searching.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, it serves as a plugin marketplace for Claude Code, integrating via CLI and possibly including a web frontend (e.g., buildwithclaude.com).
en.hot: With the rapid growth of the Claude Code ecosystem, developers need a centralized platform to discover and install plugins. This repository offers rich curated collections and community indexing, reaching 3,315 stars and trending on GitHub.
uses: Claude Code users looking to extend functionality and quickly install Agents, Commands, and more.
Developers needing to discover community-contributed MCP servers and plugin marketplaces for external tool integration.
Teams aiming to standardize Claude Code workflows and boost development efficiency with curated plugins.

zh.tag: 为 LLM 打造的开源网页爬虫与抓取工具
zh.what: Crawl4AI 是一个开源网页爬虫和抓取工具，专为大型语言模型（LLM）设计。它能将网页内容转换为干净、结构化的 Markdown 格式，便于 RAG、AI 代理和数据管道使用。该工具强调速度、可控性和安全性，并已通过社区大量测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 库、Docker API 服务器、Playwright 集成、内存自适应调度器、GPU 支持以及丰富的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Playwright 进行浏览器自动化，支持 Docker 部署，可选 GPU 加速，并集成多种 LLM 相关工具。
zh.hot: 拥有 79k+ stars，今日新增 151，因其为 LLM 提供干净、即用的网页数据，解决了 RAG 和代理的数据获取痛点，且持续更新，社区活跃。
uses: AI 开发者：为 RAG 系统或 AI 代理快速抓取网页并生成干净的 Markdown 数据。
数据工程师：构建大规模网页数据管道，利用 Docker API 和异步支持进行高效采集。
研究人员：需要将网页内容结构化以便用于 NLP 或机器学习实验。

en.tag: Open-source LLM-friendly web crawler & scraper for clean Markdown
en.what: Crawl4AI is an open-source web crawler and scraper designed for LLMs. It converts web pages into clean, structured Markdown for RAG, agents, and data pipelines. It emphasizes speed, control, and security, and is battle-tested by a large community.
en.content: The repository includes a full Python library, Docker API server, Playwright integration, memory-adaptive dispatcher, GPU support, and extensive docs and examples.
en.stack: Built with Python, uses Playwright for browser automation, supports Docker deployment, optional GPU acceleration, and integrates with various LLM tools.
en.hot: With 79k+ stars and 151 added today, it's popular for providing clean, LLM-ready web data, solving data acquisition for RAG and agents, with active updates and community.
uses: AI developers: Quickly crawl web pages and generate clean Markdown for RAG systems or AI agents.
Data engineers: Build large-scale web data pipelines with Docker API and async support for efficient collection.
Researchers: Need structured web content for NLP or machine learning experiments.

zh.tag: 开源长时程超级智能体编排框架，可研究、编码与创作
zh.what: DeerFlow 是一个开源超级智能体编排框架，能够协调子代理、记忆和沙箱，执行从几分钟到几小时的复杂任务。它支持研究、编码和创作等多种场景，并通过可扩展的技能库实现几乎任何功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的后端（Python 3.12+）和前端（Node.js 22+）代码，以及官方文档、示例和演示。2.0 版本完全重写，与 1.x 分支不共享代码，并集成了 BytePlus 的 InfoQuest 搜索工具。
zh.stack: 后端基于 Python 3.12+，前端基于 Node.js 22+，使用 Makefile 构建。推荐使用 Doubao-Seed-2.0-Code、DeepSeek v3.2 和 Kimi 2.5 等模型运行。
zh.hot: DeerFlow 在 2026 年 2 月 28 日凭借 2.0 版本登顶 GitHub Trending，目前星标超过 8 万，社区活跃。其强大的长时程任务处理能力和完全重写的架构吸引了大量关注。
uses: 开发者和研究人员：用于构建复杂的 AI 代理应用，如自动研究、代码生成和内容创作。
企业团队：需要自动化处理耗时任务（如数据分析、报告生成）的团队。
AI 爱好者：探索超级智能体编排和沙箱隔离技术的爱好者。

en.tag: Open-source long-horizon super agent harness for research, coding, and creation
en.what: DeerFlow is an open-source super agent harness that orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to handle complex tasks ranging from minutes to hours. It supports research, coding, and creation, and can be extended with skills to do almost anything.
en.content: The repository contains full backend (Python 3.12+) and frontend (Node.js 22+) code, along with official docs, examples, and demos. Version 2.0 is a ground-up rewrite, sharing no code with the 1.x branch, and integrates BytePlus's InfoQuest search tool.
en.stack: Backend uses Python 3.12+, frontend uses Node.js 22+, built with Makefile. Recommended models include Doubao-Seed-2.0-Code, DeepSeek v3.2, and Kimi 2.5.
en.hot: DeerFlow claimed the #1 spot on GitHub Trending on Feb 28, 2026, after the 2.0 launch, and now has over 80k stars. Its powerful long-horizon task handling and ground-up rewrite have drawn massive attention.
uses: Developers and researchers: to build complex AI agent applications like automated research, code generation, and content creation.
Enterprise teams: needing to automate time-consuming tasks such as data analysis and report generation.
AI enthusiasts: exploring super agent orchestration and sandboxing techniques.

zh.tag: 自托管A股量化工作台：选股+监控+回测
zh.what: 这是一个面向个人散户和量化爱好者的自托管、零运维的A股量化工作台，集选股、监控、回测于一体。它基于TickFlow数据源，利用LLM能力实现策略定制、个股分析和复盘，并支持自由接入第三方数据源。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的量化工作台代码，涵盖选股引擎、指标流水线、回测研究、因子挖掘、市场环境分析、异动监控、监控中心、个股分析、连板梯队等模块，并提供Docker部署和详细文档。
zh.stack: 后端基于Python 3.11+，使用Polars进行高性能数据处理；前端使用React 18；数据源为TickFlow，支持插件化扩展；部署支持Docker。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜（Python）排名第17，今日新增82星，总星数达3509。其亮点在于结合LLM能力提供AI驱动的策略定制和个股分析，且完全自托管、零运维，吸引了大量个人量化爱好者。
uses: 个人散户：希望用开源工具进行A股量化选股和回测，无需自己搭建复杂基础设施。
量化爱好者：需要灵活的策略定制和因子挖掘，且希望数据源可插拔。
开发者：想学习或扩展一个完整的量化工作台，包括前端React和后端Python。

en.tag: Self-hosted A-share quant workbench: screening, monitoring, backtesting
en.what: A self-hosted, zero-maintenance quantitative workbench for A-shares, targeting individual investors and quant enthusiasts. It integrates stock screening, monitoring, and backtesting, powered by TickFlow data, with LLM capabilities for strategy customization, stock analysis, and review, and supports pluggable third-party data sources.
en.content: The repo contains a full quant workbench codebase, including modules for stock screening, indicator pipeline, backtesting, factor mining, market environment analysis, anomaly monitoring, monitoring center, stock analysis, and limit-up ladder, with Docker deployment and detailed docs.
en.stack: Backend in Python 3.11+, using Polars for high-performance data processing; frontend in React 18; data source is TickFlow with plugin support; deployment via Docker.
en.hot: Ranked #17 on GitHub Trending (Python) with 82 stars today and 3509 total. Its appeal lies in LLM-powered strategy customization and stock analysis, plus full self-hosting with zero maintenance, attracting many individual quant enthusiasts.
uses: Individual investors: seeking an open-source tool for A-share quant screening and backtesting without complex infrastructure.
Quant enthusiasts: needing flexible strategy customization and factor mining with pluggable data sources.
Developers: interested in learning or extending a full quant workbench with React frontend and Python backend.

zh.tag: 多智能体群体智能预测引擎，模拟未来
zh.what: MiroFish 是一个基于多智能体技术的下一代 AI 预测引擎。它从现实世界提取种子信息（如新闻、政策草案或金融信号），自动构建高保真的平行数字世界，让数千个具有独立人格、长期记忆和行为逻辑的智能体自由交互并进行社会演化。用户可以从“上帝视角”动态注入变量，精确推演未来轨迹，在数字沙盒中预演未来，辅助决策。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的引擎代码、文档（中英文）、Docker 支持、徽章和静态资源。主要提供 Python 实现，支持通过自然语言描述预测需求，并返回详细预测报告和可交互的数字世界。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖多智能体框架和模拟环境，支持 Docker 部署，并集成 DeepWiki 文档和 Discord 社区。
zh.hot: 凭借 71k+ 的 star 数和日增 48 的热度，MiroFish 以其“预测万物”的宏大愿景和群体智能的独特概念吸引了大量关注，在 GitHub Trending 上表现亮眼。
uses: 决策者（如政策制定者、企业高管）可在零风险的数字沙盒中预演政策或公关策略，评估潜在影响。
金融分析师可利用引擎模拟市场对新闻或政策变化的反应，辅助投资决策。
研究人员和开发者可探索群体智能、多智能体模拟和复杂系统预测的前沿技术。
创意写作者可上传小说故事，观察角色在数字世界中的演化，激发创作灵感。

en.tag: Multi-agent swarm intelligence engine for predicting the future
en.what: MiroFish is a next-generation AI prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology. It extracts seed information from the real world (such as breaking news, policy drafts, or financial signals) to automatically construct a high-fidelity parallel digital world, where thousands of intelligent agents with independent personalities, long-term memory, and behavioral logic freely interact and undergo social evolution. Users can dynamically inject variables from a 'God's-eye view' to precisely deduce future trajectories, rehearsing the future in a digital sandbox to aid decision-making.
en.content: The repository contains the complete engine code, documentation (Chinese and English), Docker support, badges, and static assets. It provides a Python implementation that accepts natural language prediction requests and returns detailed prediction reports and an interactive digital world.
en.stack: Written primarily in Python, it relies on multi-agent frameworks and simulation environments, supports Docker deployment, and integrates DeepWiki documentation and a Discord community.
en.hot: With over 71k stars and 48 new stars today, MiroFish has attracted significant attention due to its grand vision of 'predicting anything' and the unique concept of swarm intelligence, performing prominently on GitHub Trending.
uses: Decision-makers (e.g., policymakers, executives) can rehearse policies or PR strategies in a zero-risk digital sandbox to assess potential impacts.
Financial analysts can simulate market reactions to news or policy changes to support investment decisions.
Researchers and developers can explore cutting-edge technologies in swarm intelligence, multi-agent simulation, and complex system prediction.
Creative writers can upload novel stories to observe character evolution in a digital world, sparking inspiration.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 编程代理，终端与桌面双形态
zh.what: OpenCode 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，能在终端或桌面应用中自主完成编码任务。它支持多种主流模型，并提供类似 IDE 的交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心代理引擎、终端 UI（packages/web）、桌面应用（packages/console）以及安装脚本，并附带多语言 README 和截图。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，通过 npm 分发，支持 curl 脚本、Homebrew、Scoop、Chocolatey、pacman、Nix 等多种安装方式。
zh.hot: 凭借 20 万+ Star 和每日新增 400+ 的热度，OpenCode 成为 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3 名，反映了开发者对开源 AI 编程工具的强烈需求。
uses: 开发者希望在本地终端中使用 AI 代理辅助编码，无需离开命令行。
团队需要可自托管的 AI 编程助手，避免依赖云端闭源服务。
喜欢桌面应用图形界面的用户，可下载桌面版获得更直观的交互。

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent with terminal and desktop apps
en.what: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that autonomously handles coding tasks in a terminal or desktop app. It supports multiple major models and offers an IDE-like interaction experience.
en.content: The repo includes the core agent engine, terminal UI (packages/web), desktop app (packages/console), installation scripts, plus multilingual READMEs and screenshots.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, distributed via npm, with installation via curl script, Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, pacman, Nix, and more.
en.hot: With 200K+ stars and 400+ new stars daily, OpenCode ranks #3 on GitHub Trending today, reflecting strong developer demand for open-source AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want an AI coding agent in their local terminal without leaving the command line.
Teams needing a self-hostable AI coding assistant to avoid cloud-based closed-source services.
Users preferring a graphical desktop app for a more intuitive interaction.

zh.tag: 内容驱动网站的现代网页构建工具
zh.what: Astro 是一个专为内容驱动型网站设计的网页构建工具，它结合了强大的开发者体验和轻量级的输出。它允许开发者使用组件化的方式构建网站，并在构建时预渲染页面，从而实现极快的加载速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 astro 包、create-astro 脚手架工具，以及针对 React、Preact、Solid、Svelte、Vue 等框架的官方集成包。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，利用 Vite 提供开发服务器和构建能力，支持多种前端框架集成。
zh.hot: Astro 因其创新的岛屿架构和零 JS 默认输出而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有超过 6 万星标，今日新增 32 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第四。
uses: 适合构建博客、文档站、营销页面等以内容为主的网站，追求极致的性能表现。
适合希望使用 React/Vue/Svelte 等组件但又不希望加载大量客户端 JS 的开发者。
适合需要快速搭建静态网站并易于部署到 CDN 的团队或个人。

en.tag: Modern web framework for content-driven websites
en.what: Astro is a website build tool for the modern web, designed for content-driven sites. It combines a powerful developer experience with lightweight output, allowing developers to build sites with components and pre-render pages at build time for fast loading.
en.content: The repository contains the core astro package, the create-astro scaffolding tool, and official integrations for React, Preact, Solid, Svelte, Vue, and more.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, leveraging Vite for dev server and build capabilities, with integrations for multiple frontend frameworks.
en.hot: Astro is popular for its innovative islands architecture and zero-JS-by-default output, amassing over 61k stars on GitHub, with 32 new stars today, ranking 4th on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Ideal for building content-focused websites like blogs, docs, and marketing pages that demand top performance.
Great for developers who want to use React/Vue/Svelte components without shipping heavy client-side JavaScript.
Perfect for teams or individuals needing to quickly build static sites that are easy to deploy to CDNs.

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
zh.what: BookOrbit 是一个自托管的图书馆和阅读平台，支持电子书、PDF、有声书和漫画。它提供网页阅读器、Kobo 和 KOReader 支持，并同步阅读进度、高亮和状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端和前端代码，提供仪表盘、书架管理、阅读统计、成就系统、OPDS 和 Send-to-Kindle 等功能，并支持多用户和 OIDC/SSO 认证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于现代 Web 技术栈构建，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种第三方服务（如 Crowdin 翻译、Codecov 覆盖率）。
zh.hot: BookOrbit 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 248 星，总星数达 2613，因其自托管、跨设备同步和丰富功能而备受关注。
uses: 喜欢自托管服务的阅读爱好者，希望完全掌控自己的书籍数据。
需要在不同设备（如 Kobo、KOReader）间无缝同步阅读进度的用户。
注重隐私和自主权的用户，希望避免依赖商业云服务。
开发者或技术爱好者，希望扩展或定制自己的阅读平台。

en.tag: Self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics
en.what: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It offers a web reader, Kobo and KOReader support, and syncs progress, highlights, and reading status across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full server and frontend code, featuring a dashboard, bookshelf management, reading stats, achievements, OPDS and Send-to-Kindle delivery, multi-user accounts with OIDC/SSO, and automatic sync to Hardcover, Readwise, and StoryGraph.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on modern web technologies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates with third-party services like Crowdin for translation and Codecov for coverage.
en.hot: BookOrbit is rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub with 248 stars today and 2,613 total, thanks to its self-hosted nature, cross-device sync, and rich feature set.
uses: Reading enthusiasts who prefer self-hosted services and want full control over their book data.
Users who need seamless reading progress sync across devices like Kobo and KOReader.
Privacy-conscious individuals who want to avoid relying on commercial cloud services.
Developers or tech enthusiasts looking to extend or customize their reading platform.

zh.tag: 开源 AI IDE，并行运行多种编码代理并构建可复用工作流
zh.what: Proliferate 是一个开源的 AI 集成开发环境（IDE），支持在统一工作区中并行运行 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等多种编码代理。每个任务都有独立的 git worktree、终端、对话和审查状态，并支持子代理、集成和工作流自动化。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（apps/desktop）、核心库、文档和示例资源，提供原生代理适配器、工作区管理、并行代理、子代理、MCP/技能集成以及定时或事件驱动的工作流功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，桌面应用可能基于 Electron 或类似框架，依赖各代理的原生 CLI 和 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: 今日新增 45 星，总星数 309，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 6 名。它解决了多代理并行和复杂工作流管理的痛点，且开源免费，吸引开发者关注。
uses: 开发者希望在同一 IDE 中并行运行多个 AI 编码代理，提高开发效率。
团队需要为不同任务隔离环境，避免分支冲突和状态混乱。
自动化爱好者可设置定时或事件驱动的工作流，如夜间代码审查和依赖更新。

en.tag: Open-source AI IDE to run coding agents in parallel and build reusable workflows
en.what: Proliferate is an open-source AI IDE that lets you run multiple coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode in parallel within a single workspace. Each task gets its own isolated git worktree, terminal, conversation, and review state, with support for subagents, integrations, and workflow automation.
en.content: The repository includes a desktop app (apps/desktop), core libraries, docs, and assets, offering native agent harnesses, workspace management, parallel agents, subagents, MCP/skills integrations, and scheduled or event-driven workflows.
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript; the desktop app likely uses Electron or similar framework, leveraging native CLIs of each agent and MCP protocol.
en.hot: Gained 45 stars today, reaching 309 total and #6 on the TypeScript daily trending list. It addresses the pain point of parallel multi-agent management and complex workflows, while being open-source and free, attracting developer interest.
uses: Developers who want to run multiple AI coding agents in parallel within one IDE to boost productivity.
Teams needing isolated environments per task to avoid branch conflicts and state chaos.
Automation enthusiasts can set up scheduled or event-driven workflows like nightly code reviews and dependency bumps.

zh.tag: Meta 开源设计系统，组件丰富且支持 AI 代理协作
zh.what: Astryx 是 Meta 内部使用八年、支撑 13000+ 应用的设计系统，现已开源。它提供 150+ 可访问组件、主题、暗黑模式、模板和 CLI，并针对人类与 AI 代理协作进行了优化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心包 @astryxdesign/core（React 组件和 CSS）、文档站点、Storybook 和可在线试玩的 Sandbox，以及用于快速启动项目的 CLI 工具。
zh.stack: 基于 React 19+ 和 StyleX 构建，但消费者无需引入样式库，可通过 className 覆盖（支持 Tailwind、CSS modules 等）。
zh.hot: Meta 背书和 12k+ stars 使其备受关注，尤其适合 AI 代理协作的设计系统定位，在 TypeScript 日榜排名第 7。
uses: 前端开发者在 React 19 项目中快速搭建可访问的 UI，无需额外样式库
设计系统团队参考 Meta 的组件架构和主题定制方案
AI 代理工具链开发者利用其 API 和 CLI 实现自动化 UI 生成

en.tag: Meta's open-source design system, fully customizable and agent-ready
en.what: Astryx is an open-source design system that grew inside Meta over eight years, powering 13,000+ apps. It ships 150+ accessible components, theming, dark mode, templates, and a CLI, designed for both human and AI agent collaboration.
en.content: The repo contains the core package @astryxdesign/core with React components and CSS, plus docs, Storybook, a live Sandbox, and a CLI for scaffolding projects.
en.stack: Built on React 19+ and StyleX, but consumers don't need a styling library; they can override with className using Tailwind, CSS modules, or plain CSS.
en.hot: Backed by Meta and 12k+ stars, it's trending #7 in TypeScript daily; its agent-ready design system positioning attracts attention.
uses: Frontend developers building accessible UIs in React 19 projects without extra styling libs
Design system teams looking for Meta's component architecture and theming approach
AI agent tooling developers leveraging its API and CLI for automated UI generation

zh.tag: 开源免费AI网关，单端点聚合264家模型提供商并智能压缩省token
zh.what: OmniRoute 是一个开源的免费 AI 网关，通过单一 API 端点聚合了 264+ 家模型提供商（含 90+ 免费 tier），让你能把 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等主流编程工具无缝接入免费的 Claude、GPT 或 Gemini。它内置 RTK+Caveman 双层压缩算法，可自动减少 15%–95% 的 token 消耗，并支持智能故障自动回退、MCP/A2A 协议以及多模态接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含可直接部署的网关核心、Web 管理后台（Dashboard）、PWA 与桌面端应用，以及详细的路由策略配置、免费额度文档和 Provider 接入模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 全栈构建，网关层采用 Node.js 高并发架构，前端提供 React 驱动的 Dashboard 与 PWA，并支持 Desktop 端封装。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3,605 Star、总星数突破 1.8 万并登上 GitHub 周榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对「零成本调用多模型」的强烈需求——聚合 90+ 免费提供商与高达 95% 的 token 压缩能力，直接切中了 AI 应用落地时的成本焦虑。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小型团队 —— 想用 Claude/GPT/Gemini 但预算有限，通过免费 tier 聚合实现零成本调用。
AI 编程工具重度用户 —— 将 Cursor、Cline、Claude Code 等 IDE 插件的底层模型切换到免费提供商。
网关/中间件自建者 —— 需要统一端点管理多模型路由、自动容灾和 token 压缩的企业内部 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway aggregating 264 providers with token compression and auto-fallback
en.what: OmniRoute is an open-source free AI gateway that aggregates 264+ providers—including 90+ free tiers—behind a single API endpoint, letting you plug Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other tools into free Claude, GPT or Gemini instances. It features RTK+Caveman stacked compression to cut token usage by 15–95%, alongside smart auto-fallback, MCP/A2A support, and multimodal APIs.
en.content: The repo ships with a deployable gateway core, a web admin dashboard, PWA and desktop apps, plus routing strategy configs, free-tier documentation, and provider integration templates.
en.stack: Built entirely in TypeScript on a Node.js backend for high-concurrency gateway operations, with a React-based web dashboard and PWA, plus desktop packaging.
en.hot: It gained 3,605 stars this week, reaching 18.4k total and hitting #16 on GitHub Trending, as developers rush to cut AI costs—aggregating 90+ free providers and slashing token usage by up to 95% directly addresses the biggest barrier to shipping AI apps.
uses: Indie devs & small teams —— Access Claude/GPT/Gemini at zero cost by pooling 90+ free tiers instead of paid APIs.
Power users of AI coding tools —— Redirect Cursor, Cline, Claude Code and Copilot to free model backends via one endpoint.
Platform builders —— Those needing a unified gateway with auto-fallback, routing strategies, and token compression for internal AI infra.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的跨平台笔记与待办应用，支持端到端加密同步
zh.what: Joplin 是一款免费开源的笔记和待办应用，支持将大量笔记组织成笔记本。笔记采用 Markdown 格式，支持搜索、复制、标签和编辑，并可从 Evernote 导入数据。它采用离线优先设计，确保数据随时可访问，并通过端到端加密与多种云服务同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端（Windows/macOS/Linux）和移动端（Android/iOS）应用源码，以及 Web Clipper 浏览器扩展、插件系统、主题和完整的文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，桌面端基于 Electron，移动端使用 React Native，支持多种同步后端（Nextcloud、Dropbox、OneDrive 等）。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 5.6 万星标，因其注重隐私、开源免费且功能强大而广受欢迎，今日新增 11 星，仍稳居 TypeScript 趋势榜前列。
uses: 注重隐私的用户，希望完全掌控自己的笔记数据，避免云端锁定。
需要跨平台同步笔记和待办事项的开发者或知识工作者。
从 Evernote 迁移的用户，需要导入现有笔记并继续使用 Markdown 编辑。

en.tag: Privacy-focused cross-platform note-taking and to-do app with E2E sync
en.what: Joplin is a free, open-source note-taking and to-do app that organizes notes into notebooks. Notes are in Markdown, searchable, and can be imported from Evernote. It is offline-first, ensuring data accessibility, and syncs with end-to-end encryption via various cloud services.
en.content: The repo contains source code for desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux) and mobile (Android/iOS) apps, plus Web Clipper browser extension, plugin system, themes, and full documentation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron for desktop and React Native for mobile, supporting multiple sync backends (Nextcloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, etc.).
en.hot: With over 56k stars, it's popular for its privacy focus, open-source nature, and robust features. Gaining 11 stars today, it remains a top TypeScript trending repo.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want full control over their note data and avoid vendor lock-in.
Developers or knowledge workers needing cross-platform note and task sync.
Users migrating from Evernote who need to import existing notes and continue with Markdown editing.

zh.tag: 给设计工程师准备的一套 UI 类 Agent Skills
zh.what: 知名设计工程师 ibelick 出品的 UI 技能包集合：让 AI 编码 agent 按任务自动走对应的 UI 技能流程，跑一行 npx ui-skills start 就能把 agent 路由到合适的技能集。
zh.content: skills/ 目录下 6 个技能：baseline-ui、improve-ui、fixing-accessibility、fixing-metadata、fixing-motion-performance、ui-skills-root；另有 bin/（CLI 入口）和配套网站（Astro + Cloudflare Workers）。
zh.stack: TypeScript，CLI 走 npx 分发，MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，官网 ui-skills.com。
zh.hot: 把设计判断封装成 AI Agent 可复用技能，这一思路对设计工程师直观易懂，也便于立刻试用。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 让 agent 按设计规范生成和改进 UI，告别「能跑但丑」
设计工程师 —— 把无障碍、metadata、动效性能检查自动化
独立开发者 —— 一人兼顾开发和设计时的品味兜底

en.tag: A set of UI Agent Skills for design engineers
en.what: A UI skill-pack collection from well-known design engineer ibelick: routes your AI coding agent through the right UI skill workflow per task — run npx ui-skills start and the agent picks the appropriate skill set.
en.content: Six skills under skills/: baseline-ui, improve-ui, fixing-accessibility, fixing-metadata, fixing-motion-performance and ui-skills-root; plus bin/ (the CLI entry) and the companion site (Astro on Cloudflare Workers).
en.stack: TypeScript, CLI distributed via npx, MIT; created January 2026, site at ui-skills.com.
en.hot: The idea of packaging design judgment as reusable skills for AI agents is easy for design engineers to understand and immediately test.
uses: Frontend developers — let agents generate and improve UI to design standards, no more 'works but ugly'
Design engineers — automate accessibility, metadata and motion-performance checks
Indie hackers — a taste safety net when you cover both dev and design

zh.tag: 开源项目管理平台，Jira/Linear 替代品
zh.what: Plane 是一个开源的项目管理平台，旨在替代 Jira、Linear、Monday 和 ClickUp。它帮助团队管理任务、迭代（Cycles）、文档和问题分类（Triage），提供现代化的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的项目管理系统源码，包括前端（TypeScript/React）、后端（Python/Django）以及部署配置（Docker、Kubernetes）。提供丰富的功能：工作项、周期、模块、视图等。
zh.stack: 前端使用 TypeScript 和 React，后端使用 Python 和 Django，数据库采用 PostgreSQL，支持 Docker 和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.hot: Plane 在 GitHub 上拥有 56k+ stars，今日新增 98 个，位列 Trending 日榜第 15。其开源替代商业项目管理工具的理念吸引了大量开发者，且功能丰富、部署灵活。
uses: 团队项目管理：适合需要任务跟踪、迭代管理和文档协作的团队。
自托管需求：对数据隐私和基础设施有控制要求的企业或组织。
开发者社区：对开源项目管理工具感兴趣，希望参与贡献或定制的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source project management platform, Jira/Linear alternative
en.what: Plane is an open-source project management platform designed as an alternative to Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp. It helps teams manage tasks, cycles, docs, and triage with a modern user experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the project management system, including frontend (TypeScript/React), backend (Python/Django), and deployment configurations (Docker, Kubernetes). It offers rich features: work items, cycles, modules, views, etc.
en.stack: Frontend uses TypeScript and React, backend uses Python and Django, database is PostgreSQL, supports Docker and Kubernetes deployment.
en.hot: Plane has 56k+ stars on GitHub, with 98 new stars today, ranking 15th on the daily trending list. Its open-source alternative to commercial project management tools attracts many developers, with rich features and flexible deployment.
uses: Team project management: suitable for teams needing task tracking, cycle management, and document collaboration.
Self-hosting needs: enterprises or organizations requiring control over data and infrastructure.
Developer community: developers interested in open-source project management tools, wanting to contribute or customize.

zh.tag: 终端 AI 编程代理，内置 IDE 能力
zh.what: oh-my-pi 是一个终端 AI 编程代理，将 IDE 的编辑能力集成到命令行中。它支持哈希锚定的编辑、优化的工具集、LSP、Python、浏览器和子代理等功能，旨在提供开箱即用且高度可定制的编码体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 代码库（约 8 万行）、TypeScript 编写的编码代理包，以及安装脚本和文档。提供 60+ 提供商、31 个内置工具、14 个 LSP 操作和 28 个 DAP 操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 和 TypeScript，运行时支持 Bun（推荐），并支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。依赖包括 LSP 和 DAP 协议，以及多种 AI 提供商。
zh.hot: 作为 Pi 的 fork，它提供了更强大的代理表面，并持续根据真实使用进行调优。本周新增 1739 星，总星数达 22525，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 16 名，反映了开发者对终端 AI 编码工具的高度关注。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接获得 AI 辅助编码，无需切换 IDE
需要高度可定制和可扩展的 AI 代理，支持多种提供商和工具
喜欢使用 Rust 和 TypeScript 构建高性能命令行工具的技术爱好者
希望利用 LSP 和 DAP 集成进行代码导航和调试的开发者

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with IDE wired in
en.what: oh-my-pi is a terminal AI coding agent that integrates IDE capabilities into the command line. It supports hash-anchored edits, an optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, and subagents, aiming to provide an out-of-the-box yet deeply customizable coding experience.
en.content: The repository contains a core Rust codebase (~80k lines), a TypeScript coding agent package, and installation scripts and docs. It offers 60+ providers, 31 built-in tools, 14 LSP ops, and 28 DAP ops.
en.stack: Primarily Rust and TypeScript, with Bun as the recommended runtime, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It leverages LSP and DAP protocols and integrates with multiple AI providers.
en.hot: As a fork of Pi, it offers a more capable agent surface and is continuously tuned by real-world use. With 1,739 stars added this week and a total of 22,525, ranking #16 on the TypeScript weekly trending, it reflects high developer interest in terminal AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without switching IDEs
Those needing a highly customizable and extensible AI agent with multiple providers and tools
Tech enthusiasts interested in building high-performance CLI tools with Rust and TypeScript
Developers who want to leverage LSP and DAP integration for code navigation and debugging

zh.tag: 自托管 AI 伴侣，复刻 Neuro-sama，支持实时语音与游戏
zh.what: AIRI 是一个自托管的 AI 伴侣项目，旨在复刻虚拟主播 Neuro-sama 的交互体验。它支持实时语音聊天、Minecraft 和 Factorio 等游戏互动，让用户拥有属于自己的 AI 虚拟角色。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端（Web/macOS/Windows）、服务端代码、文档和 Discord/Telegram 等社区链接。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 和现代 Web 技术栈，支持跨平台部署。
zh.hot: 4.4 万 Star 且日增 572，因其复刻热门虚拟主播 Neuro-sama 的独特概念，结合自托管与游戏互动功能，吸引了大量 AI 和二次元爱好者。
uses: AI 爱好者 —— 自托管专属 AI 伴侣，体验实时语音互动
二次元/虚拟主播粉丝 —— 复刻 Neuro-sama，打造个性化虚拟角色
游戏玩家 —— 在 Minecraft/Factorio 中与 AI 伴侣一起游玩
开发者 —— 学习或贡献 TypeScript 全栈 AI 应用

en.tag: Self-hosted AI companion, recreating Neuro-sama, with real-time voice and game support
en.what: AIRI is a self-hosted AI companion project that recreates the interactive experience of virtual streamer Neuro-sama. It supports real-time voice chat and game interactions like Minecraft and Factorio, giving users their own AI virtual character.
en.content: The repo includes full client (Web/macOS/Windows) and server code, documentation, and community links like Discord/Telegram.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on Node.js and modern web tech stack, supports cross-platform deployment.
en.hot: 44k stars with 572 daily, driven by the unique concept of recreating popular virtual streamer Neuro-sama, combined with self-hosting and game interaction, attracting AI and anime fans.
uses: AI enthusiasts — self-host a personal AI companion with real-time voice
Anime/vTuber fans — recreate Neuro-sama and customize virtual characters
Gamers — play Minecraft/Factorio with an AI companion
Developers — learn or contribute to a full-stack TypeScript AI app

zh.tag: 零配置、开箱即用的 React 地图组件库
zh.what: mapcn 是一个免费开源的 React 地图组件库，基于 MapLibre GL 构建，支持 Tailwind 和 shadcn/ui。它提供主题感知、零配置、可组合的声明式组件，包括标记、弹窗、路线和控件等，让开发者快速集成美观的地图功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含组件源码、文档站点（mapcn.dev）、示例和配置，支持通过 npm 安装，提供基础地图、标记、弹窗、路线、控件等组件。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript、React、MapLibre GL、Tailwind CSS，与 shadcn/ui 兼容，使用 Vite 构建文档。
zh.hot: 凭借零配置、开箱即用的体验和与 shadcn/ui 的无缝集成，star 数已达 1.1 万+，今日新增 184，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: React 开发者快速为项目添加地图功能，无需复杂配置。
使用 shadcn/ui 的团队，希望保持 UI 风格一致的地图组件。
需要主题自适应（明暗模式）地图界面的 Web 应用。
非商业项目可免费使用，商业项目需注意底图许可。

en.tag: Zero-config, ready-to-use React map components built on MapLibre GL
en.what: mapcn is a free and open-source React map component library built on MapLibre GL, styled with Tailwind, and compatible with shadcn/ui. It offers theme-aware, zero-config, composable declarative components for markers, popups, routes, and controls, enabling developers to quickly integrate beautiful map features.
en.content: The repository contains component source code, documentation site (mapcn.dev), examples, and configuration. It can be installed via npm and provides components for basic maps, markers, popups, routes, and controls.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, React, MapLibre GL, Tailwind CSS, compatible with shadcn/ui, and uses Vite for documentation.
en.hot: With zero-config, out-of-the-box experience and seamless shadcn/ui integration, it has gained 11k+ stars, adding 184 today, and hit the GitHub trending list.
uses: React developers who want to add map functionality quickly without complex setup.
Teams using shadcn/ui who need map components that match their UI style.
Web apps requiring theme-aware (light/dark) map interfaces.
Non-commercial projects can use for free; commercial use requires attention to basemap licensing.

zh.tag: 高质量 TypeScript 类型定义仓库
zh.what: DefinitelyTyped 是 TypeScript 社区维护的集中式仓库，为 npm 上大量 JavaScript 库提供高质量的 .d.ts 类型定义。它让 TypeScript 开发者能在没有官方类型的库中获得类型检查和智能提示。
zh.content: 仓库包含数千个包的类型定义，每个包一个目录，内含 index.d.ts 和测试文件。采用 pnpm monorepo 结构，并配有 dtslint 等工具进行类型检查和 lint。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，构建工具包括 pnpm、dtslint（基于 tslint 的类型检查工具），以及 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为 TypeScript 生态的基础设施，star 数高达 51k+，几乎所有 TypeScript 项目都会间接依赖它，因此持续保持热度。
uses: TypeScript 开发者：为无官方类型的库安装 @types/* 包，获得类型支持。
库作者：通过 DefinitelyTyped 发布类型定义，扩大库的可用性。
贡献者：参与维护和提交新类型定义，提升社区影响力。

en.tag: High-quality TypeScript type definitions repository
en.what: DefinitelyTyped is a centralized repository maintained by the TypeScript community, providing high-quality .d.ts type definitions for a vast number of npm packages. It enables TypeScript developers to get type checking and IntelliSense for libraries without official types.
en.content: The repo contains type definitions for thousands of packages, each in its own directory with index.d.ts and test files. It uses a pnpm monorepo structure with tools like dtslint for type checking and linting.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with build tools like pnpm, dtslint (a type-checking tool based on tslint), and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: As foundational infrastructure for the TypeScript ecosystem, it has 51k+ stars and is indirectly depended on by virtually every TypeScript project, keeping it consistently popular.
uses: TypeScript developers: install @types/* packages for libraries without official types to get type support.
Library authors: publish type definitions via DefinitelyTyped to increase library usability.
Contributors: participate in maintaining and submitting new type definitions to grow community influence.

zh.tag: 终端里的 Gemini AI 代理，开源免费
zh.what: Gemini CLI 是一个开源 AI 代理，将 Gemini 模型直接带入终端，提供轻量级访问，让用户从提示到模型响应路径最短。它支持免费层（个人 Google 账户每天 1000 次请求），并内置多种工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CLI 工具源码、文档、安装脚本和示例截图，支持通过 npx、npm、Homebrew 等方式安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 环境，支持 MCP（模型上下文协议）扩展，集成 Google Search 等工具。
zh.hot: 凭借 Gemini 3 模型的强大能力、免费额度以及终端优先的设计，迅速获得超过 10 万星标，成为开发者日常工具的热门选择。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速调用 AI 辅助编码、调试或执行命令。
需要免费且高频率 AI 请求的个人用户，利用 Google 账户免费额度。
喜欢定制和扩展 AI 工具链的极客，通过 MCP 集成自定义服务。

en.tag: Open-source AI agent bringing Gemini to your terminal
en.what: Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings Gemini models directly into your terminal, offering lightweight access and the most direct path from prompt to model. It includes a free tier (1,000 requests/day with personal Google account) and built-in tools.
en.content: The repository contains the full CLI source code, documentation, installation scripts, and example screenshots, installable via npx, npm, Homebrew, etc.
en.stack: Developed primarily in TypeScript, requires Node.js, supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) for extensions, and integrates tools like Google Search.
en.hot: With powerful Gemini 3 models, free tier, and terminal-first design, it quickly amassed over 100k stars, becoming a popular choice for developers' daily toolkit.
uses: Developers who want quick AI assistance for coding, debugging, or command execution in the terminal.
Personal users needing free and high-frequency AI requests, leveraging Google account free tier.
Enthusiasts who enjoy customizing and extending AI toolchains via MCP integrations.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的 HTML 转视频渲染框架
zh.what: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，能将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可搜索动画转换为确定性的 MP4 视频。它支持本地 CLI 使用，也可作为 AI 编码代理的技能，或作为托管创作流程的渲染核心。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、CLI 工具、技能包（skills）、文档、示例和展示页面，以及用于视频渲染的动画和媒体处理模块。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，要求 Node.js >= 22，依赖 npm 生态，支持与 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等代理集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.2 万星标和日增 149 星，HyperFrames 精准切中 AI 代理生成视频的需求，将 HTML 渲染为视频的创新方式吸引了大量开发者。
uses: AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor）自动生成视频内容，如产品介绍、营销短片。
开发者本地使用 CLI 快速将 HTML 动画转换为 MP4，用于原型或交付。
需要确定性视频渲染的自动化工作流，如批量生成数据可视化视频。

en.tag: Open-source framework turning HTML/CSS into deterministic MP4 videos, built for AI agents
en.what: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via CLI, as skills for AI coding agents, or as the rendering core for hosted authoring workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, CLI tools, skills packages, documentation, examples, showcase pages, and modules for animation and media processing for video rendering.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >= 22, leverages npm ecosystem, and integrates with coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
en.hot: With 42k stars and 149 stars added today, HyperFrames taps into the demand for AI-agent-generated videos, attracting developers with its novel approach of rendering HTML to video.
uses: AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) can automatically generate video content like product intros and marketing clips.
Developers can use the CLI locally to quickly convert HTML animations to MP4 for prototypes or deliverables.
Automated workflows requiring deterministic video rendering, such as batch-generating data visualization videos.

zh.tag: 开源 CRM，面向 AI 时代，可代码化定制
zh.what: Twenty 是一个开源 CRM，旨在替代 Salesforce，专为 AI 时代设计。它提供技术团队构建自定义 CRM 的模块，能够快速适应复杂业务需求，并像管理代码一样管理 CRM 的构建、部署和版本。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 CRM 应用、网站、文档、CLI 工具（create-twenty-app）以及 SDK（twenty-sdk），支持通过代码定义对象、字段和视图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端可能基于 React，后端使用 Node.js，并依赖 PostgreSQL 等数据库，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为 Salesforce 的开源替代品，吸引了大量关注，拥有 55k+ stars，今日新增 59，在 TypeScript 趋势榜上排名第 18，反映了开发者对可定制、AI 友好 CRM 的需求。
uses: 技术团队希望构建高度定制化 CRM，并像管理代码一样管理配置。
开发者希望使用 AI 功能增强 CRM，例如自动化和智能数据管理。
企业希望摆脱 Salesforce 的高成本和封闭性，采用开源方案。
对 CRM 开发感兴趣，想学习现代 TypeScript 全栈架构的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source CRM designed for AI, code-first customization
en.what: Twenty is an open-source CRM designed as an alternative to Salesforce, built for the AI era. It provides technical teams with building blocks to create custom CRMs that meet complex business needs and adapt quickly, allowing CRM to be built, shipped, and versioned like code.
en.content: The repository includes the core CRM application, website, documentation, CLI tool (create-twenty-app), and SDK (twenty-sdk), enabling code-defined objects, fields, and views.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, frontend likely React, backend Node.js, with PostgreSQL database, Docker deployment.
en.hot: As an open-source Salesforce alternative, it has gained significant traction with 55k+ stars, +59 today, ranking #18 on TypeScript trending, reflecting demand for customizable, AI-friendly CRMs.
uses: Technical teams wanting to build highly customized CRMs and manage configurations like code.
Developers looking to integrate AI capabilities into CRM, such as automation and intelligent data handling.
Businesses seeking to avoid Salesforce's high cost and closed nature with an open-source solution.
Developers interested in CRM development and learning modern TypeScript full-stack architecture.

zh.tag: 并行运行100+编码代理的智能IDE
zh.what: Superset 是一个智能 IDE，允许用户同时运行 100 多个编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等），每个代理在独立的 git worktree 中工作，互不干扰。它提供了终端、差异查看器、编辑器集成等功能，帮助开发者并行处理多个任务，提高编码效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（macOS）、CLI、SDK 和 MCP 服务器，以及营销网站和文档。核心功能包括并行工作区、代理监控、差异查看和编辑器集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，可能涉及 Electron、React 等前端技术，以及 git 集成和 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的兴起，开发者需要并行运行多个代理来提高效率。Superset 解决了多代理协作的痛点，star 数已达 13k+，在 GitHub 趋势榜上排名第 19。
uses: 开发者希望同时运行多个编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）来加速开发，避免等待。
团队需要并行处理多个任务或功能分支，并希望集中监控代理进度。
喜欢使用 CLI 代理但希望有图形界面来管理和审查变更的用户。

en.tag: Agentic IDE to run 100+ coding agents in parallel
en.what: Superset is an agentic IDE that lets you run 100+ coding agents (like Claude Code, Codex) in parallel, each in its own isolated git worktree. It provides a built-in terminal, diff viewer, and editor integration, enabling developers to handle multiple tasks concurrently and boost productivity.
en.content: The repository contains a desktop app (macOS), CLI, SDK, and MCP server, along with marketing site and docs. Core features include parallel workspaces, agent monitoring, diff viewing, and editor integration.
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript, likely using Electron, React, and git integration, along with MCP protocol support.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need to run multiple agents in parallel for efficiency. Superset addresses the pain point of multi-agent collaboration, amassing 13k+ stars and ranking #19 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers who want to run multiple coding agents (like Claude Code, Codex) in parallel to speed up development and avoid waiting.
Teams that need to handle multiple tasks or feature branches concurrently and want centralized monitoring of agent progress.
Users who prefer CLI agents but want a GUI to manage and review changes.

zh.tag: 开源免费的 Airtable 替代品，自托管在线数据库构建工具
zh.what: NocoDB 是一个开源、免费且可自托管的在线数据库构建平台，旨在成为 Airtable 的替代品。它允许用户通过直观的电子表格界面快速创建和管理数据库，无需编写代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端 GUI（基于 Vue）和后端服务（基于 NestJS），提供 Docker 镜像、命令行工具以及多语言文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端采用 Vue.js，后端采用 NestJS，支持 SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL 等数据库，可通过 Docker 快速部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 64,666 颗星，NocoDB 成为 GitHub 上最受欢迎的 Airtable 替代品之一，因其开源免费、自托管灵活以及强大的功能而备受青睐。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队希望快速搭建在线数据库，无需后端编码。
企业需要自托管数据管理平台，确保数据隐私和合规性。
教育机构或非技术用户需要协作式数据管理工具，类似电子表格但更强大。

en.tag: Free & self-hostable Airtable alternative for building online databases
en.what: NocoDB is an open-source, free, and self-hostable online database builder that serves as an Airtable alternative. It enables users to quickly create and manage databases through an intuitive spreadsheet-like interface without writing code.
en.content: The repository includes a frontend GUI (Vue-based) and a backend service (NestJS-based), providing Docker images, CLI tools, and multi-language documentation.

zh.stack: 基于 Svelte 和 Vite，使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 环境。适配器支持多种部署目标，如 Node、静态托管、Cloudflare、Netlify、Vercel 等。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增星标为 0，但总星标超过 2 万，位居 JavaScript 趋势榜前列。SvelteKit 以其简洁的语法和出色的性能持续吸引开发者，成为现代 Web 开发的热门选择。
uses: 适合希望用 Svelte 构建全栈应用的开发者，享受简洁语法和高效开发体验。
适用于需要服务端渲染或静态站点生成的项目，如博客、文档站、电商网站等。
团队寻求统一技术栈，从原型到生产部署，利用适配器轻松部署到云平台。

en.tag: Full-stack web framework built on Svelte, streamlined development experience
en.what: SvelteKit is a full-stack framework for building high-performance web apps, based on the Svelte component model. It offers file-based routing, server-side rendering, static site generation, and more, allowing developers to build web apps of any scale with a single codebase.
en.content: The repository contains the core package @sveltejs/kit and several official adapters (e.g., adapter-auto, adapter-node, adapter-static) for deploying apps to different platforms. It also includes tools like enhanced-img and package publishing.
en.stack: Built on Svelte and Vite, written in JavaScript, requires Node.js. Adapters support various deployment targets like Node, static hosting, Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel, etc.
en.hot: Despite zero stars today, it has over 20k stars and ranks high on the JavaScript trending list. SvelteKit continues to attract developers with its concise syntax and excellent performance, making it a popular choice for modern web development.
uses: For developers building full-stack apps with Svelte, enjoying concise syntax and efficient development.
Ideal for projects needing SSR or SSG, such as blogs, documentation sites, e-commerce.
Teams seeking a unified tech stack from prototype to production, deploying easily via adapters.

zh.tag: Rust 原生高性能量化交易平台
zh.what: NautilusTrader 是一个基于 Rust 的高性能量化交易平台，采用确定性事件驱动架构，专为生产环境设计。它提供低延迟、高吞吐量的交易执行和回测能力，同时支持 Python 接口，便于策略开发和集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心交易引擎、回测模块、市场数据适配器、策略框架以及多种交易所连接器。代码主要用 Rust 编写，同时提供 Python 绑定，包含完整的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 Python 3.12-3.14，兼容 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。依赖包括 PyO3 用于 Python 绑定，以及 Arrow 等用于数据处理。
zh.hot: 凭借 25.9k 星标和今日新增 120 星，NautilusTrader 因其生产级 Rust 性能、确定性架构和活跃社区而备受关注，成为量化交易领域的热门选择。
uses: 量化交易员和算法工程师：用于构建低延迟交易策略和执行系统。
金融科技公司：作为交易基础设施的核心组件，支持回测和实盘交易。
研究人员：利用其高性能回测引擎进行策略研究和数据分析。
开发者：通过 Python API 快速原型设计，或使用 Rust 进行深度定制。

en.tag: Production-grade Rust-native algorithmic trading platform
en.what: NautilusTrader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform built in Rust with a deterministic event-driven architecture, designed for production use. It offers low-latency, high-throughput execution and backtesting capabilities, with a Python API for strategy development and integration.
en.content: The repository contains the core trading engine, backtesting module, market data adapters, strategy framework, and various exchange connectors. The code is primarily in Rust with Python bindings, including comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings for 3.12-3.14, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows. Dependencies include PyO3 for Python bindings and Arrow for data handling.
en.hot: With 25.9k stars and 120 new stars today, NautilusTrader gains attention for its production-grade Rust performance, deterministic architecture, and active community, making it a popular choice in algorithmic trading.
uses: Quant traders and algo engineers: for building low-latency trading strategies and execution systems.
Fintech companies: as a core component of trading infrastructure for backtesting and live trading.
Researchers: leveraging its high-performance backtesting engine for strategy research and data analysis.
Developers: rapid prototyping via Python API or deep customization with Rust.

zh.tag: Web 项目一体化工具链，集格式化与检查于一身
zh.what: Biome 是一个为 Web 项目设计的工具链，旨在提供维护项目所需的功能。它通过 CLI 和 LSP 提供格式化和 lint 功能，帮助开发者保持代码风格一致并发现潜在问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 实现、CLI 工具、LSP 服务器、VS Code 扩展以及多语言 README 文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 npm 包和 VS Code 扩展，支持多种编辑器集成。
zh.hot: Biome 作为 JavaScript/TypeScript 工具链的快速替代品，凭借其高性能和一体化特性，在开发者中广受欢迎，star 数已超 2.5 万。
uses: 前端开发者：希望用单一工具替代 ESLint 和 Prettier，简化项目配置。
团队协作：统一代码风格，减少代码审查中的格式争议。
编辑器用户：通过 LSP 或 VS Code 扩展获得实时格式化和 lint 反馈。

en.tag: All-in-one toolchain for web projects, combining formatter and linter
en.what: Biome is a toolchain for web projects, aimed to provide functionalities to maintain them. It offers formatter and linter, usable via CLI and LSP, helping developers keep code style consistent and catch potential issues.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust implementation, CLI tool, LSP server, VS Code extension, and multi-language README documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, offering npm packages and VS Code extension, with support for multiple editor integrations.
en.hot: Biome gains popularity as a fast alternative to JavaScript/TypeScript toolchains, with its high performance and all-in-one nature, amassing over 25k stars.
uses: Frontend developers: looking to replace ESLint and Prettier with a single tool to simplify project setup.
Team collaboration: unify code style and reduce formatting disputes in code reviews.
Editor users: get real-time formatting and lint feedback via LSP or VS Code extension.

zh.tag: 为 JS/TS 与 AI 代理优化的 Rust 构建系统
zh.what: Turborepo 是一个专为 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 项目设计的构建系统，使用 Rust 编写，以速度和效率著称。它旨在优化 monorepo 的构建流程，支持增量构建、任务缓存和并行执行，从而显著提升开发体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Turborepo 的 Rust 核心实现、CLI 工具、文档和示例，以及用于集成和测试的配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，同时包含 TypeScript/JavaScript 的绑定和 CLI，依赖 npm 生态。
zh.hot: 作为 Vercel 推出的构建工具，Turborepo 凭借 Rust 的高性能和针对 AI 代理的优化，在开发者中广受欢迎，近 3.1 万星标持续吸引关注。
uses: 适合管理大型 monorepo 的前端团队，提升构建速度和开发效率。
适用于需要高效任务缓存和并行构建的 JavaScript/TypeScript 项目。
对 AI 编码代理友好的构建系统，便于自动化任务和集成。

en.tag: Rust-powered build system optimized for JavaScript/TypeScript and coding agents
en.what: Turborepo is a build system optimized for JavaScript and TypeScript projects, written in Rust for speed and efficiency. It aims to optimize monorepo build workflows with incremental builds, task caching, and parallel execution, significantly improving developer experience.
en.content: The repository contains Turborepo's Rust core implementation, CLI tooling, documentation, and examples, along with configuration for integration and testing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with TypeScript/JavaScript bindings and CLI, leveraging the npm ecosystem.
en.hot: As a Vercel-backed build tool, Turborepo's Rust-based performance and optimization for AI agents have made it popular among developers, with nearly 31k stars and ongoing attention.
uses: Ideal for frontend teams managing large monorepos to speed up builds and improve efficiency.
Suitable for JavaScript/TypeScript projects requiring efficient task caching and parallel builds.
A build system friendly to AI coding agents, facilitating automation and integration.

zh.tag: 零配置终端 IDE，兼具 VS Code 体验与极速性能
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能齐全的终端文本编辑器，无需任何配置即可使用。它提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，如命令面板、多光标编辑和 LSP 支持，旨在让用户无需学习曲线即可高效编辑。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、官方文档、演示 GIF 和安装脚本。核心功能包括文件管理、编辑、搜索替换、导航、分屏、主题定制、LSP 集成以及多任务编排器（基于 git worktree）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 LSP 客户端。支持多平台，通过脚本安装。
zh.hot: 凭借零配置、类 VS Code 的体验和高效处理超大文件的能力，Fresh 在开发者中迅速走红，本周新增 117 星，总星数达 8372，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）第 16 名。
uses: 终端爱好者：希望在终端中获得现代 IDE 体验，无需离开命令行。
服务器/远程开发：通过 SSH 在远程机器上编辑代码，享受本地 IDE 的便利。
性能敏感场景：需要打开超大文件或追求低延迟输入的用户。
极简主义者：厌倦了繁琐配置，想要开箱即用的编辑器。

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE with VS Code-like UX and blazing performance
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor that works with zero configuration. It offers familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features like command palette, multi-cursor editing, and LSP support, aiming to provide a seamless editing experience without a learning curve.
