en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, official documentation, demo GIFs, and installation scripts. Key features include file management, editing, search & replace, navigation, split views, theming, LSP integration, and an orchestrator for multitasking with git worktrees.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP client. Cross-platform with script-based installation.
en.hot: Fresh has gained rapid popularity among developers due to its zero-config, VS Code-like experience and ability to handle multi-gigabyte files efficiently, adding 117 stars this week to reach 8372 total, ranking #16 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts: want a modern IDE experience in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Remote development: edit code on remote machines via SSH with local IDE conveniences.
Performance-sensitive tasks: need to open huge files or desire low-latency input.
Minimalists: tired of complex configuration, want an out-of-the-box editor.

zh.tag: 跨平台原生 GUI 工具包，一套代码多语言
zh.what: Slint 是一个开源声明式 GUI 工具包，用于构建嵌入式、桌面和移动平台的原生用户界面。它使用简单的 .slint 标记语言编写 UI，并支持 Rust、C++、JavaScript 或 Python 的业务逻辑。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Slint 的完整源代码、示例（嵌入式、桌面、移动）、文档和工具集成（如 Figma 插件、Live Preview）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持多种语言绑定，依赖包括编译器和运行时库。
zh.hot: Slint 在 Rust GUI 领域持续热门，因其轻量、跨平台和原生性能，今日新增 14 星，总星数超 2.3 万。
uses: 嵌入式系统开发者，需要低资源占用的原生 UI
跨平台桌面应用开发者，希望用一套代码覆盖多系统
需要与 Rust、C++、Python 或 JS 集成的团队

en.tag: Cross-platform native GUI toolkit with one codebase for multiple languages
en.what: Slint is an open-source declarative GUI toolkit for building native user interfaces for embedded, desktop, and mobile platforms. It uses a simple .slint markup language for UI and connects to business logic in Rust, C++, JavaScript, or Python.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, examples for embedded, desktop, and mobile, documentation, and tooling integrations like Figma plugin and Live Preview.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with bindings for multiple languages, depending on a compiler and runtime libraries.
en.hot: Slint remains popular in the Rust GUI space due to its lightweight, cross-platform, and native performance, gaining 14 stars today and over 23k total.
uses: Embedded systems developers needing low-resource native UI
Cross-platform desktop app developers wanting one codebase for multiple OS
Teams integrating with Rust, C++, Python, or JavaScript

zh.tag: Rust 编写的轻量级网页抓取与搜索 API，兼容 Firecrawl
zh.what: fastCRW 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能网页抓取、爬取和搜索 API，可替代 Firecrawl 和 Tavily。它提供 /scrape、/crawl、/search 等端点，并内置 MCP 服务器，方便 AI 代理集成。支持将 URL 转换为干净的 Markdown 或结构化 JSON。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心服务器（crw-server）、命令行工具（CLI）、Python 包（crw）、npm 的 MCP 包（crw-mcp），以及文档和基准测试脚本。提供一键安装脚本，支持本地部署或使用托管云服务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供单一二进制文件，内存占用低（约 6 MB）。同时提供 Python 和 npm 包，支持 MCP（Model Context Protocol）集成。
zh.hot: 在 1K URL 基准测试中比 Tavily 快 2.3 倍，比 Firecrawl 快 1.5 倍，且内存占用极低，吸引了追求效率和成本效益的开发者。今日新增 20 星，登上 Rust 日榜第 11 名。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要快速、轻量的网页抓取和搜索 API 来增强代理能力。
数据采集工程师：需要大规模爬取和提取结构化数据，且希望降低资源消耗。
自托管爱好者：偏好本地运行，掌控数据隐私和成本。

en.tag: Fast, lightweight Rust web scraping, crawling & search API with Firecrawl-compatible endpoints and MCP server for AI agents.
en.what: fastCRW is a high-performance web scraping, crawling, and search API written in Rust, serving as a drop-in alternative to Firecrawl and Tavily. It offers endpoints like /scrape, /crawl, and /search, and includes an MCP server for AI agent integration. It converts URLs into clean Markdown or structured JSON.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core server (crw-server), a CLI, a Python package (crw), an npm MCP package (crw-mcp), plus documentation and benchmark scripts. It offers one-command installation and supports local deployment or managed cloud.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, delivering a single binary with low memory footprint (~6 MB). Also offers Python and npm packages, with MCP (Model Context Protocol) support.
en.hot: In 1K-URL benchmarks, it is 2.3x faster than Tavily and 1.5x faster than Firecrawl, with minimal memory usage, attracting developers seeking efficiency and cost savings. Gained 20 stars today, ranking 11th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: need fast, lightweight web scraping and search APIs to enhance agent capabilities.
Data collection engineers: require large-scale crawling and structured data extraction with minimal resource usage.
Self-hosting enthusiasts: prefer local deployment for data privacy and cost control.

zh.tag: 开源开发者平台，将脚本转为 API、工作流和 UI
zh.what: Windmill 是一个开源开发者平台，用于构建内部工具，将脚本转换为 API、后台任务、工作流和 UI。它可作为 Retool、Pipedream、Superblocks 的自托管替代品，并提供简化版的 Temporal，支持自动生成 UI 和自定义 UI 来触发工作流和脚本。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Windmill 平台源码，包括后端（Rust）、前端、脚本执行引擎、工作流编排器、UI 生成器，以及 Docker 部署配置和 Helm charts。还提供 Python、TypeScript、Go、Bash、SQL 等多种语言的支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，后端基于 Actix Web，前端使用 Svelte，支持多种脚本语言，并集成 PostgreSQL 作为数据库。
zh.hot: Windmill 因其极快的工作流引擎（比 Airflow 快 13 倍）和作为 Retool 的开源替代品而受到关注。当前在 GitHub 日榜上排名第 12，拥有 17,632 颗星，持续吸引开发者。
uses: 开发者快速构建内部工具和自动化工作流，无需从零搭建前端。
团队需要将现有脚本（Python、TS、Go 等）快速暴露为 API 或定时任务。
寻求自托管、开源替代 Retool 或 Temporal 的企业用户。

en.tag: Open-source developer platform to turn scripts into APIs, workflows and UIs
en.what: Windmill is an open-source developer platform for building internal tools, turning scripts into APIs, background jobs, workflows, and UIs. It serves as a self-hostable alternative to Retool, Pipedream, Superblocks, and a simplified Temporal with autogenerated UIs and custom UIs to trigger workflows and scripts.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Windmill platform, including backend (Rust), frontend, script execution engine, workflow orchestrator, UI generator, plus Docker deployment configs and Helm charts. It supports multiple languages like Python, TypeScript, Go, Bash, SQL, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, backend uses Actix Web, frontend uses Svelte, supports multiple scripting languages, and integrates PostgreSQL as the database.
en.hot: Windmill gains attention for its fastest workflow engine (13x faster than Airflow) and as an open-source alternative to Retool. Currently ranked #12 on GitHub daily trending with 17,632 stars, continuously attracting developers.
uses: Developers quickly build internal tools and automate workflows without building frontends from scratch.
Teams need to expose existing scripts (Python, TS, Go, etc.) as APIs or scheduled jobs quickly.
Enterprises seeking self-hosted, open-source alternatives to Retool or Temporal.

zh.tag: 极速全栈 JavaScript 工具链，替代 Node.js
zh.what: Bun 是一个集 JavaScript 运行时、打包器、测试运行器和包管理器于一体的工具，旨在替代 Node.js。它用 Rust 编写，基于 JavaScriptCore 引擎，显著降低启动时间和内存占用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Bun 的源代码、文档、安装脚本和示例。核心是 `bun` 可执行文件，支持运行 TS/JSX、测试、脚本执行和包安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，底层依赖 JavaScriptCore 引擎，支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 凭借惊人的性能和一体化设计，Bun 在开发者中广受欢迎，Star 数已超 9.5 万，今日新增 42，持续霸榜。
uses: Node.js 开发者寻求更快的运行时和工具链，可无缝迁移现有项目。
前端开发者需要快速打包、测试和运行 TypeScript/JSX 代码。
希望简化开发流程、减少 node_modules 依赖的团队。

en.tag: Ultra-fast all-in-one JS/TS toolkit, drop-in Node.js replacement
en.what: Bun is an all-in-one toolkit for JavaScript and TypeScript apps, combining a runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager. Written in Rust and powered by JavaScriptCore, it dramatically reduces startup times and memory usage.
en.content: The repository contains Bun's source code, documentation, installation scripts, and examples. The core is the `bun` executable, which supports running TS/JSX, testing, script execution, and package installation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging the JavaScriptCore engine underneath, with support for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: With its incredible performance and all-in-one design, Bun has gained massive popularity among developers, amassing over 95k stars, with 42 new stars today, consistently trending.
uses: Node.js developers seeking a faster runtime and toolchain, with seamless migration for existing projects.
Frontend developers needing quick bundling, testing, and running of TypeScript/JSX code.
Teams looking to streamline development workflows and reduce node_modules dependencies.

zh.tag: Git 但更好：为 AI 工作流打造的现代版本控制客户端
zh.what: GitButler 是一个基于 Git 的现代版本控制界面，提供 GUI 和 CLI，专为 AI 工作流设计。它支持堆叠分支、并行分支、无限撤销、轻松修改提交等功能，可作为现有 Git 仓库的友好且强大的替代界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面 GUI 应用（Tauri/Rust/Svelte）和名为 'but' 的 CLI 工具，以及文档、示例和 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 Tauri 和 Svelte，CLI 也是 Rust 实现，依赖 Git 作为底层版本控制。
zh.hot: 凭借 21.5k 星标，GitButler 因将现代开发体验与 AI 工作流结合而受到关注，成为 Git 的替代品。
uses: 开发者希望用更直观的 GUI 或 CLI 来管理 Git 分支和提交，尤其是堆叠分支。
AI 代理或自动化工具需要与 Git 交互，GitButler 提供了为代理设计的接口。
团队希望在不改变底层 Git 仓库的前提下，提升版本控制操作的效率和灵活性。

en.tag: Git, but better: a modern version control client for AI-powered workflows
en.what: GitButler is a modern Git-based version control interface with both GUI and CLI, built for AI-powered workflows. It features stacked branches, parallel branches, unlimited undo, easy commit mutations, and more, serving as a friendlier and more powerful drop-in replacement for Git in any existing repository.
en.content: The repository contains a desktop GUI app (Tauri/Rust/Svelte) and a CLI tool called 'but', along with documentation, examples, and CI configurations.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with the GUI built on Tauri and Svelte, and the CLI also in Rust, leveraging Git as the underlying version control.
en.hot: With 21.5k stars, GitButler has gained attention for combining modern development experience with AI workflows, positioning itself as a Git replacement.
uses: Developers seeking a more intuitive GUI or CLI for managing Git branches and commits, especially stacked branches.
AI agents or automation tools that need to interact with Git, as GitButler offers interfaces designed for agents.
Teams wanting to improve efficiency and flexibility of version control operations without changing the underlying Git repository.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的高性能 JS/TS 工具链集合
zh.what: Oxc（氧化编译器）是用 Rust 编写的高性能 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 工具集合，旨在为 JS 生态提供统一、极速的开发工具链。它驱动了 Rolldown（Vite 的打包器），并支持下一代超快开发工具的无缝协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含解析器（Parser）、转换器（Transformer）、压缩器（Minifier）、模块解析器（Resolver）以及 linter（Oxlint）和格式化器（Oxfmt）等组件，并提供 CLI 工具和库供集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，利用其内存安全和零成本抽象实现高性能；同时提供 npm 包（如 oxlint、oxfmt）以便在 JS 生态中使用。
zh.hot: Oxc 因成为 Vite 下一代打包器 Rolldown 的核心而备受关注，其 Rust 实现带来显著的性能提升，吸引了大量 star（22k+），并在 GitHub Trending 上持续上榜。
uses: 前端工具链开发者：希望构建或集成高性能 JS 解析、转换、压缩功能的开发者。
使用 Vite/Rolldown 的团队：需要极速打包和开发体验的现代前端项目。
需要快速 lint 和格式化的项目：用 oxlint 和 oxfmt 替代传统工具以提升 CI 速度。
对 Rust 与 JS 互操作感兴趣的工程师：学习如何用 Rust 构建高性能 JS 工具。

en.tag: A collection of high-performance JavaScript/TypeScript tools written in Rust
en.what: Oxc (The Oxidation Compiler) is a collection of high-performance tools for JavaScript and TypeScript written in Rust, aiming to provide a unified, ultra-fast toolchain for the JS ecosystem. It powers Rolldown (Vite's bundler) and enables the next generation of seamlessly integrated, ultra-fast development tools.
en.content: The repository contains components such as a parser, transformer, minifier, module resolver, as well as linter (Oxlint) and formatter (Oxfmt), offering CLI tools and libraries for integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging its memory safety and zero-cost abstractions for high performance; also provides npm packages (e.g., oxlint, oxfmt) for use in the JS ecosystem.
en.hot: Oxc gains attention as the core of Rolldown, Vite's next-generation bundler, with its Rust implementation delivering significant performance improvements, attracting over 22k stars and consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Developers building or integrating high-performance JS parsing, transformation, or minification features.
Teams using Vite/Rolldown: modern frontend projects needing blazing-fast bundling and dev experience.
Projects needing fast linting and formatting: replace traditional tools with oxlint and oxfmt to speed up CI.
Engineers interested in Rust-JS interop: learn how to build high-performance JS tools in Rust.

zh.tag: 用WiFi信号实现穿墙感知的空间智能平台
zh.what: RuView 利用普通 WiFi 信号（CSI）实现穿墙的人员检测、呼吸和心率监测、运动追踪及房间状态感知，无需摄像头或穿戴设备。它通过低成本的 ESP32 传感器捕获信号扰动，并转化为可用的空间智能数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台代码、文档、集成指南（Home Assistant、Apple Home、Google Home、Alexa 等），以及 ADR 架构决策记录和示例蓝图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 ESP32 硬件和 CSI 数据，支持 MQTT、Matter 等协议。
zh.hot: 凭借 9 万+ 星标和今日新增 113 星，RuView 因将科幻般的穿墙感知变为现实而备受关注，且完全基于现有 WiFi 基础设施，无需额外硬件。
uses: 智能家居爱好者：无需摄像头即可实现全屋人员检测和生命体征监测，提升隐私和便利性。
养老与医疗监护：监测老人或病人的呼吸、心率及异常活动，及时预警潜在风险。
安防与节能：通过房间占用检测优化照明和空调，同时实现入侵警报。

en.tag: WiFi-sensing platform turning radio waves into spatial intelligence
en.what: RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, enabling through-wall presence detection, vital sign monitoring, and movement tracking without cameras or wearables. It captures signal disturbances via low-cost ESP32 sensors and converts them into actionable insights.
en.content: The repository includes the full platform code, extensive documentation, integration guides for major smart-home ecosystems, ADR records, and starter blueprints.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging ESP32 hardware and CSI data, with support for MQTT, Matter, and other protocols.
en.hot: With over 91k stars and 113 new stars today, RuView captivates by making sci-fi through-wall sensing a reality, leveraging existing WiFi infrastructure without extra hardware.
uses: Smart home enthusiasts: achieve whole-home presence and vital sign monitoring without cameras, enhancing privacy and convenience.
Elderly care and health monitoring: track breathing, heart rate, and anomalies to alert caregivers of potential risks.
Security and energy saving: optimize lighting and HVAC based on room occupancy, and detect intrusions.

zh.tag: Rust 语言的 IDE 语言服务器，提供智能代码补全与重构
zh.what: rust-analyzer 是一个为 Rust 编程提供 IDE 功能的语言服务器，支持跳转定义、查找引用、重构和代码补全。它通过语言服务器协议与多种编辑器集成，并内置格式化与诊断功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含语言服务器的核心实现、架构文档、贡献指南以及安装说明。内部由多个分析 Rust 代码的库组成，并提供了详细的架构文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 rustfmt 和 clippy 进行格式化和诊断，通过语言服务器协议与编辑器通信。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 官方维护的 IDE 工具，star 数达 1.6 万，是 Rust 开发者日常编码不可或缺的基础设施，持续活跃更新。
uses: Rust 开发者：在 VS Code、Vim 等编辑器中获得智能补全、跳转和重构能力
编辑器插件开发者：基于 LSP 集成 rust-analyzer 以提供 Rust 支持
对编译器前端感兴趣的学习者：阅读其架构文档和源码以理解 Rust 代码分析

en.tag: A language server for Rust, delivering IDE features like completion and refactoring
en.what: rust-analyzer is a language server that provides IDE functionality for Rust, including go-to-definition, find-all-references, refactoring, and code completion. It integrates with editors via LSP and includes formatting and diagnostics.
en.content: The repo contains the language server implementation, architecture docs, contributing guide, and installation instructions. Internally, it's structured as a set of libraries for analyzing Rust code, with detailed architecture documentation.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on rustfmt and clippy for formatting and diagnostics, and communicates with editors via the Language Server Protocol.
en.hot: As an official Rust IDE tool, it has 16.7k stars and is essential for daily Rust development, with active maintenance and updates.
uses: Rust developers: get smart completion, navigation, and refactoring in editors like VS Code and Vim
Editor plugin developers: integrate rust-analyzer via LSP to add Rust support
Learners interested in compiler frontends: study its architecture and source to understand Rust code analysis

zh.tag: 跨平台安全 Rust 图形 API，WebGPU 标准实现核心
zh.what: wgpu 是一个基于 WebGPU 标准的跨平台、安全、纯 Rust 图形 API，原生支持 Vulkan、Metal、D3D12 和 OpenGL，并在 wasm 上支持 WebGL2 和 WebGPU。它是 Firefox、Servo 和 Deno 中 WebGPU 集成的核心。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、示例程序、文档和 wiki，以及用于 C 语言绑定的 wgpu-native 子项目。提供丰富的示例和教程链接，帮助开发者快速上手。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，依赖 WebGPU 标准，支持多后端图形 API（Vulkan、Metal、D3D12、OpenGL），并支持 wasm 目标。
zh.hot: 作为 WebGPU 生态的核心基础设施，wgpu 受到广泛关注，拥有 17.8k 星标，是 Rust 图形编程的首选库，持续活跃开发。
uses: Rust 开发者需要跨平台图形渲染，用于游戏、可视化或 GUI 应用。
WebGPU 研究者或浏览器开发者，需要参考或集成 wgpu 作为 WebGPU 实现。
希望学习现代图形 API 的初学者，通过 wgpu 的示例和教程入门。

en.tag: Cross-platform safe Rust graphics API, core of WebGPU implementations
en.what: wgpu is a cross-platform, safe, pure-Rust graphics API based on the WebGPU standard, running natively on Vulkan, Metal, D3D12, and OpenGL, and on WebGL2/WebGPU on wasm. It serves as the core of WebGPU integration in Firefox, Servo, and Deno.
en.content: The repository contains the core library, examples, documentation, and wiki, as well as the wgpu-native subproject for C bindings. It provides extensive examples and tutorial links for quick onboarding.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation, based on the WebGPU standard, supporting multiple graphics backends (Vulkan, Metal, D3D12, OpenGL), and wasm targets.
en.hot: As a core infrastructure of the WebGPU ecosystem, wgpu has gained significant attention with 17.8k stars, being the go-to library for Rust graphics programming and actively developed.
uses: Rust developers needing cross-platform graphics rendering for games, visualization, or GUI applications.
WebGPU researchers or browser developers looking to reference or integrate wgpu as a WebGPU implementation.
Beginners wanting to learn modern graphics APIs through wgpu's examples and tutorials.

zh.tag: JavaScript 的超集，为大型应用提供类型系统
zh.what: TypeScript 是一种开源的编程语言，是 JavaScript 的超集，通过添加可选的静态类型来提升代码的可维护性和可扩展性。它编译为干净的、基于标准的 JavaScript，可在任何浏览器、主机或操作系统上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编译器的完整源代码，包括解析器、类型检查器、转换器和命令行工具。还包含测试套件、文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写（自举），构建工具使用 Gulp，测试框架使用 Mocha 等。
zh.hot: TypeScript 已成为现代 JavaScript 开发的标准，拥有超过 11 万 star，今日新增 168，在 GitHub Trending 上持续热门。
uses: 前端开发者：在 React、Vue 等框架中使用 TypeScript 提升代码质量和开发效率。
后端开发者：使用 Node.js 和 TypeScript 构建可维护的服务器端应用。
大型团队：通过类型系统减少协作中的错误，提高代码可读性。

en.tag: A superset of JavaScript that adds static types for large-scale applications
en.what: TypeScript is an open-source programming language that is a superset of JavaScript, adding optional static types to improve code maintainability and scalability. It compiles to clean, standards-based JavaScript that runs on any browser, host, or OS.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the TypeScript compiler, including the parser, type checker, emitter, and command-line tools. It also includes test suites, documentation, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript (self-hosted), built with Gulp, and tested with Mocha and other tools.
en.hot: TypeScript has become the standard for modern JavaScript development, with over 110k stars and 168 new stars today, keeping it trending on GitHub.
uses: Frontend developers: Use TypeScript with frameworks like React and Vue to improve code quality and productivity.
Backend developers: Build maintainable server-side applications with Node.js and TypeScript.
Large teams: Reduce errors and improve code readability through the type system.

zh.tag: 为自主AI代理打造的零配置、零信任P2P智能网络
zh.what: SAM是一个专为自主AI代理设计的智能网络，节点自动发现并构建P2P网络，实现无缝通信和工具调用。它强调零配置和零信任，确保每个连接、节点和数据包都经过严格认证。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个核心组件：sam-control-plane（注册与授权控制平面）、sam-router（基于libp2p的引导节点和中继）、sam-node（本地节点客户端，提供网格传输和MCP sidecar路由）。提供快速入门指南、集成指南、测试网验证教程和Kubernetes部署文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用Go语言开发，依赖libp2p实现P2P网络，支持Docker和Kubernetes部署，提供MCP（Model Context Protocol）集成。
zh.hot: 今日新增62星，登上Go语言日榜第5，因其为AI代理提供去中心化基础设施，契合当前自主代理和去中心化趋势。
uses: AI代理开发者：希望让代理动态发现并调用跨网格工具。
基础设施运维：需要零配置、零信任的P2P网络解决方案。
边缘计算场景：利用加密身份实现节点在云、本地和边缘环境无缝迁移。

en.tag: Zero-config, zero-trust P2P smart network for autonomous AI agents
en.what: SAM is a smart network built for autonomous AI agents, where nodes automatically discover each other and form a P2P network, enabling seamless communication and tool invocation. It emphasizes zero-config and zero-trust, strictly authenticating every connection, node, and packet.
en.content: The repo contains three core components: sam-control-plane (registry and authorization control plane), sam-router (libp2p bootstrap nodes and relays), and sam-node (local node client providing mesh transport and MCP sidecar routing). It includes quick start guides, integration guides, testnet validation tutorials, and Kubernetes deployment docs.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging libp2p for P2P networking, with Docker and Kubernetes deployment support, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration.
en.hot: Gained 62 stars today, ranking 5th on the Go daily trending list, as it offers decentralized infrastructure for AI agents, aligning with the current trends of autonomous agents and decentralization.
uses: AI agent developers: to enable agents to dynamically discover and call tools across the mesh.
Infrastructure operators: needing zero-config, zero-trust P2P network solutions.
Edge computing scenarios: leveraging cryptographic identities for seamless node mobility across cloud, local, and edge environments.

zh.tag: 本地一键运行 Kubernetes 集群
zh.what: minikube 是一个在本地运行 Kubernetes 集群的工具，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它旨在成为本地 Kubernetes 应用开发的最佳工具，并支持所有适合的 Kubernetes 功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 minikube 的源代码、文档和示例，包括命令行工具、驱动程序和附加组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes 和容器运行时（如 Docker、containerd）。
zh.hot: 作为 Kubernetes 官方项目，star 数高达 32k，是本地开发 Kubernetes 应用的标准工具，今日新增 3 星，仍保持热度。
uses: 本地开发人员：在本地快速启动 Kubernetes 集群，用于开发和测试应用。
学习 Kubernetes：通过 minikube 在个人电脑上实践 Kubernetes 核心概念。
CI/CD 环境：在持续集成中提供轻量级 Kubernetes 集群进行自动化测试。

en.tag: Run Kubernetes locally with one command
en.what: minikube is a tool that runs a Kubernetes cluster locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It aims to be the best tool for local Kubernetes application development and supports all Kubernetes features that fit.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, and examples for minikube, including the CLI tool, drivers, and addons.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, depending on Kubernetes and container runtimes like Docker and containerd.
en.hot: As an official Kubernetes project, it has 32k stars and is the standard tool for local Kubernetes development, with 3 new stars today, maintaining its popularity.
uses: Local developers: quickly spin up a Kubernetes cluster locally for development and testing.
Kubernetes learners: practice core Kubernetes concepts on a personal computer.
CI/CD environments: provide a lightweight Kubernetes cluster for automated testing in continuous integration.

zh.tag: 复古终端音乐播放器，致敬 Winamp
zh.what: cliamp 是一款受 Winamp 启发的复古终端音乐播放器，支持播放本地文件、流媒体、播客、YouTube、Spotify 等众多来源。它提供频谱可视化、参数均衡器和播放列表管理，将现代音乐服务带入终端环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的完整播放器代码，基于 Bubbletea、Lip Gloss、Beep 和 go-librespot 构建。提供安装脚本、Homebrew、AUR、Nix 等多种安装方式，并附有文档和演示视频。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Charmbracelet 的 Bubbletea 和 Lip Gloss 构建 TUI，使用 Beep 处理音频，go-librespot 支持 Spotify。可选依赖包括 ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp 以扩展格式和平台支持。
zh.hot: 凭借对 Winamp 的怀旧情怀和强大的多平台支持，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，3.4k stars 且日增 61，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4 名。
uses: 终端爱好者：喜欢在终端中完成所有操作，追求极客风格的音乐播放体验。
多平台用户：需要统一播放本地、流媒体、播客等多种来源的音乐，且跨平台使用。
怀旧玩家：怀念 Winamp 的界面和功能，希望在终端中重现类似体验。

en.tag: Retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp
en.what: cliamp is a retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp, supporting local files, streams, podcasts, YouTube, Spotify, and more. It features a spectrum visualizer, parametric EQ, and playlist management, bringing modern music services to the terminal.
en.content: The repository contains the full player code written in Go, built with Bubbletea, Lip Gloss, Beep, and go-librespot. It offers multiple installation methods including script, Homebrew, AUR, Nix, and includes documentation and demo videos.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, using Charmbracelet's Bubbletea and Lip Gloss for the TUI, Beep for audio processing, and go-librespot for Spotify support. Optional dependencies include ffmpeg and yt-dlp for extended format and platform support.
en.hot: Riding on Winamp nostalgia and robust multi-platform support, it quickly gained traction with 3.4k stars and 61 daily additions, ranking #4 on the Go trending list.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts: enjoy doing everything in the terminal and seek a geeky music playback experience.
Multi-platform users: need a unified player for local files, streams, podcasts, etc., across different OSes.
Nostalgic users: miss Winamp's interface and features and want a similar experience in the terminal.

zh.tag: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务器，让 AI 直接操作仓库与工作流
zh.what: GitHub MCP Server 是 GitHub 官方的 Model Context Protocol 服务器，允许 AI 代理、助手和聊天机器人通过自然语言直接与 GitHub 平台交互。它可以读取仓库和代码文件、管理 issue 和 PR、分析代码并自动化工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 MCP 服务器实现，提供远程托管版本和本地运行版本，支持多种 MCP 主机（如 VS Code、Claude Desktop、Cursor 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 GitHub REST API 和 MCP SDK，支持远程 HTTP 和本地 stdio 传输。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方项目，它让 AI 工具无缝接入 GitHub 生态，star 数已超 3.2 万，今日新增 19 个，位列 Go 趋势榜第五，反映了开发者对 AI 驱动开发工作流的强烈需求。
uses: 开发者希望让 AI 助手直接操作 GitHub 仓库、issue 和 PR，提升日常开发效率。
团队利用 AI 自动化代码审查、CI/CD 监控和依赖安全分析，减少手动操作。
AI 工具开发者需要将 GitHub 能力集成到自定义代理或聊天机器人中，构建智能工作流。

en.tag: GitHub's official MCP server, connecting AI tools to repositories and workflows
en.what: The GitHub MCP Server is GitHub's official Model Context Protocol server that enables AI agents, assistants, and chatbots to interact directly with the GitHub platform via natural language. It can read repositories and code files, manage issues and PRs, analyze code, and automate workflows.
en.content: The repository contains a Go implementation of the MCP server, offering both a remotely hosted version and a local version, compatible with various MCP hosts like VS Code, Claude Desktop, and Cursor.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the GitHub REST API and MCP SDK, supporting remote HTTP and local stdio transports.
en.hot: As an official GitHub project, it seamlessly integrates AI tools with the GitHub ecosystem, amassing over 32k stars with 19 new stars today, ranking 5th on the Go trending list, reflecting strong developer demand for AI-driven development workflows.
uses: Developers who want AI assistants to directly manage GitHub repositories, issues, and PRs to boost daily productivity.
Teams automating code review, CI/CD monitoring, and dependency security analysis with AI to reduce manual effort.
AI tool builders integrating GitHub capabilities into custom agents or chatbots for intelligent workflows.

zh.tag: 快速、安全、高效的跨平台备份工具
zh.what: restic 是一个用 Go 编写的备份程序，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 等系统。它提供加密、去重和增量备份，确保数据安全且节省存储空间。用户可以通过命令行轻松创建备份仓库、备份文件并恢复数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 restic 源代码、文档、测试和构建配置。主要目录有 cmd（命令行入口）、internal（核心逻辑）、doc（文档）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 FUSE 用于挂载备份，支持多种后端存储（如本地目录、SFTP、S3、Azure Blob 等）。
zh.hot: 作为老牌备份工具，restic 凭借其安全性和效率持续获得关注，目前拥有超过 35k 星标，今日新增 24 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第六。
uses: 个人用户：用于备份个人文件、照片和文档，确保数据安全。
系统管理员：自动化备份服务器和关键数据，支持多种存储后端。
开发者：集成到开发流程中，备份代码和配置，或作为备份解决方案的参考实现。

en.tag: Fast, secure, efficient cross-platform backup tool
en.what: restic is a backup program written in Go, supporting Linux, macOS, Windows, and other systems. It offers encryption, deduplication, and incremental backups, ensuring data security and storage efficiency. Users can easily create backup repositories, back up files, and restore data via the command line.
en.content: The repository contains the full restic source code, documentation, tests, and build configurations. Key directories include cmd (command-line entry), internal (core logic), and doc (documentation).
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relies on FUSE for mounting backups, and supports multiple backends such as local directory, SFTP, S3, Azure Blob, etc.
en.hot: As a well-established backup tool, restic continues to gain attention for its security and efficiency, with over 35k stars and 24 new stars today, ranking 6th on the Go trending list.
uses: Individual users: back up personal files, photos, and documents to ensure data safety.
System administrators: automate backups of servers and critical data, supporting multiple storage backends.
Developers: integrate into development workflows to back up code and configurations, or use as a reference implementation for backup solutions.

zh.tag: 订阅转 API 网关，拼车共享 AI 额度
zh.what: Sub2API 是一个开源 AI API 网关平台，用于将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等订阅统一转换为 API 接口，支持拼车共享，降低使用成本。它允许用户将订阅额度分配给多个成员，并通过标准 API 无缝使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Vue 3 前端面板、Docker 部署配置，以及多语言 README（英文、中文、日文）。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Go 1.26.5、Vue 3.4+、PostgreSQL 15+、Redis 7+，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 37.8k 星标和日增 153 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因其解决 AI 订阅成本高昂的痛点，提供拼车共享方案，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 个人开发者：将多个 AI 订阅统一为 API，便于集成到自己的工具。
小团队：拼车共享订阅额度，降低 AI 使用成本。
AI 应用开发者：需要稳定 API 网关，支持多模型路由。

en.tag: Subscription-to-API gateway for sharing AI quotas
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway platform that converts subscriptions from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, etc., into unified API endpoints, supporting carpooling to share quotas and reduce costs. It allows users to distribute subscription quotas among members and use them seamlessly via standard APIs.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, Vue 3 frontend panel, Docker deployment configs, and multilingual READMEs (English, Chinese, Japanese).
en.stack: Tech stack: Go 1.26.5, Vue 3.4+, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+, Docker-ready.
en.hot: With 37.8k stars and +153 today, it hit the GitHub trending chart, addressing the pain point of high AI subscription costs via carpooling, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Individual developers: unify multiple AI subscriptions into APIs for integration into own tools.
Small teams: share subscription quotas to reduce AI costs.
AI app developers: need a stable API gateway with multi-model routing.

zh.tag: 终端里的 AI 编程搭档，无缝接入你的工具与工作流
zh.what: Crush 是一个运行在终端里的 AI 编程助手，让你在不离开终端的情况下获得 AI 辅助编码体验。它支持多种主流 LLM，并能通过 LSP 和 MCP 扩展功能，深度融入你的开发环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Crush 的完整源代码、安装脚本、文档和示例配置。项目采用 Go 编写，基于 Charm 生态构建，提供跨平台支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Charm 生态（如 Bubble Tea 等）构建 TUI。支持通过 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 兼容 API 接入多种 LLM，并集成 LSP 和 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: 作为 Charmbracelet 的新项目，Crush 凭借其终端原生的 AI 编程体验和强大的可扩展性迅速获得关注，27.6k 的 star 数证明了其受欢迎程度。
uses: 喜欢在终端工作的开发者，希望在不切换应用的情况下获得 AI 辅助编码。
需要灵活切换不同 LLM 模型的团队，利用会话管理保持上下文。
希望利用 LSP 和 MCP 扩展 AI 能力的进阶用户，定制自己的工作流。

en.tag: Your new coding bestie in the terminal, wired into your LLM of choice
en.what: Crush is a terminal-based AI coding assistant that brings AI-powered coding to your favorite terminal. It supports multiple LLMs, and can be extended with LSP and MCP for deeper integration into your development workflow.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and example configurations for Crush. Written in Go and built on the Charm ecosystem, it offers cross-platform support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging the Charm ecosystem (e.g., Bubble Tea) for the TUI. It supports multiple LLMs via OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible APIs, and integrates LSP and MCP protocols.
en.hot: As a new project from Charmbracelet, Crush quickly gained attention for its terminal-native AI coding experience and extensibility, evidenced by its 27.6k stars.
uses: Developers who prefer working in the terminal and want AI-assisted coding without switching apps.
Teams that need flexibility to switch between different LLM models while preserving context.
Advanced users who want to extend AI capabilities with LSP and MCP for customized workflows.

zh.tag: AI代理专用CLI库，452个工具即装即用
zh.what: 这是CLI Printing Press生成的CLI官方库，包含452个经过测试和社区贡献的命令行工具，专为AI代理设计，减少token消耗。提供发现技能，让代理能搜索目录并安装合适的CLI。
zh.content: 仓库包含CLI目录、按22个分类组织的452个工具，以及用于代理的发现技能（如OpenClaw、Claude Code等），每个CLI有对应的技能安装包。
zh.stack: 主要语言是Go，CLI工具可能用Go编写，安装方式包括npm、ClawHub、Hermes等，依赖代理技能框架。
zh.hot: 因为AI代理需要高效工具，此库提供现成CLI，减少token浪费，今日新增7星，登上Go趋势榜第9名。
uses: AI代理开发者：为代理集成现成CLI，提升任务执行效率。
CLI工具爱好者：发现并安装针对特定场景的实用命令行工具。
使用OpenClaw、Claude Code等框架的团队：快速部署代理技能。

en.tag: 452 ready-to-install CLIs for AI agents, browse at printingpress.dev
en.what: This is the official library of CLIs generated by CLI Printing Press, containing 452 tested and community-contributed command-line tools designed for AI agents to reduce token spend. It offers a discovery skill for agents to search the catalog and install the right CLI.
en.content: The repo contains a catalog of 452 CLIs across 22 categories, plus discovery skills for agent harnesses (OpenClaw, Claude Code, etc.), with per-CLI skill installers.
en.stack: Primary language is Go; CLIs are likely Go-based, installed via npm, ClawHub, Hermes, etc., depending on agent skill frameworks.
en.hot: It's hot because AI agents need efficient tools; this library offers ready-made CLIs to reduce token waste, gaining 7 stars today and ranking #9 on Go trending.
uses: AI agent developers: integrate ready-made CLIs to boost agent efficiency.
CLI enthusiasts: discover and install practical command-line tools for specific scenarios.
Teams using OpenClaw, Claude Code, etc.: quickly deploy agent skills.

zh.tag: AI代理的操作系统，让多个代理协作自动化
zh.what: CompozyOS是一个为AI代理设计的操作系统，它将你已有的代理CLI（如Claude Code、Codex等）整合成一个团队，让它们分工协作、自动运行任务并共享项目记忆。你可以在浏览器中全面掌控所有代理活动。
zh.content: 仓库包含Go编写的核心守护进程、Web界面（位于packages/site）、CLI工具和文档，支持通过ACP兼容的代理CLI（如Claude Code、OpenClaw、Hermes）进行交互。
zh.stack: 主要使用Go语言，采用SQLite存储状态，支持HTTP/SSE、UDS、MCP等多种接口，本地优先设计。
zh.hot: 本周新增107星，总星数达2626，登上GitHub Go语言周榜第21名。它解决了多代理协作和自动化运维的痛点，将复杂的代理工程化封装成简单产品，受到开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：希望将多个AI代理（如Claude Code、Codex）整合成团队，自动化日常编码任务。
技术运维：需要持续运行的自动化任务（如定时任务、webhook触发）并希望集中监控和审批。
团队协作：共享项目记忆和代理工作状态，便于团队协作和知识沉淀。

en.tag: An OS for AI agents, turning CLIs into a collaborative team
en.what: CompozyOS is an operating system for AI agents, integrating your existing agent CLIs (like Claude Code, Codex) into a team that splits work, automates tasks, and shares memory. You control everything from a browser.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based daemon, a web shell (packages/site), CLI tools, and docs, interacting with ACP-compatible agent CLIs like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with SQLite-backed storage, supporting HTTP/SSE, UDS, MCP interfaces, and a local-first design.
en.hot: Gained 107 stars this week, totaling 2626, ranking #21 on GitHub Go weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of multi-agent collaboration and automation, packaging complex agent engineering into a simple product, attracting developers.
uses: Developers: Want to integrate multiple AI agents (like Claude Code, Codex) into a team to automate coding tasks.
Technical operators: Need continuously running automations (cron, webhooks) with centralized monitoring and approvals.
Team collaboration: Share project memory and agent activity for better teamwork and knowledge retention.

zh.tag: 开源基础设施即代码工具，Terraform 的替代品
zh.what: OpenTofu 是一个开源的基础设施即代码（IaC）工具，允许你以声明方式安全高效地构建、更改和版本化管理云基础设施。它支持主流服务提供商和自定义内部解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenTofu 的完整源代码，包括 CLI、核心引擎、配置语法解析器、资源图构建器以及执行计划逻辑。还包含贡献指南、社区会议信息和 OpenSSF 最佳实践徽章。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 HashiCorp 的 Terraform 生态（如 HCL 配置语言）但独立维护。
zh.hot: 作为 Terraform 的开源替代品，在 Terraform 许可证变更后迅速获得关注，目前拥有近 3 万星标，日增 8 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 11 名。
uses: 云基础设施工程师：使用代码管理多云环境，实现版本控制和自动化部署。
DevOps 团队：通过执行计划和资源图优化变更流程，减少人为错误。
开源爱好者：参与贡献，推动基础设施工具的开源发展。

en.tag: Open-source Infrastructure as Code tool, a Terraform alternative
en.what: OpenTofu is an open-source Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool that lets you declaratively manage cloud infrastructure safely and efficiently. It supports popular service providers and custom in-house solutions.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of OpenTofu, including the CLI, core engine, configuration syntax parser, resource graph builder, and execution plan logic. It also includes contribution guidelines, community meeting info, and an OpenSSF Best Practices badge.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the Terraform ecosystem (e.g., HCL configuration language) but independently maintained.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Terraform, it gained traction after Terraform's license change, now with nearly 30k stars, +8 today, ranking #11 on Go trending.
uses: Cloud infrastructure engineers: manage multi-cloud environments with code, enabling version control and automated deployment.
DevOps teams: optimize change processes with execution plans and resource graphs, reducing human errors.
Open-source enthusiasts: contribute to the project and promote open-source infrastructure tooling.

zh.tag: Xray 多协议多用户 Web 管理面板
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器管理面板，支持多种代理协议（如 VLESS、VMess、Trojan、Shadowsocks 等），提供用户管理、流量统计、到期限制等功能。它是原 X-UI 项目的增强分支，增加了更多协议支持和稳定性改进。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 面板源码，提供多语言界面（中英等）、Telegram 机器人、RESTful API 和订阅服务。支持单端口多协议 fallback、多节点管理、流量统计和客户端配额。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 Xray-core，使用 SQLite 存储数据。前端采用 Vue.js 和 Element UI，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 45k+ stars，本周新增近 500，因其功能全面、易用性强，成为自建代理服务器的热门选择。
uses: 个人用户：快速搭建和管理自己的代理服务器，支持多种协议和客户端设备。
小型团队：需要多用户管理、流量配额和到期限制的场景。
技术爱好者：希望深入配置 Xray 高级功能（如 REALITY、TUN）的用户。

en.tag: Advanced Xray-core web panel for multi-protocol, multi-user proxy management
en.what: 3X-UI is an open-source web panel for managing Xray-core servers, supporting multiple proxy protocols (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, etc.) with user management, traffic statistics, and expiry limits. It's an enhanced fork of the original X-UI project, adding broader protocol support and improved stability.
en.content: The repository contains the full web panel source code with multi-language UI, Telegram bot, RESTful API, and subscription server. It supports single-port multi-protocol fallback, multi-node management, traffic statistics, and per-client quotas.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging Xray-core, with SQLite for data storage. Frontend uses Vue.js and Element UI, and Docker deployment is supported.
en.hot: With 45k+ stars and nearly 500 added this week, it's a popular choice for self-hosted proxy servers due to its comprehensive features and ease of use.
uses: Individual users: quickly set up and manage their own proxy server with multiple protocols and client devices.
Small teams: scenarios requiring multi-user management, traffic quotas, and expiry limits.
Tech enthusiasts: users who want to configure advanced Xray features (e.g., REALITY, TUN).

zh.tag: 极速 JavaScript 打包器，性能革命
zh.what: esbuild 是一个用 Go 编写的极速 JavaScript 打包器，旨在将构建工具性能提升 10-100 倍。它无需缓存即可实现极速打包，并内置支持 JavaScript、CSS、TypeScript 和 JSX。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、基准测试图表和示例。主要功能包括：内置 JS/CSS/TS/JSX 支持、CLI/JS/Go API、ESM 和 CommonJS 打包、CSS 模块、tree shaking、压缩、source maps、本地服务器、监听模式和插件系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，同时提供 JavaScript 和 Go 的 API。依赖较少，核心是高性能的解析和打包逻辑。
zh.hot: 凭借极致的构建速度（比传统工具快 10-100 倍）而广受欢迎，star 数高达 40k，成为前端构建工具领域的热门选择。
uses: 前端开发者：需要快速打包 JavaScript/TypeScript 项目，提升开发效率。
构建工具维护者：作为底层打包器，集成到更高级的构建系统中。
性能敏感场景：如大型项目、CI/CD 流水线，减少构建时间。

en.tag: An extremely fast JavaScript bundler, performance revolution
en.what: esbuild is an extremely fast JavaScript bundler written in Go, aiming to bring a new era of build tool performance, 10-100x faster than current tools. It achieves extreme speed without needing a cache and has built-in support for JavaScript, CSS, TypeScript, and JSX.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, benchmark charts, and examples. Major features include built-in support for JS/CSS/TS/JSX, straightforward API for CLI/JS/Go, bundling ESM and CommonJS, CSS modules, tree shaking, minification, source maps, local server, watch mode, and plugins.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with JavaScript and Go APIs provided. It has minimal dependencies, focusing on high-performance parsing and bundling logic.
en.hot: It's popular due to its extreme build speed (10-100x faster than traditional tools), with 40k stars, making it a hot choice in frontend build tooling.
uses: Frontend developers: need fast bundling for JavaScript/TypeScript projects to improve dev efficiency.
Build tool maintainers: use as a low-level bundler to integrate into higher-level build systems.
Performance-sensitive scenarios: large projects, CI/CD pipelines, reduce build time.

zh.tag: 统一策略引擎，全栈策略执行
zh.what: OPA 是一个开源的通用策略引擎，提供统一的、上下文感知的策略执行能力，覆盖整个技术栈。它使用 Rego 语言编写策略，支持在微服务、Kubernetes、CI/CD 等场景中实现细粒度的访问控制和合规性检查。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OPA 的 Go 源码、CLI 工具、Docker 镜像、文档、示例策略以及 Rego 语言支持。还提供了 Rego Playground 和 VS Code 扩展等开发工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Rego 策略语言，支持通过 REST API 和 Go 库集成，可运行于 Docker 容器。
zh.hot: OPA 是 CNCF 毕业项目，拥有 12k+ 星标，是云原生领域策略引擎的标杆。今日新增 3 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 微服务和 Kubernetes 环境中的访问控制与策略执行
CI/CD 流水线中的合规性检查和策略验证
需要统一策略管理的平台团队和安全工程师
希望以声明式方式管理基础设施策略的开发者

en.tag: Unified policy engine for context-aware enforcement across the stack
en.what: OPA is an open-source, general-purpose policy engine that enables unified, context-aware policy enforcement across the entire stack. It uses the Rego language to write policies, supporting fine-grained access control and compliance checks in microservices, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and more.
en.content: The repository contains OPA's Go source code, CLI tools, Docker images, documentation, example policies, and Rego language support. It also provides the Rego Playground and VS Code extension for development.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relies on the Rego policy language, supports integration via REST API and Go libraries, and can run in Docker containers.
en.hot: OPA is a CNCF graduated project with 12k+ stars, a benchmark for policy engines in cloud-native. Gaining 3 stars today, it remains popular.
uses: Access control and policy enforcement in microservices and Kubernetes
Compliance checks and policy validation in CI/CD pipelines
Platform teams and security engineers needing unified policy management
Developers who want to manage infrastructure policies declaratively

zh.tag: 阿里巴巴开源的企业级AI代码审查CLI工具
zh.what: OpenCodeReview 是一款基于 AI 的代码审查 CLI 工具，起源于阿里巴巴集团内部，经过两年大规模验证，为数万开发者服务并发现数百万代码缺陷。它读取 Git diff，通过具备工具调用能力的 Agent 将变更文件发送给可配置的 LLM，生成精确到行的结构化审查评论。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具源码、内置精细调优的规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入等）、支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口，以及多语言文档和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 和 LLM API（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 作为阿里巴巴内部大规模验证的代码审查工具开源，结合确定性流水线和 LLM Agent 的混合架构，精准行级评论和内置规则集吸引了大量开发者，今日新增 162 星，总星数 10964。
uses: 开发团队 —— 集成到 CI/CD 流水线，自动审查代码提交，提升代码质量
个人开发者 —— 在本地运行审查，快速发现潜在缺陷和安全漏洞
开源维护者 —— 用于管理 PR 审查，减少人工负担

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review CLI with deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent
en.what: OpenCodeReview is an AI-powered code review CLI tool originating from Alibaba Group's internal system, serving tens of thousands of developers and identifying millions of code defects over two years. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates line-level structured review comments.
en.content: The repo contains Go CLI source code, built-in fine-tuned rulesets (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), support for OpenAI & Anthropic compatible APIs, and multi-language documentation and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, depends on Git and LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic compatible), supports agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
en.hot: Open-sourced from Alibaba's battle-tested internal tool, its hybrid architecture of deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, and built-in rulesets have attracted many developers, gaining 162 stars today and 10964 total.
uses: Development teams — integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated code review on commits, improving code quality
Individual developers — run locally for quick detection of potential defects and security vulnerabilities
Open source maintainers — manage PR reviews with reduced manual effort

zh.tag: 多智能体工作区管理器，持久化任务状态
zh.what: Gas Town 是一个工作区管理器，用于协调多个 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）处理不同任务。它通过 git 支持的钩子持久化工作状态，解决代理重启后丢失上下文的问题，支持可靠的多代理工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心概念如 Mayor（AI 协调器）、Town（工作区）、Rigs（项目容器）、Crew Members、Polecats（工作代理）、Hooks（持久化存储）、Convoys（工作跟踪单元）和 Beads（git 支持的问题跟踪系统）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 git worktree 实现持久化存储，与 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等 AI 代理集成。
zh.hot: 随着多代理协作需求增长，Gas Town 解决了代理重启丢失上下文的核心痛点，star 数达 17736，今日新增 22，位列 Go 日榜第 16 名。
uses: 开发团队需要协调多个 AI 编码代理并行处理任务时，可使用 Gas Town 管理工作区。
希望持久化代理工作状态、避免重启丢失上下文的个人开发者或团队。
需要扩展代理规模至 20-30 个的复杂项目，Gas Town 提供可靠的协调机制。

en.tag: Multi-agent workspace manager with persistent work tracking
en.what: Gas Town is a workspace manager that coordinates multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) on different tasks. It persists work state in git-backed hooks, solving context loss on agent restart and enabling reliable multi-agent workflows.
en.content: The repo includes core concepts like Mayor (AI coordinator), Town (workspace), Rigs (project containers), Crew Members, Polecats (worker agents), Hooks (persistent storage), Convoys (work tracking units), and Beads (git-backed issue tracking).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging git worktree for persistent storage and integrating with AI agents like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.
en.hot: With growing demand for multi-agent collaboration, Gas Town addresses the core pain point of context loss on agent restart, reaching 17,736 stars with 22 new today, ranking #16 on Go daily trending.
uses: Development teams coordinating multiple AI coding agents on parallel tasks can use Gas Town to manage workspaces.
Individual developers or teams wanting to persist agent work state and avoid context loss on restart.
Complex projects needing to scale agent count to 20-30, Gas Town provides reliable coordination.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 原生容器工作流引擎，编排并行任务
zh.what: Argo Workflows 是一个开源的 Kubernetes 原生工作流引擎，用于编排并行作业。它将工作流定义为 Kubernetes CRD，每个步骤都是一个容器，支持顺序任务和 DAG 依赖关系，适合机器学习、数据处理等计算密集型任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Argo Workflows 的完整源代码、文档、示例、Helm 图表以及用于构建和测试的 CI/CD 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Kubernetes CRD 和控制器模式，依赖 Docker 容器运行时。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，Argo Workflows 是 Kubernetes 上最流行的工作流引擎，拥有 16.9k 星标，社区活跃，广泛应用于 CI/CD 和 AI 管道。
uses: 机器学习管道：编排训练、评估和部署步骤，加速模型迭代。
数据处理与批处理：并行处理大数据任务，提高吞吐量。
CI/CD 自动化：构建、测试和发布流程的自动化编排。
基础设施自动化：自动化基础设施配置和管理任务。

en.tag: Container-native workflow engine for orchestrating parallel jobs on Kubernetes
en.what: Argo Workflows is an open-source, container-native workflow engine for orchestrating parallel jobs on Kubernetes. It defines workflows as Kubernetes CRDs, where each step is a container, supporting sequential tasks and DAG dependencies, ideal for compute-intensive jobs like ML and data processing.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, Helm charts, and CI/CD configurations for building and testing Argo Workflows.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, built on Kubernetes CRDs and controller patterns, leveraging Docker container runtime.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, Argo Workflows is the most popular workflow engine on Kubernetes, with 16.9k stars and an active community, widely used for CI/CD and AI pipelines.
uses: Machine learning pipelines: orchestrate training, evaluation, and deployment steps to accelerate model iteration.
Data and batch processing: parallelize large-scale data tasks to increase throughput.
CI/CD automation: automate build, test, and release processes.
Infrastructure automation: automate infrastructure provisioning and management tasks.

zh.tag: 企业级 AI 模型访问与治理网关
zh.what: TokenHub 为企业提供统一的 AI 模型访问与治理层，涵盖模型路由、访问控制、成本优化和账单核对。它让每一次模型调用都可控、可追踪、可归因，解决多团队、多应用消耗模型和令牌时的治理难题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、前端界面（含品牌资源）、Docker Compose 部署配置、多语言 README（中英日）及文档截图。核心功能包括模型路由、权限管理、令牌节省、供应商对账，并围绕用户、团队负责人、管理员三种角色设计工作区。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 1.26，前端位于 frontend/ 目录，支持 Docker Compose 一键部署，并提供 OpenAI 兼容接口。依赖包括 Docker、前端构建工具链等。
zh.hot: 尽管 star 数刚过千，但今日新增 6 星并登上 Go 趋势榜，说明企业级 AI 治理需求正被关注。它填补了开源 AI 网关只做 provider fan-out 而缺乏治理层的空白，直击成本归因和权限管控痛点。
uses: 企业平台团队：统一管理多个 AI 提供商的访问密钥、路由策略和成本预算。
财务与业务团队：通过供应商对账功能核对内部使用量与账单，解释实际 AI 花费。
开发团队：无需在应用中硬编码原始密钥，通过项目级令牌分配安全调用模型。
管理员与团队负责人：在独立工作区中审批、监控和归因日常用量。

en.tag: Enterprise AI model access and governance gateway
en.what: TokenHub provides enterprises with a unified governance layer for AI model access, including model routing, access control, cost optimization, and bill reconciliation. It makes every model call controllable, traceable, and attributable, addressing governance challenges when multiple teams and applications consume models and tokens.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, a frontend with brand assets, Docker Compose deployment configs, multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/JA), and documentation screenshots. Core features include model routing, permission management, token savings, provider reconciliation, and workspaces designed for three roles: user, team lead, and admin.
en.stack: Backend uses Go 1.26, frontend in frontend/ directory, supports Docker Compose deployment, and offers OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Dependencies include Docker, frontend build toolchain, etc.
en.hot: Though stars just passed 1k, it gained 6 today and hit the Go trending list, showing growing interest in enterprise AI governance. It fills the gap of open-source AI gateways that only do provider fan-out but lack a governance layer, directly addressing cost attribution and access control pain points.
uses: Enterprise platform teams: centrally manage access keys, routing policies, and cost budgets across multiple AI providers.
Finance and business teams: reconcile internal usage with provider bills to explain actual AI spend.
Development teams: securely call models via project-level token distribution without hardcoding raw keys in applications.
Admins and team leads: approve, monitor, and attribute daily usage in separate workspaces.

zh.tag: 轻量级 Kubernetes 发行版，单二进制，生产可用
zh.what: K3s 是一个轻量级 Kubernetes 发行版，打包为单个二进制文件，内存占用减半，安装简单。它完全符合 Kubernetes 标准，适用于边缘计算、物联网、CI、开发环境等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 K3s 的源代码、文档、安装脚本和 CI/CD 配置。它集成了 Containerd、Flannel、CoreDNS、Traefik 等组件，并支持多种存储后端。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 containerd、runc、flannel、CoreDNS、Traefik 等开源组件。支持 SQLite、etcd、MySQL、PostgreSQL 等存储后端。
zh.hot: K3s 凭借其轻量级和易用性在开发者中广受欢迎，拥有超过 33k 的 star。它简化了 Kubernetes 的部署，特别适合资源受限的环境。
uses: 边缘计算和物联网场景，资源有限但需要 Kubernetes 功能
CI/CD 流水线中快速搭建临时集群进行测试
开发环境本地运行 Kubernetes，节省内存和配置时间
嵌入式系统或 ARM 设备上运行 Kubernetes

en.tag: Lightweight Kubernetes distribution, single binary, production-ready
en.what: K3s is a lightweight Kubernetes distribution packaged as a single binary, with half the memory footprint and easy installation. It is fully conformant with Kubernetes and suitable for edge, IoT, CI, development, and more.
en.content: The repository contains K3s source code, documentation, installation scripts, and CI/CD configurations. It bundles components like Containerd, Flannel, CoreDNS, Traefik, and supports multiple storage backends.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging open-source components like containerd, runc, flannel, CoreDNS, and Traefik. Supports SQLite, etcd, MySQL, PostgreSQL as storage backends.
en.hot: K3s is popular among developers for its lightweight and easy-to-use nature, with over 33k stars. It simplifies Kubernetes deployment, especially in resource-constrained environments.
uses: Edge computing and IoT scenarios with limited resources but needing Kubernetes features
Quickly spin up temporary clusters for testing in CI/CD pipelines
Run Kubernetes locally in development environments to save memory and setup time
Run Kubernetes on embedded systems or ARM devices

zh.tag: 将 Signal 消息应用封装成 REST API 的 Docker 服务
zh.what: 这个项目将 signal-cli 封装成一个 Docker 化的 REST API，允许开发者通过 HTTP 请求发送和接收 Signal 消息、管理群组、链接设备等。它简化了 Signal 的集成，使非 Java 应用也能轻松使用 Signal 功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Dockerfile、signal-cli 的封装脚本、REST API 端点定义（如 /v1/qrcodelink、/v2/send），以及多种执行模式（normal、native、json-rpc 等）的配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 编写，依赖 signal-cli（Java 应用），支持 Docker 部署，可通过 GraalVM 编译为原生二进制以提升性能。
zh.hot: 随着 Signal 的普及，开发者需要便捷的 API 集成方式，该项目提供了现成的 Docker 解决方案，star 数持续增长，今日新增 8 个，位列 Go 趋势榜第 20。
uses: 开发人员希望将 Signal 消息功能集成到自己的应用或服务中，而不必直接处理 signal-cli 的复杂性。
自动化脚本或聊天机器人需要发送/接收 Signal 消息，通过 REST API 简化操作。
团队或企业需要将 Signal 作为通知渠道，利用 Docker 快速部署和扩展。

en.tag: Dockerized REST API wrapping Signal Messenger via signal-cli
en.what: This project wraps signal-cli into a Dockerized REST API, enabling developers to send/receive Signal messages, manage groups, link devices, and more via HTTP requests. It simplifies Signal integration, making it accessible to non-Java applications.
en.content: The repo includes Dockerfile, wrapper scripts around signal-cli, REST endpoint definitions (e.g., /v1/qrcodelink, /v2/send), and configuration for multiple execution modes (normal, native, json-rpc, etc.).
en.stack: Written in Go, depends on signal-cli (Java app), supports Docker deployment, and can use GraalVM native image for better performance.
en.hot: As Signal gains popularity, developers need easy API integration; this project offers a ready-made Docker solution, with steady star growth (+8 today) and ranking #20 on Go trending.
uses: Developers who want to integrate Signal messaging into their apps without dealing with signal-cli complexity.
Automation scripts or chatbots that need to send/receive Signal messages via simple REST calls.
Teams or enterprises using Signal as a notification channel, leveraging Docker for quick deployment and scaling.

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: 让 Windows 游戏在 Linux 上无缝运行的兼容层
zh.what: Proton 是 Valve 开发的工具，基于 Wine 和额外组件，让 Steam 客户端中的 Windows 独占游戏能在 Linux 上运行。它通过 Wine 实现兼容，并针对游戏进行了优化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Proton 的完整源代码，包括 Wine 的修改版本、构建脚本、Makefile 以及用于构建的容器配置。用户可以通过克隆仓库并构建来定制 Proton，例如更换 Wine 版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Wine、Docker/Podman 容器构建环境，以及 Steam 客户端集成。
zh.hot: Proton 是 Linux 游戏玩家的关键工具，随着 Steam Deck 和 Linux 游戏生态的兴起，其重要性持续上升。32k+ 的 star 反映了社区的高度关注和依赖。
uses: Linux 玩家：在 Steam 上直接运行 Windows 游戏，无需双系统或虚拟机。
高级用户：通过修改源码或使用不同 Wine 版本，优化特定游戏的兼容性。
开发者：研究 Wine 和游戏兼容层，或为 Proton 贡献代码。

en.tag: Compatibility layer that lets Windows games run on Linux
en.what: Proton is a Valve-developed tool based on Wine and additional components that allows Windows-exclusive games on Steam to run on Linux. It leverages Wine for compatibility and is optimized for gaming.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Proton, including a modified Wine, build scripts, Makefiles, and container configurations for building. Users can clone and build to customize Proton, such as using a different Wine version.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on Wine, Docker/Podman containers for building, and integrates with the Steam client.
en.hot: Proton is crucial for Linux gamers, and its importance grows with Steam Deck and the Linux gaming ecosystem. The 32k+ stars reflect high community attention and reliance.
uses: Linux gamers: run Windows games on Steam directly without dual-boot or VM.
Advanced users: customize Proton by modifying source or using different Wine versions for specific games.
Developers: study Wine and compatibility layers, or contribute to Proton.

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能机器学习推理与训练加速器
zh.what: ONNX Runtime 是一个跨平台的机器学习推理和训练加速器，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow/Keras 等深度学习框架以及 scikit-learn、LightGBM、XGBoost 等经典机器学习库。它通过硬件加速器、图优化和变换，在不同硬件、驱动和操作系统上提供最佳性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ONNX Runtime 的完整源代码、文档、示例和发布版本，以及用于推理和训练的示例仓库和插件执行提供程序（如 QNN）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种语言绑定（如 Python、C#、Java），并依赖 ONNX 格式和硬件加速库（如 CUDA、TensorRT）。
zh.hot: 作为微软开源的跨平台推理引擎，ONNX Runtime 在 AI 部署领域具有重要地位，本月新增 306 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 需要在多种硬件（CPU、GPU、NPU）上部署机器学习模型的开发者
希望加速 PyTorch 或 TensorFlow 模型推理的工程团队
需要跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）统一推理解决方案的企业
研究模型优化和硬件加速的 AI 基础设施工程师

en.tag: Cross-platform, high-performance ML inference and training accelerator
en.what: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform inference and training accelerator for machine learning, supporting models from deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras, as well as classical ML libraries such as scikit-learn, LightGBM, and XGBoost. It leverages hardware accelerators, graph optimizations, and transforms to deliver optimal performance across various hardware, drivers, and operating systems.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and releases for ONNX Runtime, along with companion sample repositories for inference and training, and plugin execution providers like QNN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for multiple languages (e.g., Python, C#, Java), and relies on the ONNX format and hardware acceleration libraries (e.g., CUDA, TensorRT).
en.hot: As Microsoft's open-source cross-platform inference engine, ONNX Runtime holds a key position in AI deployment, gaining 306 stars this month and continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Developers deploying ML models on diverse hardware (CPU, GPU, NPU)
Engineering teams looking to accelerate PyTorch or TensorFlow model inference
Enterprises needing a unified cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS) inference solution
AI infrastructure engineers researching model optimization and hardware acceleration

zh.tag: 跨 GPU 的通用超分辨率与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一个允许在支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换原生超分辨率方案的工具，同时可管理帧生成功能，包括通过实验性 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成。它支持将 DLSS 帧生成转换为 FSR3 帧生成（通过 Nukem mod），并为所有用户提供广泛的定制选项。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、预编译的 Stable 和 Nightly 版本、详细的 Wiki 文档、安装指南、已知问题列表以及编译说明。项目结构清晰，包含图像资源、赞助链接和社区 Discord 入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 GPU 厂商的 SDK（如 DLSS、FSR、XeSS）以及 DirectX 12 等图形 API。构建系统支持常规编译流程，并提供了详细的编译指南。
zh.hot: OptiScaler 在 GitHub 上获得近万星标，今日新增 21 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 4。它解决了跨品牌显卡使用超分辨率与帧生成的关键痛点，尤其受到 N 卡和 A 卡用户的广泛关注。
uses: 游戏玩家：在非原生支持 FSR 或 XeSS 的游戏中启用这些技术，提升帧率和画质。
Mod 爱好者：通过替换原生超分辨率方案，实现跨厂商的帧生成功能，如 DLSS 转 FSR3。
开发者/测试者：利用其开源特性进行定制开发，或验证不同 GPU 上的兼容性表现。

en.tag: Universal upscaling/frame-gen bridge across GPUs
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games that already support DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation, including enabling it in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG. It supports converting DLSS frame gen to FSR3 FG via Nukem mod and offers extensive customization for all users.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, precompiled Stable and Nightly releases, detailed Wiki documentation, installation guides, known issues list, and compilation instructions. It includes image assets, sponsor links, and community Discord invite.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, relying on GPU vendor SDKs (DLSS, FSR, XeSS) and graphics APIs like DirectX 12. The build system supports standard compilation with detailed guides.
en.hot: OptiScaler has nearly 10k stars, with 21 added today, ranking #4 on the C++ daily trending. It addresses the key pain point of using upscaling and frame generation across GPU brands, attracting wide attention from both NVIDIA and AMD users.
uses: Gamers: Enable FSR or XeSS in games that don't natively support them, boosting FPS and visual quality.
Mod enthusiasts: Replace native upscalers to enable cross-vendor frame generation, e.g., DLSS-to-FSR3.
Developers/testers: Leverage open-source code for customization or verify compatibility across different GPUs.

zh.tag: 免费强大的国际象棋引擎，UCI 协议，无 GUI
zh.what: Stockfish 是一个免费且强大的国际象棋引擎，基于 Glaurung 2.1 开发，能够分析棋局并计算最优走法。它不包含图形用户界面，需要配合第三方 GUI 使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 README、GNU GPL v3 许可证、作者列表、源代码目录（含 Makefile）以及 NNUE 神经网络权重文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持 32/64 位 CPU、特定硬件指令集、大端机器等，依赖 NNUE 神经网络评估。
zh.hot: 作为国际象棋引擎的标杆，拥有 16k+ star，持续活跃开发，今日新增 10 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第五。
uses: 国际象棋爱好者或开发者，希望集成顶级引擎到自己的 GUI 或应用中。
AI 研究者，研究 NNUE 评估和搜索算法在棋类游戏中的应用。
需要高性能计算资源测试或贡献硬件进行引擎测试的志愿者。

en.tag: A free and strong UCI chess engine, no GUI included
en.what: Stockfish is a free and strong UCI chess engine derived from Glaurung 2.1 that analyzes chess positions and computes optimal moves. It does not include a GUI, requiring third-party interfaces for use.
en.content: The repository includes README, GNU GPL v3 license, AUTHORS file, source code directory with Makefile, and NNUE neural network weights.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, supports 32/64-bit CPUs, specific hardware instructions, big-endian machines, and relies on NNUE neural network evaluation.
en.hot: As a benchmark chess engine, it has 16k+ stars, active development, +10 stars today, ranking 5th on C++ trending.
uses: Chess enthusiasts or developers who want to integrate a top-tier engine into their GUI or applications.
AI researchers studying NNUE evaluation and search algorithms in board games.
Volunteers willing to donate hardware resources for engine testing via Fishtest.

zh.tag: C++ 即时模式 GUI 库，零依赖高性能
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个为 C++ 设计的轻量级图形用户界面库，采用即时模式（immediate mode）范式，输出优化后的顶点缓冲区，可随时在 3D 渲染管线中绘制。它旨在快速迭代，帮助程序员构建内容创作工具、可视化工具和调试工具，而非面向终端用户的常规 UI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Dear ImGui 的核心源码、示例、文档、构建配置（如 CMake）以及测试相关文件。核心代码位于根目录，包括 imgui.cpp、imgui.h 等，另有 examples/ 目录提供多种后端集成示例。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持 OpenGL、DirectX、Vulkan 等多种渲染后端，通过后端适配器集成。
zh.hot: 拥有 75k+ star，是 C++ 社区最受欢迎的 GUI 库之一，因其轻量、高效和易用性而广受游戏开发、工具开发者的青睐。今日新增 32 star，持续保持热度。
uses: 游戏开发中的调试工具和编辑器界面
内容创作工具（如关卡编辑器、动画工具）
可视化工具和数据监控面板
需要快速原型 UI 的 C++ 项目

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++. It outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered anytime in a 3D-pipeline-enabled application. It is designed for fast iterations, empowering programmers to create content creation tools, visualization/debug tools, rather than typical end-user UI.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code, examples, documentation, build configurations (e.g., CMake), and test-related files. Core code is in the root directory (imgui.cpp, imgui.h, etc.), with an examples/ directory providing integration demos for various backends.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies, supporting multiple rendering backends like OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, integrated via backend adapters.
en.hot: With 75k+ stars, it's one of the most popular GUI libraries in the C++ community, favored by game developers and tool builders for its lightweight, efficient, and easy-to-use design. Gaining 32 stars today, it remains highly popular.
uses: Debug tools and editor UIs in game development
Content creation tools (e.g., level editors, animation tools)
Visualization tools and data monitoring dashboards
C++ projects needing rapid UI prototyping

zh.tag: 开源免费的三维参数化建模软件
zh.what: FreeCAD 是一款免费开源的跨平台三维参数化建模软件，主要用于设计真实物体。它支持参数化建模，允许用户通过修改历史参数轻松调整设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 FreeCAD 的完整源代码，包括 GUI、核心模块、Python API 以及文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 OpenCASCADE 几何内核、Coin3D 库、Python 和 Qt。
zh.hot: FreeCAD 持续受到关注，因其免费开源、功能强大且跨平台，适合替代商业 CAD 软件。
uses: 产品设计师、机械工程师和建筑师用于创建和修改三维模型
爱好者、学生和教师用于学习 CAD 和进行个人项目
程序员可利用其 Python API 进行脚本化和二次开发

en.tag: Free and open-source parametric 3D modeler
en.what: FreeCAD is a free and open-source cross-platform parametric 3D modeler primarily for designing real-life objects. It supports parametric modeling, allowing users to easily modify designs by changing parameters in the model history.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of FreeCAD, including GUI, core modules, Python API, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on OpenCASCADE geometry kernel, Coin3D library, Python, and Qt.
en.hot: FreeCAD remains popular due to its free and open-source nature, powerful features, and cross-platform support, making it a viable alternative to commercial CAD software.
uses: Product designers, mechanical engineers, and architects use it to create and modify 3D models
Hobbyists, students, and teachers use it for learning CAD and personal projects
Programmers can leverage its Python API for scripting and customization

zh.tag: ESP32 的 WiFi/蓝牙攻防工具套件
zh.what: ESP32 Marauder 是一套运行在 ESP32 芯片上的 WiFi 和蓝牙攻击与防御工具，提供网络扫描、嗅探、欺骗、干扰等功能。它既可以用于安全测试，也可以用于网络监控和防御，适合渗透测试人员、安全研究者和爱好者。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、预编译的 release 固件、详细的 wiki 文档以及用于构建和测试的 CI 配置。固件通过交互式命令行界面提供多种攻击和监控模式，并支持通过 Web 界面或物理按键进行控制。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 编写，使用 Arduino 框架和 ESP32 SDK，依赖 ESP32 的 WiFi 和蓝牙硬件。支持 PlatformIO 和 Arduino IDE 构建，并包含单元测试框架。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 12k stars，本周新增 116 个，位列 C++ 周榜第 17。其热度源于将复杂的网络攻击工具集成到廉价的 ESP32 硬件上，降低了安全测试的门槛，吸引了大量安全爱好者和硬件玩家。
uses: 渗透测试人员：用于评估 WiFi/蓝牙网络的安全性，测试网络防御能力。
安全研究者：研究无线攻击技术，开发新的防御措施。
硬件爱好者：在 ESP32 上体验黑客工具，学习无线通信原理。
教育场景：作为网络安全课程的教学演示工具。

en.tag: A suite of WiFi/Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools for ESP32
en.what: ESP32 Marauder is a suite of WiFi and Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools for the ESP32, offering network scanning, sniffing, spoofing, jamming, and more. It can be used for security testing or network monitoring and defense, suitable for penetration testers, security researchers, and enthusiasts.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, precompiled release firmware, a detailed wiki, and CI configurations for building and testing. The firmware provides an interactive command-line interface with various attack and monitoring modes, controllable via a web interface or physical buttons.
en.stack: Written in C++, built on the Arduino framework and ESP32 SDK, leveraging ESP32's WiFi and Bluetooth hardware. Supports PlatformIO and Arduino IDE builds, and includes a unit testing framework.
en.hot: With over 12k stars and 116 new stars this week, ranking #17 on the C++ weekly trending list, its popularity stems from integrating complex network attack tools onto cheap ESP32 hardware, lowering the barrier to security testing and attracting security enthusiasts and hardware tinkerers.
uses: Penetration testers: to assess WiFi/Bluetooth network security and test defenses.
Security researchers: to study wireless attack techniques and develop countermeasures.
Hardware enthusiasts: to experiment with hacking tools on ESP32 and learn wireless communication.
Educational settings: as a teaching demo tool for cybersecurity courses.

zh.tag: 自建 VPN 的开源客户端，支持多协议与混淆
zh.what: Amnezia VPN 是一个开源 VPN 客户端，允许用户在自己的服务器上轻松部署 VPN 服务。它支持多种经典协议（如 OpenVPN、WireGuard、IKEv2）以及带流量混淆的协议（如 Cloak、Shadowsocks、AmneziaWG、XRay），并提供分流功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端和移动端的客户端代码，提供安装脚本、文档和界面资源。主要目录包括客户端应用、协议实现、以及用于服务器部署的 Docker 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，跨平台支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS。依赖 Qt 框架、OpenSSL、以及各 VPN 协议库（如 WireGuard、OpenVPN）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1606 星，总星数达 1.4 万+，因其自建 VPN 的易用性和强大的混淆功能而受到关注，尤其适合网络受限地区的用户。
uses: 需要自建 VPN 的个人用户，希望快速部署并连接自己的服务器。
在严格网络环境下需要绕过封锁的用户，利用混淆协议隐藏流量特征。
开发者和技术爱好者，希望定制或贡献 VPN 客户端代码。
企业或组织需要内部安全远程访问，可基于此客户端搭建专属 VPN。

en.tag: Open-source VPN client for self-hosted servers with multi-protocol & obfuscation
en.what: Amnezia VPN is an open-source VPN client that lets users easily deploy VPN servers on their own machines. It supports classic protocols like OpenVPN, WireGuard, IKEv2, and obfuscated protocols such as Cloak, Shadowsocks, AmneziaWG, and XRay, plus split tunneling.
en.content: The repo contains client code for desktop and mobile, with installation scripts, docs, and UI assets. Key directories include client apps, protocol implementations, and Docker configs for server deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, cross-platform for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Uses Qt framework, OpenSSL, and VPN protocol libraries like WireGuard and OpenVPN.
en.hot: Gained 1,606 stars this month, reaching 14k+ total, due to its ease of self-hosting VPN and robust obfuscation features, appealing to users in restricted regions.
uses: Individuals wanting to self-host VPN and quickly deploy on their own servers.
Users in censored networks needing to bypass blocks with obfuscation protocols.
Developers and tinkerers looking to customize or contribute to VPN client code.
Organizations requiring secure remote access, can build custom VPN on this client.

zh.tag: ESP32 多频段无线攻防工具，带触屏 UI
zh.what: ESP32-DIV 是一个基于 ESP32-S3 的开源多频段无线工具包，集成了 Wi-Fi、BLE、2.4GHz、Sub-GHz、红外、RFID/NFC 和 GPS 功能。它提供紧凑的手持设备形态，并配备触屏界面，用于无线流量分析、信号测试和 RF 工具构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的固件源码、硬件设计文件（如 PCB 原理图）、Web 刷机工具（浏览器直接刷写）以及详细的 Wiki 文档，涵盖从 Wi-Fi 去认证攻击到 Sub-GHz 信号重放等功能的教程。
zh.stack: 基于 ESP32-S3 微控制器，使用 C++ 编写固件，依赖 Arduino 框架或 ESP-IDF。支持触屏显示、SD 卡存储、多种无线模块（如 CC1101 用于 Sub-GHz）。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 3768 星，并进入 C++ 日榜前十，因其将多种无线攻击/防御功能集成于一个便携设备，且提供浏览器刷写和详尽 Wiki，吸引了安全研究者和硬件爱好者。
uses: 安全研究人员：用于无线协议分析、渗透测试和漏洞研究（需合法授权）
硬件爱好者：学习 ESP32 开发、射频电路设计和嵌入式 UI 编程
教育用途：在课堂或实验室演示无线通信原理和安全概念

en.tag: ESP32-based multi-band wireless offensive/defensive toolkit with touchscreen UI
en.what: ESP32-DIV is an open-source multi-band wireless toolkit built on the ESP32-S3, covering Wi-Fi, BLE, 2.4GHz, Sub-GHz, IR, RFID/NFC, and GPS. It comes in a compact handheld form factor with a touchscreen UI for wireless traffic analysis, signal resilience testing, and RF tool building.
en.content: The repository includes full firmware source code, hardware design files (e.g., PCB schematics), a web-based flasher (flash directly from browser), and extensive Wiki documentation with tutorials covering features from Wi-Fi deauthentication attacks to Sub-GHz signal replay.
en.stack: Based on the ESP32-S3 microcontroller, firmware written in C++ using Arduino framework or ESP-IDF. Supports touchscreen display, SD card storage, and various wireless modules (e.g., CC1101 for Sub-GHz).
en.hot: With 3768 stars and a spot in the C++ daily trending top 10, this project attracts security researchers and hardware enthusiasts by packing multiple wireless offensive/defensive features into a portable device, plus browser flashing and detailed Wiki.
uses: Security researchers: for wireless protocol analysis, penetration testing, and vulnerability research (with proper authorization)
Hardware enthusiasts: to learn ESP32 development, RF circuit design, and embedded UI programming
Educational use: to demonstrate wireless communication principles and security concepts in classrooms or labs

zh.tag: 极致美观的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器
zh.what: Hyprland 是一个独立、高度可定制、动态平铺的 Wayland 合成器，注重外观而不牺牲功能。它提供最新的 Wayland 特性、丰富的视觉效果（渐变边框、模糊、动画、阴影等）、强大的插件系统、内置插件管理器、撕裂支持（提升游戏性能）等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hyprland 合成器的完整源代码、文档链接、安装指南、配置示例和画廊展示。代码库以 C++ 编写，易于扩展和阅读。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，不依赖 wlroots、libweston、kwin 或 mutter，完全独立实现。依赖 Wayland 协议和相关库。
zh.hot: 凭借出色的视觉效果和高度可定制性，Hyprland 在 Linux 桌面用户中广受欢迎，Star 数达 36,817，今日新增 24，持续活跃开发。
uses: Linux 桌面用户 —— 追求美观、高效、可定制的平铺窗口管理体验
Wayland 爱好者 —— 希望体验最新 Wayland 特性的用户
开发者 —— 对合成器实现感兴趣，或希望为其开发插件的开发者

en.tag: A highly customizable dynamic tiling Wayland compositor with stunning visuals
en.what: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks. It offers the latest Wayland features, extensive eye candy (gradient borders, blur, animations, shadows), a powerful plugin system, built-in plugin manager, tearing support for better gaming performance, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Hyprland compositor, documentation links, installation guides, configuration examples, and a gallery. The codebase is written in C++ and is designed to be easily expandable and readable.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, Hyprland is fully independent and does not rely on wlroots, libweston, kwin, or mutter. It depends on Wayland protocols and related libraries.
en.hot: With its stunning visuals and high customizability, Hyprland has gained immense popularity among Linux desktop users, amassing 36,817 stars (24 new today) and maintaining active development.
uses: Linux desktop users — seeking a beautiful, efficient, and customizable tiling window management experience
Wayland enthusiasts — users wanting to experience the latest Wayland features
Developers — interested in compositor implementation or developing plugins for Hyprland

zh.tag: ESP32 万能协议黑客工具，网页 CLI 控制
zh.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate 是一款开源固件，能将 ESP32 设备变成多协议开发与分析工具，灵感来自传奇的 Bus Pirate。它支持通过串口终端或网页 CLI 嗅探、发送、脚本化并交互各种数字协议（如 I2C、UART、1-Wire、SPI 等），还能与蓝牙、Wi-Fi、Sub-GHz 和 RFID 等无线电协议通信。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、文档、脚本和示例，以及一个集中式网站，提供安装、网页工具、硬件指南、配方和维基。固件支持多种模式，如 HiZ、I2C、SPI、UART、1-Wire、蓝牙、Wi-Fi、JTAG 等。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 编写，面向 ESP32 平台，利用其硬件外设和无线功能。依赖 Arduino 框架或 ESP-IDF，并通过 WebSocket 提供网页 CLI。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本月新增约 1188 颗星，总星数达 5478，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其多功能性和易用性吸引了硬件黑客和嵌入式开发者。
uses: 硬件黑客和安全研究人员，用于协议嗅探、逆向工程和设备调试。
嵌入式开发者和爱好者，用于快速原型设计和与各种传感器/芯片交互。
教育场景，用于学习数字协议和无线电通信。
DIY 项目，作为便携式多协议工具。

en.tag: ESP32 multi-protocol hacking tool with web CLI
en.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate is open-source firmware that turns your ESP32 device into a multi-protocol development and analysis tool, inspired by the legendary Bus Pirate. It supports sniffing, sending, scripting, and interacting with various digital protocols (I2C, UART, 1-Wire, SPI, etc.) via a serial terminal or web-based CLI, and also communicates with radio protocols like Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Sub-GHz, and RFID.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, documentation, scripts, and examples, along with a central website offering installation, web tools, hardware guides, recipes, and a wiki. The firmware supports numerous modes like HiZ, I2C, SPI, UART, 1-Wire, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, JTAG, and more.
en.stack: Written in C++ for the ESP32 platform, leveraging its hardware peripherals and wireless capabilities. It relies on the Arduino framework or ESP-IDF and provides a web CLI via WebSocket.
en.hot: The project has gained rapid popularity on GitHub, adding ~1,188 stars this month to reach 5,478 total, ranking #22 on the C++ monthly trending list. Its versatility and ease of use attract hardware hackers and embedded developers.
uses: Hardware hackers and security researchers for protocol sniffing, reverse engineering, and device debugging.
Embedded developers and hobbyists for rapid prototyping and interacting with various sensors/chips.
Educational settings for learning digital protocols and radio communications.
DIY projects as a portable multi-protocol tool.

zh.tag: Telegram 官方桌面客户端，跨平台消息应用
zh.what: 这是 Telegram 官方桌面客户端的完整源代码，基于 Telegram API 和 MTProto 安全协议构建。它提供了消息收发、语音通话、文件共享等核心功能，并支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、构建说明、多平台安装包（Windows、macOS、Linux）以及旧版本兼容信息。还列出了第三方依赖如 Qt、OpenSSL 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 OpenSSL、WebRTC、zlib 等库，支持 CMake 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Telegram 官方桌面客户端，拥有 3.2 万星标，持续维护，是跨平台消息应用的重要参考实现。
uses: 开发者可学习大型 C++ 跨平台应用的架构与构建流程。
用户可下载官方客户端，享受安全、快速的即时通讯服务。
对 MTProto 协议感兴趣的开发者可研究其实现细节。

en.tag: Official Telegram desktop client, cross-platform messaging app
en.what: This is the complete source code of the official Telegram desktop client, built on the Telegram API and MTProto secure protocol. It offers messaging, voice calls, file sharing, and more, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.content: The repo contains full source code, build instructions, multi-platform installers (Windows, macOS, Linux), and legacy version compatibility info. Third-party dependencies like Qt and OpenSSL are listed.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework, depends on OpenSSL, WebRTC, zlib, and others, built with CMake.
en.hot: As the official Telegram desktop client, it has 32k+ stars, actively maintained, and serves as a key reference for cross-platform messaging apps.
uses: Developers can learn architecture and build process of large-scale C++ cross-platform apps.
Users can download the official client for secure and fast instant messaging.
Developers interested in MTProto protocol can study its implementation details.

zh.tag: 将PS2游戏静态重编译为原生PC移植版
zh.what: PS2Recomp 是一个实验性的静态重编译器，能将 PlayStation 2 的 ELF 二进制文件转换为 C++ 代码，并提供运行时环境来执行生成的代码，从而无需模拟器即可在 PC 上原生运行 PS2 游戏。它通过解析 MIPS R5900 指令并逐条翻译为 C++ 操作，实现高度忠实的移植。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个模块：ps2xAnalyzer 用于扫描 ELF 并生成 TOML 配置，ps2xRecomp 负责解码指令并生成 C++ 代码，ps2xRuntime 提供内存、函数注册和系统调用处理，ps2xIOP 实现 IOP HLE 服务。还包含 Ghidra 脚本用于导出函数信息。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++20，依赖 CMake 3.20+，支持 MSVC 等编译器，部分向量路径需要 SSE4/AVX 支持。
zh.hot: 该工具为 PS2 游戏移植提供了全新思路，静态重编译相比模拟器性能更高，吸引了大量对复古游戏移植感兴趣的开发者。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但累计 3190 星表明社区关注度持续。
uses: 希望将 PS2 游戏原生移植到 PC 的开发者，可借助此工具生成 C++ 代码。
对静态重编译技术感兴趣的逆向工程爱好者，可研究其指令翻译和运行时设计。
游戏模组社区，可通过重编译实现更深入的修改和优化。

en.tag: Static recompiler to turn PS2 games into native PC ports
en.what: PS2Recomp is an experimental static recompiler that converts PlayStation 2 ELF binaries into C++ code and provides a runtime to execute the generated code, enabling native PC ports without an emulator. It works by parsing MIPS R5900 instructions and translating each to C++ operations, achieving high-fidelity ports.
en.content: The repository contains several modules: ps2xAnalyzer scans ELFs and writes TOML configs, ps2xRecomp decodes instructions and generates C++ code, ps2xRuntime provides memory, function registration, and syscall handling, and ps2xIOP implements IOP HLE services. It also includes a Ghidra script for exporting function info.
en.stack: Primarily C++20, requires CMake 3.20+, tested mainly with MSVC, and needs SSE4/AVX for some vector paths.
en.hot: This tool offers a fresh approach to PS2 game porting, with static recompilation offering higher performance than emulation, attracting developers interested in retro game ports. Despite modest daily stars, the cumulative 3190 stars indicate sustained community interest.
uses: Developers aiming to create native PC ports of PS2 games, using this tool to generate C++ code.
Reverse engineering enthusiasts interested in static recompilation, studying its instruction translation and runtime design.
Game modding communities, enabling deeper modifications and optimizations through recompilation.

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 低延迟远程游戏
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个开源的、自托管的游戏串流服务端，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将 PC 上的游戏画面和音频实时传输到其他设备，实现远程游戏体验。支持多种操作系统和硬件，提供低延迟、高画质的串流服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、Dockerfile、文档和配置示例。主要组件包括串流核心、Web 管理界面、编码器支持（如 NVENC、AMF、VAAPI）以及输入捕获模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 FFmpeg、Boost、OpenSSL 等库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，并提供 Docker 镜像和 Flatpak 包。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 40k 星标，今日新增 37 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 15。作为开源替代 NVIDIA GameStream 的方案，它持续活跃并受到远程游戏玩家的青睐。
uses: 游戏玩家：在局域网或互联网上串流 PC 游戏到手机、平板、笔记本等设备
家庭用户：将主机游戏画面传输到客厅电视或其他房间的屏幕
开发者：学习或扩展游戏串流技术，集成到自己的应用中

en.tag: Self-hosted game stream host for Moonlight, enabling low-latency remote play
en.what: Sunshine is an open-source, self-hosted game streaming server compatible with Moonlight clients. It enables real-time transmission of PC game video and audio to other devices for remote play. It supports multiple OSes and hardware, offering low-latency, high-quality streaming.
