en.content: The repo contains full C++ source code, build scripts, Dockerfiles, documentation, and configuration examples. Key components include the streaming core, web UI, encoder support (NVENC, AMF, VAAPI), and input capture modules.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on FFmpeg, Boost, OpenSSL, etc. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, with Docker images and Flatpak packages.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 37 new today, it ranks #15 on the C++ trending list. As an open-source alternative to NVIDIA GameStream, it remains actively maintained and popular among remote gamers.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to phones, tablets, laptops over LAN or internet
Home users: transmit console game visuals to living room TV or other screens
Developers: learn or extend game streaming tech, integrate into own apps

zh.tag: 统一加载40+种3D格式的开源资产导入库
zh.what: Assimp（Open Asset Import Library）是一个C++库，用于将多种3D文件格式（如OBJ、FBX、glTF等）导入为统一的内存数据格式。它支持超过40种格式的导入，并提供网格后处理工具，如法线生成、三角化等。
zh.content: 仓库包含库的源代码、CMake构建配置、测试数据（通过子模块）以及文档。主要目录包括code（核心库）、test（测试）、contrib（第三方依赖）和doc（文档）。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++编写，依赖CMake构建系统，支持C和C++ API，并有多种语言绑定（如C#、Java、Python）。
zh.hot: 作为3D资产导入的事实标准，Assimp在游戏开发和3D工具链中广泛使用，Star数达1.3万，今日新增5个，持续活跃。
uses: 游戏引擎开发者：需要导入多种3D格式的模型文件，统一处理网格数据。
3D工具链开发者：构建转换工具或查看器，利用Assimp的格式支持和后处理功能。
科研与教育：在计算机图形学课程或研究中，作为3D模型加载的参考实现。

en.tag: Open-source library to load 40+ 3D file formats into a unified structure
en.what: Assimp (Open Asset Import Library) is a C++ library that loads various 3D file formats (like OBJ, FBX, glTF) into a unified in-memory format. It supports import of 40+ formats and provides mesh post-processing tools like normal generation and triangulation.
en.content: The repository contains the library's source code, CMake build configuration, test data (via submodule), and documentation. Key directories include code (core library), test, contrib (third-party dependencies), and doc.
en.stack: Written in C++, built with CMake, provides C and C++ APIs, with bindings for other languages like C#, Java, and Python.
en.hot: As a de facto standard for 3D asset import, Assimp is widely used in game development and 3D toolchains, with 13k stars and steady activity.
uses: Game engine developers: need to import various 3D model formats and handle mesh data uniformly.
3D toolchain developers: build converters or viewers leveraging Assimp's format support and post-processing.
Researchers and educators: use as a reference implementation for 3D model loading in graphics courses or research.

zh.tag: 高度可定制的 Wayland 状态栏，专为 Sway 等合成器打造
zh.what: Waybar 是一个为 Wayland 合成器（如 Sway、Hyprland）设计的轻量级状态栏，支持高度定制。它通过模块化方式展示系统信息，如电池、网络、音频等，并允许用户自定义样式和布局。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源码、配置示例、样式文档和 Wiki 链接，支持多种合成器集成和丰富的模块（电源、网络、音频等）。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖 GTK3、Wayland 协议和 wlroots 库，使用 Meson 构建系统。
zh.hot: Waybar 是 Wayland 生态中最流行的状态栏之一，拥有 1.1 万星标，持续活跃更新，深受 Linux 桌面定制爱好者喜爱。
uses: Sway 或 Hyprland 用户想要一个美观且功能丰富的状态栏
Linux 桌面定制爱好者希望深度个性化系统界面
开发者需要可编程的状态栏模块来展示自定义信息

en.tag: Highly customizable Wayland status bar for Sway and wlroots compositors
en.what: Waybar is a lightweight status bar for Wayland compositors like Sway and Hyprland, offering extensive customization. It displays system info via modular components (battery, network, audio, etc.) and allows users to style and arrange them freely.
en.content: The repo includes C++ source code, configuration examples, styling docs, and Wiki links, with support for multiple compositors and a rich set of modules (power, network, audio, etc.).
en.stack: Built with C++, depends on GTK3, Wayland protocols, and wlroots, using Meson as the build system.
en.hot: Waybar is one of the most popular status bars in the Wayland ecosystem, with 11.8k stars and active updates, beloved by Linux desktop customization enthusiasts.
uses: Sway or Hyprland users seeking a beautiful and feature-rich status bar
Linux desktop customization enthusiasts who want deep personalization
Developers needing programmable modules to display custom info

zh.tag: 开源 PS3 模拟器与调试器，跨平台运行 PS3 游戏
zh.what: RPCS3 是世界上第一个免费开源的 PlayStation 3 模拟器/调试器，用 C++ 编写，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它允许用户在 PC 上运行 PS3 游戏，并提供调试功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码、构建指南（BUILDING.md）、快速入门文档、Wiki 链接以及贡献指南。还包含 GitHub Actions 工作流和 Discord 社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖图形驱动和 Visual C++ 运行库。构建系统支持多种平台，具体见 BUILDING.md。
zh.hot: 作为 PS3 模拟器的先驱，持续吸引大量关注。今日新增 12 星，总星数 19530，在 C++ 日榜排名第 18，表明其稳定的人气和社区活跃度。
uses: 游戏玩家：在 PC 上体验 PS3 独占游戏，无需购买主机
开发者：研究 PS3 硬件模拟和调试技术，参与开源贡献
怀旧爱好者：重温经典 PS3 游戏，保存游戏历史

en.tag: Open-source PS3 emulator and debugger for Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD
en.what: RPCS3 is the world's first free and open-source PlayStation 3 emulator/debugger, written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. It allows users to run PS3 games on PC and provides debugging capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build instructions (BUILDING.md), quickstart documentation, Wiki links, and contribution guidelines. It also includes GitHub Actions workflows and Discord community links.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on graphics drivers and Visual C++ Redistributable. Build system supports multiple platforms, see BUILDING.md.
en.hot: As a pioneer PS3 emulator, it consistently attracts attention. With 12 stars today and 19,530 total, ranking #18 on the C++ daily list, it shows stable popularity and community activity.
uses: Gamers: Experience PS3 exclusive titles on PC without owning a console
Developers: Study PS3 hardware emulation and debugging, contribute to open source
Retro enthusiasts: Relive classic PS3 games and preserve gaming history

zh.tag: Source引擎2013版官方源码，含半条命2与TF2游戏代码
zh.what: 这是Valve发布的Source引擎2013版SDK源码，包含半条命2、半条命2：死亡竞赛和军团要塞2的游戏代码。开发者可以用它来构建自己的模组，并支持在Steam上分发。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的游戏代码、构建脚本（Windows批处理和Linux shell脚本）、Visual Studio解决方案生成工具，以及用于模组分发的文档和许可证。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++编写，依赖Visual Studio 2022（Windows）或podman（Linux）以及Steam上的Source SDK 2013 Multiplayer。
zh.hot: 作为Valve官方仓库，拥有近万星标，今日新增5星，位列C++日榜第19名。其热度源于经典游戏源码的开放，吸引模组开发者与游戏爱好者。
uses: 模组开发者：基于Source引擎创建自定义游戏或地图，利用官方代码基础。
游戏学习者：研究半条命2和TF2的代码结构，理解商业游戏引擎的实现。
怀旧玩家：通过源码构建经典游戏，体验或修改原版内容。

en.tag: Official Source SDK 2013 source code with HL2, HL2:DM, and TF2 game code
en.what: This is the official Source SDK 2013 source code from Valve, including game code for Half-Life 2, HL2: DM, and Team Fortress 2. Developers can use it to build their own mods and distribute them on Steam.
en.content: The repository contains full game code, build scripts (Windows batch and Linux shell), Visual Studio solution generation tools, and documentation and license for mod distribution.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, requires Visual Studio 2022 (Windows) or podman (Linux) and Source SDK 2013 Multiplayer from Steam.
en.hot: As an official Valve repository with nearly 10k stars, it gained 5 stars today and ranks 19th on the C++ daily trending. Its popularity stems from open-sourcing classic game code, attracting modders and game enthusiasts.
uses: Mod developers: Create custom games or maps based on the Source engine using official codebase.
Game learners: Study the code structure of Half-Life 2 and TF2 to understand commercial game engine implementation.
Nostalgic players: Build classic games from source to experience or modify original content.

zh.tag: 原生 Wayland 桌面外壳，一体化可定制 Linux 桌面
zh.what: Noctalia 是一个原生 Wayland 桌面外壳，提供统一的桌面层，包括任务栏、启动器、通知、锁屏、壁纸等组件，无需拼接多个独立工具。它直接构建在 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES 之上，无 Qt/GTK 依赖，设计为单一内聚的外壳。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Noctalia v5（Beta）的源代码、文档、安装指南和配置示例，以及多显示器支持、桌面小部件、剪贴板历史等功能。项目结构围绕核心外壳、渲染、配置和 IPC 模块组织。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES，无 Qt/GTK 依赖。构建系统可能使用 CMake 或 Meson，具体见仓库。
zh.hot: 凭借 9769 颗星和今日新增 37 颗星，它吸引了追求精致、可配置 Linux 桌面且厌倦碎片化工具链的用户。其一体化设计和原生 Wayland 实现是热门亮点。
uses: Linux 爱好者：希望获得开箱即用的美观桌面，无需手动配置多个组件。
Wayland 用户：需要原生支持 Wayland 且无 Qt/GTK 依赖的桌面外壳。
定制者：喜欢深度自定义桌面外观和行为的用户。
开发者：对 Wayland 合成器或桌面环境开发感兴趣的人。

en.tag: Native Wayland desktop shell for a polished, configurable Linux desktop
en.what: Noctalia is a native Wayland desktop shell that provides a unified desktop layer including bars, launcher, notifications, lock screen, wallpaper, and more, eliminating the need to stitch together separate tools. Built directly on Wayland and OpenGL ES with no Qt/GTK dependency, it is designed as one cohesive shell.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for Noctalia v5 (Beta), documentation, installation guides, and configuration examples, along with features like multi-monitor support, desktop widgets, and clipboard history. The project is organized around core shell, rendering, configuration, and IPC modules.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it relies on Wayland and OpenGL ES with no Qt/GTK dependencies. The build system may use CMake or Meson, as detailed in the repository.
en.hot: With 9,769 stars and 37 added today, it attracts users seeking a polished, configurable Linux desktop without fragmented toolchains. Its all-in-one design and native Wayland implementation are key highlights.
uses: Linux enthusiasts who want a beautiful desktop out of the box without manually configuring multiple components.
Wayland users needing a native Wayland desktop shell without Qt/GTK dependencies.
Customizers who enjoy deeply customizing their desktop appearance and behavior.
Developers interested in Wayland compositors or desktop environment development.

zh.tag: 实验性 PlayStation Vita 模拟器，跨平台运行
zh.what: Vita3K 是一个实验性的 PlayStation Vita 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Android 平台。它能够运行大部分自制软件和商业游戏，为玩家提供在 PC 或移动设备上体验 Vita 游戏的机会。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器源代码、构建配置、文档、截图以及兼容性列表。项目采用 C++ 编写，并依赖 Unicorn 等外部库，提供持续构建的下载链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Unicorn 模拟框架，支持 CMake 构建，并集成 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为少数能运行商业游戏的 Vita 模拟器，Vita3K 持续吸引玩家和开发者关注，目前 Star 数已超 5600，今日新增 6 个，在 C++ 趋势榜上位列第 21。
uses: 游戏玩家：在 PC 或 Android 设备上体验 PlayStation Vita 独占游戏，如《女神异闻录4 黄金版》。
模拟器开发者：研究 Vita 硬件架构和模拟技术，参与开源贡献。
游戏测试人员：利用兼容性列表评估游戏运行效果，反馈问题。
怀旧爱好者：重温 Vita 平台经典作品，无需原版硬件。

en.tag: Experimental PlayStation Vita emulator for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android
en.what: Vita3K is an experimental PlayStation Vita emulator supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android. It can run most homebrew programs and commercial games, allowing players to experience Vita titles on PC or mobile devices.
en.content: The repository contains the emulator's source code, build configurations, documentation, screenshots, and compatibility lists. The project is written in C++ and relies on external libraries like Unicorn, with continuous build downloads available.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, utilizing the Unicorn emulation framework, with CMake build support and GitHub Actions for continuous integration.
en.hot: As one of the few Vita emulators capable of running commercial games, Vita3K consistently attracts attention from gamers and developers, with over 5.6k stars and 6 new stars today, ranking 21st on the C++ trending list.
uses: Gamers: Experience PlayStation Vita exclusive titles like Persona 4 Golden on PC or Android devices.
Emulator developers: Research Vita hardware architecture and emulation techniques, contribute to open source.
Game testers: Evaluate game compatibility using the compatibility lists and report issues.
Retro enthusiasts: Revisit classic Vita games without original hardware.

zh.tag: 跨平台 PSP 模拟器，无需 BIOS，兼容性与速度俱佳
zh.what: PPSSPP 是一款用 C++ 编写的高性能 PSP 模拟器，支持 Android、Windows、Mac、Linux 和 iOS。它采用 HLE 模拟方式，无需 BIOS 文件即可运行游戏，默认设置兼顾兼容性和速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码、构建脚本、文档和开发指南。最新版本 1.20.4 带来了大量 UI 改进、纹理放大优化、渲染修复以及多人游戏相关功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 OpenGL/Vulkan 等图形 API，支持多种平台。项目使用 CMake 构建，并包含针对各平台的特定代码。
zh.hot: 拥有 14k+ Star，持续活跃更新，新版本带来大量改进，吸引 PSP 游戏爱好者与模拟器开发者关注。
uses: 在 PC 或手机上重温 PSP 经典游戏，无需实体主机。
开发者可学习模拟器实现，参与贡献或研究 HLE 架构。
测试人员可帮助反馈游戏兼容性问题，提升模拟器质量。

en.tag: Fast and portable PSP emulator for multiple platforms, no BIOS required
en.what: PPSSPP is a high-performance PSP emulator written in C++, supporting Android, Windows, Mac, Linux, and iOS. It uses HLE emulation, requiring no BIOS file, with default settings balancing compatibility and speed.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build scripts, documentation, and development guides. The latest release 1.20.4 brings numerous UI improvements, texture upscaling optimizations, rendering fixes, and multiplayer-related features.
en.stack: Primarily C++, leveraging graphics APIs like OpenGL/Vulkan, with platform-specific code. Build system uses CMake.
en.hot: With 14k+ stars and continuous active updates, the new release brings many improvements, attracting PSP gaming enthusiasts and emulator developers.
uses: Relive classic PSP games on PC or mobile without the original hardware.
Developers can learn emulator implementation and contribute to the HLE architecture.
Testers can help report game compatibility issues to improve the emulator.

zh.tag: 开源魔兽世界3.3.5a模拟器，模块化MMO服务端框架
zh.what: AzerothCore 是一个开源的 MMORPG 游戏服务器应用程序和框架，基于魔兽世界 3.3.5a 版本，旨在重现原版游戏体验。它由社区驱动，提供高度模块化的架构，允许开发者自由扩展和定制游戏内容。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端核心代码、模块系统、构建脚本（支持 Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker）、以及配套工具和仪表盘。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 MaNGOS、TrinityCore 和 SunwellCore 的代码基础，并集成 CMake 构建系统、GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 拥有 8815 颗星，长期活跃的社区和持续更新，是魔兽世界私服领域最受欢迎的开源项目之一。
uses: 游戏开发者：研究大型 MMORPG 服务端架构和游戏机制实现。
私服运营者：搭建稳定的魔兽世界 3.3.5a 私服，提供玩家服务。
C++ 学习者：通过阅读和修改大型 C++ 项目提升编程能力。
模组作者：利用模块系统开发自定义游戏内容和功能。

en.tag: Open-source WoW 3.3.5a emulator, modular MMO server framework
en.what: AzerothCore is an open-source MMORPG game server application and framework based on World of Warcraft patch 3.3.5a, aiming to recreate the original gameplay experience. It is community-driven and offers a highly modular architecture, allowing developers to freely extend and customize game content.
en.content: The repository contains the full server core code, a modular system, build scripts (for Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker), and accompanying tools and dashboard.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, based on code from MaNGOS, TrinityCore, and SunwellCore, with CMake build system and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With 8815 stars, it is one of the most popular open-source projects in the WoW private server community, thanks to its active community and continuous updates.
uses: Game developers: study large-scale MMORPG server architecture and game mechanics implementation.
Private server operators: set up stable WoW 3.3.5a servers for players.
C++ learners: improve programming skills by reading and modifying a large C++ project.
Modders: use the modular system to develop custom game content and features.

zh.tag: 跨平台 GUI 代理工具，基于 sing-box 内核
zh.what: Throne 是一款基于 Qt 的跨平台桌面 GUI 代理工具，由 sing-box 驱动，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。它继承了已归档的 Nekoray 项目，并进行了大量改进和新功能添加。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源代码、安装脚本、RPM 仓库配置以及文档。支持多种代理协议，如 Shadowsocks、VMess、VLESS、Hysteria 等，并支持多种订阅格式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 sing-box 和 Xray-core 作为核心，还使用了 simple-protobuf、fkYAML、quirc 等库。
zh.hot: 作为 Nekoray 的继任者，Throne 在 GitHub 上获得 6871 颗星，今日新增 20 颗，位列 C++ 日榜第 24 名，因其强大的功能和活跃的维护而受到关注。
uses: 需要跨平台代理客户端的用户，尤其是从 Nekoray 迁移的用户。
希望使用 sing-box 或 Xray 内核，并需要图形界面的高级用户。
对代理协议支持广泛，需要订阅管理功能的用户。

en.tag: Cross-platform GUI proxy utility powered by sing-box
en.what: Throne is a Qt-based cross-platform desktop GUI proxy utility powered by sing-box, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It continues the archived Nekoray project with many improvements and new features.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop application source code, installation scripts, RPM repository configuration, and documentation. It supports a wide range of proxy protocols like Shadowsocks, VMess, VLESS, Hysteria, and various subscription formats.
en.stack: Primarily uses C++ and Qt framework, relies on sing-box and Xray-core as cores, and uses libraries like simple-protobuf, fkYAML, quirc, etc.
en.hot: As the successor to Nekoray, Throne has gained 6871 stars on GitHub, with 20 new stars today, ranking 24th on the C++ daily trending list, drawing attention for its powerful features and active maintenance.
uses: Users needing a cross-platform proxy client, especially those migrating from Nekoray.
Advanced users who want a GUI for sing-box or Xray cores.
Users requiring extensive protocol support and subscription management.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 一键生成高清短视频的AI自动化工具
zh.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据用户提供的主题或关键词，自动生成视频脚本、匹配素材、生成字幕和背景音乐，并合成高清短视频的一站式工具。用户只需输入一个主题或关键词，即可获得完整的短视频成品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 源代码、WebUI 界面、API 接口、文档和示例，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。提供 WebUI 和 API 两种交互方式，方便用户通过图形界面或程序化调用生成视频。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，依赖 AI 大模型（如 Kimi K3）进行文案生成和素材匹配，使用自动化工作流整合视频合成、字幕和背景音乐生成。
zh.hot: 凭借 10 万+ Star 和今日新增 470 星，它成为 GitHub Python 趋势榜第 13 名，因其极大降低了短视频创作门槛，让任何人都能快速生成专业级视频，满足了内容创作者和营销人员的强烈需求。
uses: 内容创作者：快速生成短视频素材，提升内容产出效率。
营销人员：根据产品关键词自动生成宣传视频，用于社交媒体推广。
教育工作者：将知识点转化为生动的视频讲解，辅助教学。
开发者：通过 API 集成到自己的应用或工作流中，实现自动化视频生成。

en.tag: One-click AI tool to auto-generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword
en.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an all-in-one AI tool that leverages large language models and automated workflows to generate HD short videos from a user-provided topic or keyword. It automatically creates the script, matches stock footage, generates subtitles and background music, and composes the final video.
en.content: The repository contains full Python source code, a WebUI, API endpoints, documentation, and examples, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers both a graphical WebUI and an API for programmatic video generation.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, it relies on AI LLMs (e.g., Kimi K3) for script writing and material matching, and uses automated workflows to integrate video composition, subtitles, and background music generation.
en.hot: With over 100k stars and 470 new stars today, it ranks #13 on GitHub Trending (Python). Its popularity stems from dramatically lowering the barrier to short-video creation, enabling anyone to quickly produce professional-looking videos, meeting the strong demand from content creators and marketers.
uses: Content creators: Quickly generate short video material to boost output efficiency.
Marketers: Auto-generate promotional videos from product keywords for social media campaigns.
Educators: Turn knowledge points into engaging video explanations to aid teaching.
Developers: Integrate via API into their own apps or workflows for automated video generation.

zh.tag: 时空组合性的元框架，重新定义编程范式
zh.what: Cordis 是一个用于时空组合性的元框架，旨在提供一种新的编程范式，使开发者能够以时间和空间维度组合代码模块。它目前处于积极开发阶段，API 尚不稳定，但已发布相关论文和文档。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cordis 框架的源代码、论文链接（A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability）以及文档（cordis-primer）。主要组成部分是 TypeScript 编写的核心框架。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖可能包括用于构建和测试的常见工具，但具体依赖未在摘要中列出。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3364 星，总星数达 7190，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜第五。其创新的编程范式概念和活跃的开发状态吸引了大量关注。
uses: 对编程语言设计和系统架构感兴趣的开发者，可探索新的组合性范式。
研究时空数据或分布式系统的学者，可参考其论文和实现。
希望尝试前沿框架的早期采用者，但需注意 API 不稳定。

en.tag: Meta-framework for spatiotemporal composability, redefining programming paradigm
en.what: Cordis is a meta-framework for spatiotemporal composability, aiming to provide a new programming paradigm that allows developers to compose code modules across time and space dimensions. It is under active development with an unstable API, but a paper and documentation are available.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of the Cordis framework, links to the paper (A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability), and documentation (cordis-primer). The main component is the core framework written in TypeScript.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, with dependencies likely including common build and test tools, though specific dependencies are not listed in the summary.
en.hot: Gained 3364 stars this week, reaching 7190 total, ranking 5th on GitHub Trending weekly. Its innovative programming paradigm concept and active development status attract significant attention.
uses: Developers interested in programming language design and system architecture, exploring new composability paradigms.
Researchers studying spatiotemporal data or distributed systems, referencing the paper and implementation.
Early adopters willing to try cutting-edge frameworks, but note the API is unstable.

zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。
研究与教育：用于探索代理上下文管理的新范式。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: OpenViking has quickly gained traction on GitHub with 28,893 stars and 239 new stars today, ranking #9 on the Python trending list. Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: 免费公共 API 大全，开发者资源宝库
zh.what: 这是一个由社区维护的免费公共 API 集合，涵盖动物、动漫、反恶意软件、艺术与设计、认证与授权、区块链、书籍、商业、日历、云存储与文件等众多领域。它为开发者提供了丰富的 API 资源，方便他们快速查找和集成到自己的项目中。
zh.content: 仓库以 README 为主，按类别列出所有 API，每个 API 包含名称、描述、认证方式、是否支持 HTTPS 和 CORS 等信息。此外，还包含贡献指南和 API 提交要求。
zh.stack: 仓库本身是纯文档，主要使用 Markdown 编写。主语言标记为 Python，但实际内容不涉及代码。
zh.hot: 该仓库拥有超过 46 万 star，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的资源列表之一。今日新增 2260 star，持续受到开发者关注，因为它提供了免费 API 的集中索引，节省了开发者搜索和筛选的时间。
uses: 开发者寻找免费 API 用于个人项目或原型开发
技术爱好者探索不同领域的 API，学习集成方法
产品经理或创业者调研可用的 API 服务，评估可行性
教育场景中作为教学资源，帮助学生了解 API 生态

en.tag: A curated list of free public APIs for developers
en.what: This is a community-maintained collection of free public APIs, covering a wide range of categories such as Animals, Anime, Anti-Malware, Art & Design, Authentication & Authorization, Blockchain, Books, Business, Calendar, Cloud Storage & File, and more. It provides developers with a rich resource of APIs to quickly find and integrate into their projects.
en.content: The repository is primarily a README that lists all APIs by category, with each API including name, description, auth, HTTPS, and CORS. It also includes contribution guidelines and API submission requirements.
en.stack: The repository is documentation-only, written in Markdown. The primary language is marked as Python, but there is no actual code.
en.hot: With over 460k stars, this is one of the most popular resource lists on GitHub. Today it gained 2260 stars, remaining a go-to for developers as it provides a centralized index of free APIs, saving time on searching and filtering.
uses: Developers looking for free APIs for personal projects or prototyping
Tech enthusiasts exploring APIs across domains to learn integration
Product managers or entrepreneurs researching available API services for feasibility

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存
zh.what: oMLX 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，提供连续批处理和分层 KV 缓存，将热数据保存在内存、冷数据存储在 SSD，并支持跨请求复用缓存。用户可通过 macOS 菜单栏直接管理模型、切换上下文长度，并监控性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用（.dmg 安装包）、Homebrew 安装支持、CLI 工具（~/.omlx/bin/omlx）以及可选的 MCP 支持。还提供多语言 README（中/英/韩/日）和基准测试页面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。
zh.hot: 针对 Mac 用户痛点：在便利性和控制力之间取得平衡，通过菜单栏管理 LLM 服务器，并利用 SSD 缓存实现长上下文复用，适合本地 AI 开发。Star 数近 1.9 万，今日新增 78，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文
开发者使用 Claude Code 等工具进行真实编码，需要跨请求缓存以提升效率
需要灵活控制内存和 SSD 缓存、自动切换模型的高级用户
通过 Homebrew 或 CLI 集成到自动化工作流（如 Apple Shortcuts）

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally and manage models/context from the menu bar
Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency
Power users who need flexible control over memory/SSD caching and auto-swapping models
Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供长期记忆，跨工具无缝交接
zh.what: ai-memory 是一个 Rust 编写的解决方案，为 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编码代理提供长期记忆。它能在你中途退出一个代理后，用另一个代理在相同目录继续工作，无需重新解释架构、失败尝试或未决问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档（如 macOS 和 Windows 指南）、Docker 镜像发布配置，以及支持矩阵。提供原生二进制和安装脚本，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows（WSL2 和实验性原生）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 1.95+，通过 MCP（Model Context Protocol）与代理集成，并利用生命周期钩子（lifecycle hooks）捕获会话信息。支持多种代理的配置格式。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，跨工具切换的痛点日益凸显。该项目精准解决了长期记忆缺失的问题，上线不久即获 3597 星，今日新增 332 星，位列日榜第 7。
uses: 频繁切换 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code 和 Codex）的开发者，希望保留上下文
团队协作中需要交接编码任务，确保新代理快速了解项目状态
使用 Linux/macOS 或 WSL2 环境，追求高效编码工作流的开发者

en.tag: Long-term memory for AI coding agents, enabling seamless handoff across tools
en.what: ai-memory is a Rust-based solution that provides long-term memory for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It lets you quit one agent mid-task and start another in the same directory, continuing without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, or open questions.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, documentation (e.g., macOS and Windows guides), Docker image release config, and a support matrix. It provides native binaries and install scripts for Linux, macOS, and Windows (WSL2 and experimental native).
en.stack: Primarily Rust 1.95+, integrates with agents via MCP (Model Context Protocol) and lifecycle hooks to capture session info. Supports configuration formats for multiple agents.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, the pain point of switching between tools becomes prominent. This project precisely addresses the lack of long-term memory, gaining 3597 stars shortly after launch, with 332 stars today, ranking 7th on the daily trend.
uses: Developers who frequently switch between AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code and Codex) and want to retain context
Teams that need to hand off coding tasks, ensuring new agents quickly understand project state
Developers on Linux/macOS or WSL2 seeking efficient coding workflows

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与精选插件集
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方发布的插件仓库，包含插件规范（manifest 格式）和一系列官方/第三方插件，覆盖代码审查、文档可视化、CLI 设计、Gmail/Drive 集成等场景。每个插件独立成目录，通过 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 声明。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件一个文件夹，如 continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、pr-review-canvas、orchestrate 等，另有 third_party 目录存放 Gmail、Google Drive 等第三方集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Cursor SDK（@cursor/sdk），插件通过 plugin.json 清单定义，可能涉及 MCP、CLI 工具等。
zh.hot: Cursor 作为 AI 编辑器热度极高，官方插件仓库是生态扩展的关键入口，今日新增 27 星，总星数 2645，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 7 名，开发者关注如何用插件增强 AI 代理工作流。
uses: Cursor 用户：安装官方插件提升代码审查、文档浏览等效率
插件开发者：参考规范与示例创建自己的 Cursor 插件
团队协作：利用 Team Kit、Orchestrate 等插件优化 CI/CD 和并行任务处理

en.tag: Official Cursor plugin spec and curated plugins
en.what: This is the official Cursor plugin repository, containing the plugin specification (manifest format) and a collection of first-party and third-party plugins for code review, docs visualization, CLI design, Gmail/Drive integration, and more. Each plugin lives in its own directory with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest.

en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the Cursor SDK (@cursor/sdk), plugins defined via plugin.json manifests, may involve MCP, CLI tools, etc.
en.hot: Cursor is a hot AI editor, and this official plugin repo is a key entry point for ecosystem expansion. With +27 stars today and 2,645 total, it ranks #7 on the TypeScript daily trending list, drawing developers interested in enhancing AI agent workflows via plugins.

Plugin developers: reference the spec and examples to create your own plugins
Teams: leverage Team Kit, Orchestrate, etc. to streamline CI/CD and parallel task handling

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源图原生上下文与决策基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它能够摄取企业数据，提取关键信息，构建上下文图与知识图谱，并支持图分析和因果推理，同时内置完整的决策溯源。该系统强调可解释、可追踪和可信赖，专为高风险和受监管领域设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档和示例，支持多语言图存储（RDF 和 LPG），遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理和知识建模功能。项目采用模块化设计，便于自托管和审计。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python（3.8+），依赖图数据库和知识图谱技术，支持 RDF 和 LPG 存储，遵循 W3C 标准。可能涉及因果推理和决策智能相关库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1102 星，总星数达 3323，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 13 名。其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，填补了企业级上下文管理和决策溯源的需求，在 AI 信任与合规领域引发关注。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统构建可解释、可审计的上下文管理平台。
受监管行业（金融、医疗）：要求决策可追溯、符合合规要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用图原生基础设施进行知识建模和因果推理。
AI 研究者：探索上下文感知和可问责 AI 系统的实现。

en.tag: Open-source graph-native infrastructure for context and accountable AI systems
en.what: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds a Context Graph and knowledge graph, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning with full decision provenance. It is explainable, traceable, and trustworthy by design, built for high-stakes, regulated domains.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, CLI tools, documentation, and examples. It supports polyglot graph storage (RDF and LPG), adheres to W3C standards, and offers ontology management and knowledge modeling. The project is modular, self-hostable, and auditable.
en.stack: Primarily Python (3.8+), leveraging graph database and knowledge graph technologies, supporting RDF and LPG storage, and adhering to W3C standards. It likely incorporates libraries for causal reasoning and decision intelligence.
en.hot: Gained 1,102 stars this week, reaching 3,323 total, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending (Python) weekly. Positioned as 'The Open Source Palantir for AI Agents', it addresses enterprise context management and decision provenance, sparking interest in AI trust and compliance.
uses: Enterprise AI teams: needing an explainable, auditable context management platform for agent systems.
Regulated industries (finance, healthcare): requiring traceable decisions and compliance.
Knowledge graph developers: leveraging graph-native infrastructure for knowledge modeling and causal reasoning.
AI researchers: exploring implementations of context-aware and accountable AI systems.

zh.tag: 腾讯开源的 AI 红队全栈安全平台
zh.what: A.I.G 是一个由腾讯朱雀实验室开发的全栈 AI 红队平台，用于保护 AI 生态系统。它通过代理扫描、技能扫描、MCP 扫描、AI 基础设施扫描和 LLM 越狱评估，全面检测和缓解 AI 系统中的安全漏洞。
zh.content: 仓库包含平台的核心代码、文档、多语言 README（中英日西德法等），以及 Docker 镜像和 ClawHub 集成（如 EdgeOne ClawScan、Skill Scanner）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，提供 Docker 部署方式，并集成 ClawHub 和 EdgeOne 等云服务。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 安全需求激增，该平台在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获 4957 星，今日新增 50 星，并登上日榜第 16 名。
uses: AI 安全研究员：用于评估和加固 AI 系统的安全性
企业安全团队：扫描 AI 基础设施和代理，防范潜在攻击
开发者：集成 MCP 扫描和 LLM 越狱测试到 CI/CD 流程

en.tag: Tencent's full-stack AI red teaming security platform
en.what: A.I.G is a full-stack AI red teaming platform developed by Tencent Zhuque Lab to secure AI ecosystems. It performs agent scans, skill scans, MCP scans, AI infrastructure scans, and LLM jailbreak evaluations to detect and mitigate security vulnerabilities in AI systems.
en.content: The repository includes the platform's core code, documentation, multi-language READMEs (Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, German, etc.), Docker images, and ClawHub integrations such as EdgeOne ClawScan and Skill Scanner.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, offers Docker deployment, and integrates with cloud services like ClawHub and EdgeOne.
en.hot: With surging demand for AI security, the platform has quickly gained popularity on GitHub, amassing 4,957 stars with 50 new stars today, ranking 16th on the daily trending list.
uses: AI security researchers: to assess and harden AI system security
Enterprise security teams: to scan AI infrastructure and agents against potential attacks
Developers: to integrate MCP scanning and LLM jailbreak testing into CI/CD pipelines

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: AI 代理的 817 项结构化网络安全技能库
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）设计的开源网络安全技能库，包含 817 项生产级技能，覆盖 29 个安全领域。技能映射到 MITRE ATT&CK、NIST CSF 2.0 等 6 个主流框架，并遵循 agentskills.io 标准，支持 26+ 平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含按领域组织的技能定义（如威胁情报、红队、事件响应），每个技能包含描述、示例和框架映射；还提供快速入门指南、贡献指南和平台兼容性列表。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，技能以结构化格式（如 YAML/JSON）定义，遵循 agentskills.io 规范；无特定运行时依赖，可集成到多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 28.4k stars 且单日新增近 200，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5。它填补了 AI 代理在网络安全领域缺乏标准化技能库的空白，并整合了多个权威框架，吸引安全从业者和 AI 开发者。
uses: 安全分析师：利用 AI 代理自动执行威胁检测、漏洞评估等任务
红队/渗透测试人员：在授权测试中快速调用攻击模拟技能
AI 开发者：为代理集成安全能力，或基于此库扩展自定义技能
安全培训：作为教学资源，展示 AI 在网络安全中的应用

en.tag: 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents
en.what: An open-source library of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills for AI agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), covering 29 security domains. Skills are mapped to 6 frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, etc.) and follow the agentskills.io standard, compatible with 26+ platforms.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions organized by domain (e.g., threat intel, red team, incident response), each with descriptions, examples, and framework mappings; also includes quick-start, contributing guides, and platform compatibility lists.
en.stack: Primarily Python; skills are defined in structured formats (e.g., YAML/JSON) following agentskills.io spec; no heavy runtime dependencies, integrates with various AI agent platforms.
en.hot: 28.4k stars with ~200 added today, #5 on GitHub Trending. It fills the gap of a standardized cybersecurity skill library for AI agents, integrating multiple authoritative frameworks, attracting security pros and AI developers.
uses: Security analysts: automate threat detection, vulnerability assessment with AI agents
Red team/pentesters: quickly invoke attack simulation skills in authorized tests
AI developers: integrate security capabilities into agents or extend custom skills
Security training: as educational resource for AI in cybersecurity

zh.tag: 本地运行与训练大模型和扩散模型的桌面应用
zh.what: Unsloth 是一个本地优先的 AI 工具，允许用户在个人电脑上运行和训练大型语言模型（LLM）和扩散模型。它支持包括 Qwen3.8、Kimi K3、MiniMax-H3、Gemma 4、DeepSeek-V4 和 FLUX 在内的多种模型，并提供桌面应用和命令行安装方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用安装包（Windows、macOS、Linux）、命令行安装脚本、文档和示例笔记本。核心功能是模型运行、训练和部署，并支持与 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 等代理工具集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型架构。桌面应用可能使用 Electron 或类似技术打包。
zh.hot: Unsloth 因提供本地运行和训练 AI 模型的便捷方式而广受欢迎，star 数已达 7 万，日增 592，反映了用户对隐私和本地控制的需求。
uses: AI 开发者和研究者：在本地快速实验和微调模型，无需云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望数据不出本地，避免云端泄露风险。
教育者与学生：学习模型训练和推理，无需昂贵硬件。
代理工具用户：将本地模型与 Claude Code、Codex 等集成，构建自动化工作流。

en.tag: Local desktop app to run and train LLMs and diffusion models
en.what: Unsloth is a local-first AI tool that lets users run and train large language models (LLMs) and diffusion models on their own hardware. It supports a wide range of models including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, and FLUX, and offers a desktop app as well as command-line installation.
en.content: The repository contains desktop app installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux, command-line install scripts, documentation, and example notebooks. Core features include model running, training, and deployment, with integrations for agent tools like Claude Code, Codex, and MCP.
en.stack: Built with Python, relying on deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, supporting multiple model architectures. The desktop app is likely packaged with Electron or similar technology.
en.hot: Unsloth is popular for providing a convenient way to run and train AI models locally, with 70k stars and 592 new stars today, reflecting the demand for privacy and local control.
uses: AI developers and researchers: quickly experiment and fine-tune models locally without cloud services.
Privacy-conscious users: keep data on-device to avoid cloud leaks.
Educators and students: learn model training and inference without expensive hardware.
Agent tool users: integrate local models with Claude Code, Codex, etc., for automated workflows.

zh.tag: RTX 3090/4090/5090 本地运行 LLM 的社区配方集
zh.what: 这是一个社区维护的配方集，帮助用户在 RTX 3090 等消费级 GPU 上本地部署和运行现代大语言模型。它支持多种推理引擎（vLLM、llama.cpp、ik_llama），并针对不同模型和显卡配置提供了经过验证的配置、补丁和基准测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含交互式安装和启动脚本（setup.sh、launch.sh）、模型配置变体（如 vllm/minimal、vllm/dual）、文档（FAQ、WSL 设置、单卡指南）以及 Image Studio 捆绑包（用于图像生成）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 和 Bash 脚本，依赖 PyYAML 进行配置解析。核心推理引擎包括 vLLM、llama.cpp 和 ik_llama，支持 CUDA 环境。
zh.hot: 随着消费级 GPU 性能提升，越来越多开发者希望在家用硬件上运行 LLM。该项目提供了开箱即用的配置，降低了门槛，因此迅速获得 2000+ star，并在 GitHub 周榜上排名第 12。
uses: 拥有 RTX 3090/4090/5090 显卡，希望本地运行 LLM 的个人开发者或研究者。
在 homelab 或开发环境中部署 LLM 作为后端服务的工程师。
需要图像生成与聊天模型同时运行的多模态应用场景。

en.tag: Community recipes for serving LLMs on RTX 3090/4090/5090 GPUs
en.what: A community-maintained collection of recipes for serving modern LLMs locally on consumer GPUs like the RTX 3090. It supports multiple inference engines (vLLM, llama.cpp, ik_llama) and provides verified configs, patches, and benchmarks for various models and GPU setups.
en.content: The repo includes interactive setup and launch scripts (setup.sh, launch.sh), model config variants (e.g., vllm/minimal, vllm/dual), documentation (FAQ, WSL setup, single-card guide), and an Image Studio bundle for image generation.
en.stack: Primarily Python and Bash scripts, with PyYAML for config parsing. Core inference engines include vLLM, llama.cpp, and ik_llama, all CUDA-based.
en.hot: With consumer GPUs getting more powerful, developers increasingly want to run LLMs on home hardware. This project lowers the barrier with ready-to-use configs, quickly gaining 2000+ stars and ranking #12 on GitHub's weekly trending.
uses: Individual developers or researchers with RTX 3090/4090/5090 GPUs who want to run LLMs locally.
Engineers deploying LLMs as backend services in homelabs or dev environments.
Multimodal use cases requiring both image generation and chat models running simultaneously.

zh.tag: 微软出品，Python/.NET 双语言的生产级 AI 代理与多代理工作流框架
zh.what: Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) 是一个开源、多语言的框架，用于在 .NET 和 Python 中构建生产级的 AI 代理和多代理工作流。它提供了一致的构建、编排和运行代理系统的基础，支持从原型到生产的全过程，并保持架构选择的开放性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 和 .NET 的源代码、示例、文档和托管模式。Python 包位于 python/packages，.NET 源码位于 dotnet/src，并提供多种代理提供商的示例，如 Azure OpenAI、OpenAI 等。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python 和 C#/.NET，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 Azure OpenAI、OpenAI、GitHub Copilot SDK），并集成了 Microsoft Foundry。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方框架，它填补了生产级多代理编排的空白，支持双语言和灵活架构，迅速获得 13k+ star，今日新增 66，位居 Python 趋势榜第 6。
uses: 开发需要生产级可靠性的 AI 代理和自动化工作流的团队
需要跨 Python 和 .NET 统一代理框架的企业开发者
构建复杂多代理协作（如顺序、并发、交接、群组协作）的开发者
需要可观测性、治理和人工介入控制的场景

en.tag: Microsoft's production-grade framework for building AI agents and multi-agent workflows in Python and .NET
en.what: Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) is an open-source, multi-language framework for building production-grade AI agents and multi-agent workflows in .NET and Python. It provides a consistent foundation for building, orchestrating, and operating agent systems, supporting the journey from prototype to production while keeping architecture choices open.
en.content: The repository includes source code for Python and .NET, samples, documentation, and hosting patterns. Python packages are under python/packages, .NET source under dotnet/src, with examples for various agent providers like Azure OpenAI and OpenAI.
en.stack: Primarily Python and C#/.NET, supporting multiple LLM providers (e.g., Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot SDK) and integrating with Microsoft Foundry.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft framework, it fills the gap for production-grade multi-agent orchestration with dual-language support and flexible architecture, quickly gaining 13k+ stars with 66 new today, ranking #6 on Python trending.
uses: Teams building AI agents and automation workflows requiring production-grade reliability
Enterprise developers needing a unified agent framework across Python and .NET
Developers building complex multi-agent collaborations (sequential, concurrent, handoff, group)
Scenarios requiring observability, governance, and human-in-the-loop control

zh.tag: 开源AI自动化渗透测试工具，自主发现并修复应用漏洞
zh.what: Strix 是一个开源的 AI 渗透测试平台，通过自主 AI 代理动态运行代码，像真实黑客一样侦察、利用并验证应用漏洞。它通过生成实际的可利用 Proof-of-Concept 来确认漏洞，而非仅依赖静态分析的误报，并支持多代理协作规模化执行安全测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的渗透测试工具包，支持侦察、漏洞利用与验证开箱即用；同时提供 GitHub Actions 集成与 CI/CD 流水线插件，可自动扫描 Pull Request 并在代码合并前阻断不安全提交。
zh.stack: 项目以 Python 为主要语言构建，支持通过 PyPI 分发安装（strix-agent），并依赖现代 AI 代理编排框架实现多智能体协作；可与现有 DevOps 工具链深度集成。
zh.hot: 该项目月增 16,488 Star 跃至 GitHub 月榜第 5 名，总星数突破 42,318；其“AI + 动态 PoC 验证”模式精准击中了传统静态扫描误报率高、人工渗透测试成本高的痛点，成为安全左移趋势下的热门方案。
uses: 开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动化安全扫描，在代码合并前拦截漏洞
安全工程师 —— 利用多 AI 代理协作执行大规模渗透测试与漏洞验证
DevOps/平台团队 —— 将安全左移，无需额外基础设施即可接入现有流水线

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI pentesting agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities
en.what: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing platform where autonomous agents dynamically run code to discover and validate vulnerabilities like real hackers. It generates working proofs-of-concept rather than static-analysis false positives, and scales through multi-agent orchestration for collaborative security testing.
en.content: The repository ships with a full pentesting toolkit covering reconnaissance, exploitation, and validation out of the box. It also provides GitHub Actions integration and CI/CD pipeline plugins to auto-scan pull requests and block insecure code before it reaches production.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python and distributed via PyPI as strix-agent, it relies on modern AI agent orchestration frameworks for multi-agent collaboration and deep integration with existing DevOps toolchains.
en.hot: With 16,488 new stars this month and a #5 spot on GitHub Trending, it has climbed to 42,318 total stars. Its “AI + dynamic PoC validation” model directly addresses the high false-positive rates of legacy scanners and the cost of manual pentesting, making it a standout in the shift-left security movement.
uses: Development teams — Automate security scanning in CI/CD to intercept vulnerabilities before code merges.
Security engineers — Leverage multi-agent AI collaboration for large-scale pentesting and real exploit validation.
DevOps/platform teams — Shift security left by plugging into existing pipelines with zero additional infrastructure.

zh.tag: 自适应网页抓取框架，从单请求到全站爬取
zh.what: Scrapling 是一个自适应的网页抓取框架，能够处理从单个请求到大规模爬取的各种任务。它提供了多种抓取模式，如静态抓取、动态抓取和基于浏览器的抓取，并支持自动适配不同的网站结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心抓取库、多种抓取器（Fetcher、StealthyFetcher、PlaywrightFetcher 等）、解析工具（Adaptor、Selector）、以及用于 AI 代理的技能目录（agent-skill）。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，依赖 httpx、lxml、cssselect 等库，支持 Playwright 和 Camoufox 进行浏览器自动化，并集成 MCP 以支持 AI 代理。
zh.hot: 凭借 76k+ 星标和每周 1.7k+ 新增，Scrapling 因其易用性和强大的自适应能力成为 Python 抓取领域的热门选择，尤其受到 AI 代理开发者的青睐。
uses: 数据采集工程师：快速构建从简单请求到复杂爬虫的抓取任务，无需手动处理反爬机制。
AI 代理开发者：利用内置的 agent-skill 和 MCP 支持，让 AI 代理能够自主抓取网页数据。
数据分析师：从网站提取结构化数据用于分析和建模，支持多种输出格式。

en.tag: Adaptive web scraping framework from single request to full-scale crawl
en.what: Scrapling is an adaptive web scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to full-scale crawling. It offers multiple fetching modes including static, dynamic, and browser-based, with automatic adaptation to different website structures.
en.content: The repository includes the core scraping library, various fetchers (Fetcher, StealthyFetcher, PlaywrightFetcher), parsing utilities (Adaptor, Selector), and an agent-skill directory for AI agents.
en.stack: Built with Python, relying on httpx, lxml, cssselect, and supporting Playwright and Camoufox for browser automation, with MCP integration for AI agents.
en.hot: With 76k+ stars and 1.7k+ weekly additions, Scrapling has become a popular choice in Python scraping due to its ease of use and adaptive capabilities, especially among AI agent developers.
uses: Data scraping engineers: Quickly build scraping tasks from simple requests to complex crawlers without manual anti-bot handling.
AI agent developers: Leverage built-in agent-skill and MCP support for autonomous web data extraction.
Data analysts: Extract structured data from websites for analysis and modeling, with multiple output formats.

zh.tag: 一条命令微调大模型，无需SSH和复杂配置
zh.what: Soup 是一个命令行工具，让你通过一个 YAML 配置文件即可完成大语言模型的微调与后训练。它简化了训练流程，无需管理 SSH 或复杂配置，一条命令即可启动训练。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包 soup-cli，提供命令行接口、配置解析、训练执行等功能，并附带文档、示例配置和测试。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10-3.12，依赖 PyTorch 等训练库，支持流式层训练以降低显存占用。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1786 星，总星数达 2529，因其让 8B 模型可在 4GB 显存笔记本上微调，大幅降低门槛而爆火。
uses: 个人开发者：在本地笔记本上微调小模型，无需昂贵云GPU
研究人员：快速实验不同配置，无需繁琐环境搭建
教育场景：教学演示LLM微调流程，降低学习门槛

en.tag: Fine-tune LLMs with one command, no SSH or config hell
en.what: Soup is a CLI tool that lets you fine-tune and post-train LLMs using a single YAML config file. It simplifies the training workflow, eliminating SSH and configuration complexity—one command starts the training.
en.content: The repo contains the Python package soup-cli, offering CLI, config parsing, and training execution, along with docs, example configs, and tests.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.10-3.12, relies on PyTorch and other training libraries, supports layer streaming to reduce memory usage.
en.hot: Gained 1786 stars this week (total 2529), going viral for enabling fine-tuning of 8B models on a 4GB laptop GPU, dramatically lowering the barrier.
uses: Individual developers: fine-tune small models on local laptops without expensive cloud GPUs
Researchers: quickly experiment with different configs without complex environment setup
Educational settings: demonstrate LLM fine-tuning workflows with a low learning curve

zh.tag: 在 Apple Silicon 上以多 token 预测加速本地 LLM 推理
zh.what: MTPLX 是一个原生 Mac 应用和命令行工具，利用模型自带的多 token 预测（MTP）头来加速本地大语言模型的推理。它通过批量验证多个草稿 token 并采用精确拒绝采样，在不改变输出分布的前提下实现最高 2.24 倍的加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Mac 应用（DMG 下载）和命令行工具，提供模型推荐、下载、安装和性能测量功能。内置多个 Qwen 3.8/3.6 的量化版本，如 Optimized Speed、Bare Speed 和 Optimized Quality，并支持自动选择最适合硬件的配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，使用 MLX 框架（Apple 的机器学习库）进行推理，支持 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon（M1 及以上）。通过 PyPI 和 Homebrew 分发，并包含 CI 和许可证等标准项目文件。
zh.hot: 本周新增 370 星，总星数达 1589，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 17 名。它解决了 MLX 生态中一个痛点：大多数运行时未利用模型内置的 MTP 头，而 MTPLX 提供了显著的加速且不牺牲输出质量。
uses: Mac 用户（Apple Silicon）希望在不购买额外硬件的情况下加速本地 LLM 推理，适合开发者和 AI 爱好者。
需要运行 Qwen 3.8 27B 等大型模型的用户，通过多 token 预测获得接近两倍的解码速度。
对推理速度敏感的应用场景，如代码生成、交互式聊天等，且要求输出分布与标准解码完全一致。

en.tag: Multi-token prediction to speed up local LLM inference on Apple Silicon
en.what: MTPLX is a native Mac app and CLI that accelerates local LLM inference using the model's built-in multi-token prediction (MTP) heads. It verifies multiple drafted tokens in a single batched forward pass and uses exact rejection sampling, achieving up to 2.24x speedup without changing the output distribution.
en.content: The repo includes a full Mac app (DMG download) and CLI, offering model recommendation, download, installation, and performance measurement. It bundles several quantized versions of Qwen 3.8/3.6, such as Optimized Speed, Bare Speed, and Optimized Quality, and automatically selects the best configuration for the hardware.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+, uses the MLX framework (Apple's machine learning library) for inference, supports macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Distributed via PyPI and Homebrew, with CI and standard project files.
en.hot: Gained 370 stars this week, reaching 1589 total, and ranked #17 on GitHub Trending (Python) weekly. It addresses a pain point in the MLX ecosystem: most runtimes don't use the built-in MTP heads, and MTPLX provides significant speedup without sacrificing output quality.
uses: Mac users (Apple Silicon) who want to speed up local LLM inference without extra hardware, suitable for developers and AI enthusiasts.
Users running large models like Qwen 3.8 27B, gaining nearly 2x decoding speed via multi-token prediction.
Applications sensitive to inference speed, such as code generation and interactive chat, while requiring output distribution identical to standard decoding.

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上运行与微调大模型的Python包
zh.what: mlx-lm 是一个 Python 包，用于在 Apple 芯片上使用 MLX 框架生成文本和微调大语言模型。它集成了 Hugging Face Hub，可以轻松使用数千个模型，并支持量化、低秩和全模型微调，以及分布式推理和微调。
zh.content: 仓库包含 mlx_lm 包，提供命令行工具（如 mlx_lm.generate 和 mlx_lm.chat）以及 Python API，用于加载、生成、量化和转换模型。还包括示例代码和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 MLX（Apple 的机器学习框架），使用 Python 编写，依赖 Hugging Face Hub 和 transformers 等库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 120 星，总星数 6702，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 16 名。它让 Apple 用户能轻松运行和微调大模型，无需云端 GPU，因此受到 Mac 用户的欢迎。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行大模型，保护隐私并离线使用。
开发者需要快速测试或微调 Hugging Face 上的模型，并支持量化。
研究人员进行低秩或全模型微调，利用 Apple 芯片的分布式能力。

en.tag: Python package for running and fine-tuning LLMs on Apple silicon with MLX
en.what: MLX LM is a Python package for generating text and fine-tuning large language models on Apple silicon with MLX. It integrates with Hugging Face Hub to easily use thousands of LLMs, supports quantization, low-rank and full fine-tuning, and distributed inference and fine-tuning.
en.content: The repository contains the mlx_lm package with command-line tools (e.g., mlx_lm.generate and mlx_lm.chat) and a Python API for loading, generating, quantizing, and converting models. It also includes examples and documentation.
en.stack: Built on MLX (Apple's machine learning framework), written in Python, and depends on Hugging Face Hub and transformers libraries.
en.hot: With 120 stars added this week and 6,702 total, it ranks #16 on GitHub Trending (Python) this week. It allows Apple users to easily run and fine-tune LLMs locally without cloud GPUs, making it popular among Mac users.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally for privacy and offline use.
Developers who need to quickly test or fine-tune models from Hugging Face with quantization support.
Researchers performing low-rank or full fine-tuning, leveraging distributed capabilities on Apple silicon.

zh.tag: 无限画布上的终端与AI代理管理器
zh.what: nodeterm 是一个基于节点的终端管理器，将多个真实终端作为可拖拽节点放在无限画布上，支持平移和缩放。它专为 AI 编码代理设计，每个项目可变成 Trello 风格的看板，展示并行的 Claude Code 会话。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面应用（macOS/Linux）、自托管浏览器版（Server Edition）和 iOS 伴侣应用，共享同一服务层。提供安装包（.dmg、.AppImage、.deb）、文档、架构说明和源码构建指南。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 和 TypeScript，使用 tmux 作为终端后端。支持 macOS (arm64/x64) 和 Linux (x64)，浏览器版通过服务端部署，iOS 伴侣应用可附加到同一会话。
zh.hot: 今日新增 78 星，总星数 956，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript）第 9 名。其独特卖点在于用空间画布替代传统标签页，专为 ADHD 和分散工作流设计，同时深度集成 AI 代理，切中开发者痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：需要并行管理多个 Claude Code 会话，以看板形式跟踪进度。
多任务开发者：在无限画布上组织多个终端，避免标签页混乱，保持上下文。
远程工作场景：通过 Server Edition 在浏览器中访问同一画布，或使用 iOS 伴侣应用随时查看。
ADHD 或偏好视觉化工作流的人群：用空间布局代替隐藏标签，提升专注和效率。

en.tag: Terminal & AI agent manager on an infinite canvas
en.what: nodeterm is a node-based terminal manager that places multiple real terminals as draggable nodes on an infinite pan/zoom canvas. Built for AI coding agents, it turns every project into a Trello-style board of live Claude Code sessions.
en.content: The repo includes an Electron desktop app (macOS/Linux), a self-hosted browser version (Server Edition), and an iOS companion, all sharing a common service seam. It provides installers (.dmg, .AppImage, .deb), docs, architecture notes, and build-from-source instructions.
en.stack: Built with Electron and TypeScript, using tmux for terminal backend. Supports macOS (arm64/x64) and Linux (x64), with a browser Server Edition and an iOS companion that attaches to the same live sessions.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars today, reaching 956 total, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) daily. Its unique selling point is replacing stacked tabs with a spatial canvas, designed for ADHD and scattered workflows, while deeply integrating AI agents—hitting a nerve with developers.
uses: AI coding agent users: need to manage multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, tracking progress via a kanban board.
Multitasking developers: organize multiple terminals on an infinite canvas to avoid tab clutter and maintain context.
Remote work scenarios: access the same canvas via the browser Server Edition or check in with the iOS companion.
People with ADHD or visual workflow preferences: spatial layout replaces hidden tabs, boosting focus and efficiency.

zh.tag: 本地 AI 图像转 3D 网格的桌面应用
zh.what: Modly 是一款开源桌面应用，利用本地 AI 模型将照片转换为 3D 模型，所有计算均在 GPU 上完成，无需云端。支持 Windows、Linux 和 Apple Silicon macOS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 前端（TypeScript）和 Python 后端（API），以及扩展系统，可加载外部模型如 Hunyuan3D 和 TripoSG。提供安装脚本和开发指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript（Electron）和 Python（FastAPI 等），依赖 Node.js 和 Python 环境，支持 GPU 加速。
zh.hot: 5k+ stars 且日增 70，因提供完全本地、隐私友好的 3D 生成方案，且支持多种模型扩展，吸引大量创作者和开发者。
uses: 3D 设计师和游戏开发者快速从照片生成模型原型
对隐私敏感的用户，希望本地处理而不上传数据
AI 爱好者探索本地图像到 3D 的生成技术

en.tag: Desktop app for local AI-powered image-to-3D mesh generation
en.what: Modly is an open-source desktop app that turns photos into 3D models using local AI models, running entirely on your GPU with no cloud dependency. It supports Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon macOS.
en.content: The repo contains an Electron frontend (TypeScript) and a Python backend (API), plus an extension system for external models like Hunyuan3D and TripoSG. Includes install scripts and dev guides.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript (Electron) and Python (FastAPI etc.), requiring Node.js and Python environments, with GPU acceleration.
en.hot: With 5k+ stars and +70 daily, it's hot for offering fully local, privacy-friendly 3D generation with multiple model extensions, attracting creators and developers.
uses: 3D designers and game devs quickly prototyping models from photos
Privacy-conscious users wanting local processing without uploads
AI enthusiasts exploring local image-to-3D generation

zh.tag: 免费AI编码代理，多产品覆盖终端、桌面、网页与云端
zh.what: Freebuff 是一套免费的AI编码代理产品，包括桌面端、CLI、Web、云和聊天五种形态，无需订阅或API密钥即可使用。它通过专用代理和模型选择帮助用户编码、构建和研究。

en.tag: Free AI coding agent suite across terminal, desktop, web, and cloud
en.what: Freebuff is a suite of free AI coding agents available as desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat products, requiring no subscription or API key. It uses specialized agents and a choice of models to assist with coding, building, and research.
en.content: The repository includes product documentation, quick start guides, model catalog details, and descriptions/links for each product (Desktop, CLI, Web, Cloud, Chat).

Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat

zh.tag: 现代化全功能下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BT/磁力链接
zh.what: Motrix 是一款简洁易用的桌面下载管理器，支持 HTTP、FTP、BitTorrent、磁力链接等多种协议。它提供干净直观的界面，并具备 BT 文件选择、内置 tracker 管理、端口映射等高级功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，基于 Electron、React 和 TypeScript 构建，提供仪表盘、下载列表、设置等界面。同时包含无头服务器模式，支持在 Node.js 或 Docker 中运行，并提供 Web UI。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Electron、React、TypeScript，下载核心独立于 UI，通过基于 JSON-RPC 2.0 的 MDXP 协议与浏览器扩展和命令行工具通信，插件运行在隔离沙箱中。
zh.hot: Motrix 拥有超过 5.3 万 Star，今日新增 344，因其功能全面且界面简洁而广受欢迎。v2 版本（Motrix Turbo）正在测试，带来了全新架构和更多特性，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 日常用户：需要下载 HTTP/FTP 文件或 BT 种子、磁力链接的普通用户
高级用户：需要 tracker 管理、端口映射、无头服务器部署的下载发烧友
开发者：希望集成下载功能或开发下载相关工具的技术人员

en.tag: A modern, full-featured download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and magnet links
en.what: Motrix is a clean and easy-to-use desktop download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, magnet links, and more. It offers a clean intuitive interface with advanced features like per-file selection for BT, built-in tracker management, and port mapping.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop app built with Electron, React, and TypeScript, featuring dashboard, downloads list, and settings UI. It also includes a headless server mode that runs on Node.js or Docker with a web UI.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Electron, React, and TypeScript. The download core is independent of the UI, communicating with browser extensions and CLI tools via MDXP (Motrix Download eXchange Protocol) built on JSON-RPC 2.0, with plugins running in isolated sandboxes.
en.hot: With over 53K stars and 344 new stars today, Motrix is popular for its full-featured yet clean interface. The v2 beta (Motrix Turbo) with a rebuilt architecture and new features is generating significant buzz.
uses: Everyday users: those who need to download HTTP/FTP files or BitTorrent/magnet links
Power users: download enthusiasts who need tracker management, port mapping, or headless server deployment
Developers: those who want to integrate download functionality or build download-related tools

zh.tag: 隐私优先的开源简历生成器
zh.what: Reactive Resume 是一款免费开源的简历生成器，简化了创建、更新和分享简历的流程。它提供多种模板，用户填写信息后即可导出为 PDF，无需注册账户即可使用基本功能。该应用以隐私为核心，用户完全拥有自己的数据，且支持自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用（apps/web）、后端服务（apps/server）以及相关文档，采用 monorepo 结构。支持 Docker 部署，提供多语言界面，并集成了赞助商展示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端基于 React（Next.js），后端使用 NestJS，数据库支持 PostgreSQL 和 MongoDB，使用 Docker 进行容器化部署。
zh.hot: 该项目拥有超过 4 万星标，今日新增 255 星，位列 GitHub 趋势榜（TypeScript）第 5 名。其隐私保护、开源免费和自托管特性吸引了大量用户，且持续更新维护。
uses: 求职者：快速制作专业简历并导出 PDF，无需注册。
注重隐私的用户：希望完全掌控个人数据，可自托管部署。
开发者：可定制和扩展简历生成器，或贡献代码。

en.tag: Privacy-first open-source resume builder
en.what: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that simplifies creating, updating, and sharing resumes. It offers templates, lets you fill in details and export to PDF, no account required for basic use. Built with privacy as a core principle, it gives users complete ownership of their data and can be self-hosted.
en.content: The repository contains a frontend app (apps/web), backend server (apps/server), and documentation, structured as a monorepo. It supports Docker deployment, offers multi-language UI, and includes sponsor showcases.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, frontend built with React (Next.js), backend with NestJS, databases support PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and Docker for containerized deployment.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 255 new stars today, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its privacy-first, open-source, free, and self-hostable features attract many users, and it is actively maintained.
uses: Job seekers: quickly create professional resumes and export to PDF without registration.
Privacy-conscious users: want full control over personal data and can self-host.
Developers: can customize and extend the resume builder or contribute code.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 求职代理：扫描职位、评分、定制简历、跟踪申请

zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，依赖 AI 编码 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode）作为运行时。它可能使用 AI 模型进行职位评估和简历定制，但具体依赖未在摘要中明确。
zh.hot: 6.4 万星标，今日新增 218，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 7。它解决了求职痛点，作者声称评估了 740+ 职位、生成了 100+ 定制简历并成功入职，加上媒体（WIRED、Business Insider）报道，引发共鸣。
uses: 求职者：自动化扫描职位、评分和定制简历，节省时间
开发者：在本地 CLI 中集成 AI 求职工具，可自定义评分标准
AI 爱好者：学习如何构建多代理系统，用于实际场景

en.tag: Open-source AI job search agent: scan, score, tailor, track — locally in your coding CLI
en.what: career-ops is an open-source AI job search system that runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.). It scans job portals, evaluates listings with a structured A-F rubric into a 1.0-5.0 score, tailors your CV, and tracks applications. The author calls it a 'multi-agent job search system' to let candidates use AI to choose companies, rather than being filtered by company AI.
en.content: The repo includes comprehensive docs (multi-language README), demo GIF, press mentions (WIRED, Business Insider), and core code. It supports multiple languages and integrates Product Hunt and Trendshift badges. Core features include job scanning, scoring, CV tailoring, and application tracking, all running locally in the CLI environment.
en.stack: Primary language is JavaScript, and it relies on AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) as the runtime. It likely uses AI models for job evaluation and CV tailoring, but specific dependencies are not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: With 64.6k stars and +218 today, it ranks #7 on GitHub Trending daily. It addresses job search pain points; the author claims 740+ listings evaluated, 100+ tailored CVs, and a dream role landed, plus media coverage (WIRED, Business Insider), driving its popularity.

Developers: integrate AI job search tools in local CLI, customizable scoring rubric
AI enthusiasts: learn to build multi-agent systems for real-world use cases

zh.tag: AI 代理全自动管理 YouTube 频道，免费 Gemini 可用
zh.what: 这是一个利用 AI 代理实现 YouTube 频道全自动管理的工具。它能够自动创建、优化并发布视频，全天候运行，无需人工干预。支持使用免费的 Gemini API 或 OpenAI，且无需编写代码。

uses: 内容创作者：希望自动化视频生成和发布，节省时间。
营销人员：需要批量生成视频内容以扩大品牌影响力。
开发者：对 AI 代理工作流和自动化管道感兴趣，可二次开发。
初学者：无需编程经验，通过引导式设置即可上手。

en.what: This is a tool that uses AI agents to fully automate YouTube channel management. It can automatically create, optimize, and publish videos, running 24/7 without manual intervention. It works with the free Gemini API or OpenAI, and requires no coding.

Its appeal lies in offering fully automated YouTube channel management for free (using Gemini), significantly lowering the barrier to content creation, and its continuous updates and issue fixes have garnered strong community response.
uses: Content creators: who want to automate video generation and publishing to save time.
Marketers: needing to produce video content at scale for brand reach.
Developers: interested in AI agent workflows and automation pipelines, can customize.
Beginners: no coding experience needed, guided setup makes it easy to start.

Existing SillyTavern users: seeking a smoother, native app experience with mobile support.
Developers: interested in how Tauri wraps large web frontends, or contributing to open source.

zh.tag: 拒绝白板面试的友好公司清单
zh.what: 这是一个收集不使用白板面试的公司的开源清单，旨在推广更贴近实际工作的招聘方式。它列出了那些采用真实问题讨论、结对编程或家庭作业等面试形式的公司，并鼓励社区贡献和反馈。

招聘者：参考清单中的公司实践，改进自己的面试方式。

en.tag: A list of companies that don't do whiteboard interviews
en.what: This is an open-source list of companies that avoid whiteboard interviews, promoting hiring practices that resemble real work. It includes companies that use real-world problem discussions, pair programming, or take-home assignments, and encourages community contributions and feedback.

Tech community members: Contribute or remove company entries to keep the list accurate.

zh.tag: 超3400个品牌SVG图标库
zh.what: Simple Icons 是一个收集了超过 3400 个流行品牌 SVG 图标的开源库，所有图标均以简洁的单色风格呈现。用户可以通过官网或 CDN 直接使用这些图标，并支持社区贡献和修改。

uses: 前端开发者：在网页或应用中使用品牌图标，提升视觉一致性
设计师：快速获取品牌矢量图标，用于设计稿或原型
内容创作者：为博客、视频或演示文稿添加品牌标识

en.tag: Over 3400 free SVG icons for popular brands
en.what: Simple Icons is an open-source collection of over 3400 SVG icons for popular brands, all in a clean monochrome style. Users can access icons via the website or CDN, and contributions are welcome.
en.content: The repository contains icon source files (SVG), a data file (simple-icons.json), and scripts for generating and verifying icons, along with website and CDN integration methods.

Content creators: Add brand logos to blogs, videos, or presentations

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编码工具用量监控桌面小组件
zh.what: Token Monitor 是一个桌面小组件，用于实时监控 29+ 款 AI 编码工具（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等）的 token 用量、费用和账户限制。它支持多设备同步、历史趋势分析，并按工具、设备、模型、会话或项目维度进行统计。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、安装包（支持 Windows/macOS/Linux）、演示 GIF、以及多语言 README（中/英/日/韩等）。核心功能包括实时用量监控、多设备同步、历史趋势和工具/设备/模型/会话/项目维度统计。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，桌面应用跨平台支持 Windows 10+、macOS 12+ 和 Linux x64。依赖本地数据路径读取（如 ~/.claude、~/.codex）实现无侵入监控，并集成多设备同步机制。
zh.hot: 本月新增 677 星（总星数 1323），登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（JavaScript）第 17 名。随着 AI 编码工具激增，开发者对用量透明化和成本控制的需求强烈，该工具填补了这一空白。
uses: 重度 AI 编码工具用户：实时监控 token 消耗，避免超出账户限制
团队管理者：跨设备同步用量数据，统一管理多成员的成本
成本敏感型开发者：按项目/模型/会话分析历史趋势，优化支出
自托管爱好者：本地优先存储，数据隐私可控

en.tag: Local-first desktop widget for tracking AI coding tool usage
en.what: Token Monitor is a desktop widget that provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and account limits across 29+ AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. It features multi-device sync, historical trends, and breakdowns by tool, device, model, session, or project.
en.content: The repository includes desktop app source code, installers for Windows/macOS/Linux, demo GIF, and multilingual READMEs (EN/CN/JP/KR etc.). Core features include live usage monitoring, multi-device sync, historical trends, and breakdowns by tool/device/model/session/project.
en.stack: Built primarily with JavaScript, the desktop app supports Windows 10+, macOS 12+, and Linux x64. It reads local data paths (e.g., ~/.claude, ~/.codex) for non-intrusive monitoring and integrates multi-device sync.
en.hot: Gained 677 stars this month (total 1323), ranking #17 on GitHub Trending monthly (JavaScript). With the proliferation of AI coding tools, developers strongly need usage transparency and cost control, and this tool fills that gap.
uses: Heavy AI coding tool users: monitor token consumption in real-time to avoid hitting account limits
Team managers: sync usage data across devices to manage costs for multiple members
Cost-conscious developers: analyze historical trends by project/model/session to optimize spending
Self-hosting enthusiasts: local-first storage for data privacy control

zh.tag: 本地多智能体编排，让终端 CLI 变成你的克隆员工
zh.what: Munder Difflin 是一个本地多智能体编排工具，能将你已有的终端编码 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 等）包装成可协作的智能体团队。它由你的克隆体 Michael 作为主管，为每个智能体分配长期记忆、邮箱和办公桌，并在 2D 办公楼层上可视化他们的工作状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面应用、React 前端、Pixi.js 渲染的办公楼层、xterm.js 终端集成，以及 node-pty 进程管理。支持多种 CLI 代理，提供长期记忆、消息路由和可视化界面。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron、React、TypeScript、Pixi.js、xterm.js 和 node-pty 构建，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 上线即登 GitHub Trending 日榜第二，单日新增 306 star，总星数突破 2000。其“将终端 CLI 变成克隆办公室”的创意和免费开源特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：希望利用现有 AI 编码工具实现自动化任务，如代码审查、测试执行等。
团队：需要并行处理多个编码任务，通过智能体协作提高效率。
AI 爱好者：探索多智能体系统，可视化观察智能体协作过程。

en.tag: Local multi-agent harness that turns terminal CLIs into your clone office
en.what: Munder Difflin is a local multi-agent harness that wraps existing terminal coding CLIs (like Claude Code, Codex, Grok, etc.) into a collaborative agent team. Your clone, Michael, acts as the manager, giving each agent long-term memory, a mailbox, and a desk on a 2D office floor, visualizing their work in real time.
en.content: The repo includes an Electron desktop app, React frontend, Pixi.js-rendered office floor, xterm.js terminal integration, and node-pty process management. It supports multiple CLI agents with long-term memory, message routing, and a visual interface.
en.stack: Built with Electron, React, TypeScript, Pixi.js, xterm.js, and node-pty, supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.hot: Debuted at #2 on GitHub Trending daily, gaining 306 stars in one day and surpassing 2,000 total. Its creative concept of turning terminal CLIs into a clone office, combined with being free and open source, has captured developers' attention.
uses: Developers: Automate coding tasks like code review and test execution using existing AI tools.
Teams: Parallelize multiple coding tasks and boost efficiency through agent collaboration.
AI enthusiasts: Explore multi-agent systems and visualize agent collaboration in action.

zh.tag: 八大网盘直链获取工具，一键下载
zh.what: LinkSwift 是一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具，由【网盘直链下载助手】修改而来。它支持百度网盘、阿里云盘、中国移动云盘、天翼云盘、迅雷云盘、夸克网盘、UC网盘和123云盘八大主流网盘，帮助用户快速获取文件的直链下载地址。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用户脚本（userscript），可通过 GreasyFork 或脚本猫安装，提供安装说明和扩展脚本推荐（如123云盘会员青春版、百度网盘会员青春版）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，依赖用户脚本管理器（如 Tampermonkey）运行，可能涉及浏览器 API 和网盘页面 DOM 操作。
zh.hot: 本周新增 416 星，总星数近 2 万，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（JavaScript）第 14 名。因其解决了网盘下载限速和繁琐操作的痛点，广受用户欢迎。
uses: 经常使用百度网盘、阿里云盘等网盘，希望绕过客户端限制直接下载文件的用户。
需要批量下载网盘文件或获取直链用于下载工具（如 IDM、aria2）的进阶用户。
对网盘下载速度不满，寻求免费提速方案的用户。

en.tag: One-click direct link extractor for 8 major cloud drives
en.what: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based tool for obtaining direct download links from cloud drives, modified from the 'Netdisk Direct Link Download Assistant'. It supports eight major cloud drives including Baidu, Aliyun, China Mobile, Tianyi, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123pan, enabling users to quickly get direct download URLs.
en.content: The repository contains a userscript installable via GreasyFork or ScriptCat, with installation instructions and recommended companion scripts (e.g., 123pan Youth Member, Baidu Netdisk Youth Member).

Advanced users who need to batch download files or obtain direct links for download managers like IDM or aria2.

zh.tag: LLM 流量代理与协议翻译，让代理用上开源模型
zh.what: Switchyard 是一个 Rust 编写的 LLM 流量代理和库，用于在提供商之间路由请求，并在 OpenAI Chat、Anthropic Messages 和 OpenAI Responses 格式之间进行翻译。它支持将 Claude Code 或 Codex 等编码代理指向开源模型，同时保持代理使用其原生 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的代理服务器（switchyard-server）、命令行启动器（switchyard launch）以及可嵌入的库。提供协议翻译、多后端路由（随机、LLM 分类器、信号驱动等）和 Prometheus 指标。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，使用 Cargo 构建。CLI 通过 uv 安装，支持 Python 3.10 环境。依赖 OpenRouter API 密钥进行启动，可配置 TOML 路由文件。
zh.hot: 今日新增 421 星，总星数 819，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名。它解决了将编码代理连接到开源模型的痛点，提供协议翻译和灵活路由，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 开发者希望用 Claude Code 或 Codex 等代理连接开源模型（如 vLLM、NVIDIA NIM、Ollama）
需要跨多个模型进行 A/B 测试或基准测试的团队
希望实现自定义路由算法或信号驱动路由的 AI 应用开发者
需要统一监控 LLM 流量指标（如延迟、令牌数）的运维人员

en.tag: Rust proxy for LLM traffic: translate APIs, route across backends, and run coding agents on open models
en.what: Switchyard is a Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic that routes requests across providers and translates between OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, and OpenAI Responses formats. It enables coding agents like Claude Code or Codex to point at open-source models while keeping the agent speaking its native API.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust proxy server (switchyard-server), a CLI launcher (switchyard launch), and an embeddable library. It offers protocol translation, multi-backend routing (random, LLM-as-classifier, signal-driven), and Prometheus metrics.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with Cargo. The CLI is installed via uv with Python 3.10. It uses OpenRouter API keys for launching and supports TOML route configuration.
en.hot: Gained 421 stars today (total 819), ranking #11 on GitHub Trending. It addresses the pain point of connecting coding agents to open-source models with protocol translation and flexible routing, drawing significant attention.
uses: Developers who want to use coding agents like Claude Code or Codex with open-source models (vLLM, NVIDIA NIM, Ollama)
Teams needing A/B testing or benchmarking across multiple models
AI app developers wanting custom routing algorithms or signal-driven stage routing
Operators needing unified metrics (latency, tokens) for LLM traffic

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 基于 TurboQuant 的超快向量索引，内存省 8 倍
zh.what: turbovec 是一个用 Rust 编写的向量索引，提供 Python 绑定，基于 Google Research 的 TurboQuant 算法。它能在不牺牲速度的情况下大幅降低内存占用，支持在线增量添加、SIMD 加速搜索和增量持久化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库、Python 绑定、Cargo/PyPI 包配置，以及文档和示例。核心是 TurboQuantIndex 和 IdMapIndex 类，提供 add、search、write、load、sync 等 API。
zh.stack: Rust 编写，使用 SIMD 指令（NEON、AVX-512 等），Python 绑定通过 PyO3 实现，依赖 NumPy 处理数组。
zh.hot: star 数 15k+，今日新增 736，因为它在内存占用和搜索速度上超越 FAISS，且无需训练，直接在线索引，非常适合隐私敏感和资源受限的 RAG 场景。
uses: 构建本地或私有化 RAG 系统，需要低内存占用和高搜索性能
处理大规模向量数据（如千万级文档）但内存有限的环境
需要增量更新索引且要求崩溃安全的场景
对数据隐私要求严格，希望完全离线运行的 AI 应用

en.tag: Ultra-fast vector index on TurboQuant, 8x less memory
en.what: turbovec is a Rust vector index with Python bindings, built on Google Research's TurboQuant algorithm. It dramatically reduces memory footprint without sacrificing speed, supporting online incremental ingestion, SIMD-accelerated search, and incremental persistence.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core library, Python bindings, Cargo/PyPI packaging, plus docs and examples. Core classes are TurboQuantIndex and IdMapIndex with add, search, write, load, sync APIs.
en.stack: Written in Rust, uses SIMD instructions (NEON, AVX-512, etc.), Python bindings via PyO3, depends on NumPy for array handling.
en.hot: 15k+ stars, +736 today, because it beats FAISS in memory and speed, requires no training, and supports online indexing, ideal for privacy-sensitive and resource-constrained RAG.
uses: Building local or private RAG systems needing low memory and high search performance
Handling large-scale vector data (e.g., 10M docs) with limited memory
Scenarios requiring incremental index updates with crash safety
AI apps with strict privacy needs, wanting fully offline operation

zh.tag: 开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持多智能体协作
zh.what: OpenPencil 是全球首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持并发智能体团队。用户可以用自然语言描述界面，实时生成到无限画布上，并通过对话修改设计。它采用 Design-as-Code 理念，是 Pencil 的现代替代品。

zh.hot: 作为首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，概念新颖，结合 AI 代理团队和实时生成，吸引了大量关注。今日新增 32 星，总星数达 4772，位列 Rust 趋势榜第三。
