产品经理：用自然语言描述需求，即时生成界面方案。
AI 爱好者：探索多智能体协作在创意工具中的应用。
开源社区：参与开发，扩展 MCP 服务器和模型集成。

en.tag: Open-source AI-native vector design tool with concurrent agent teams
en.what: OpenPencil is the world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent agent teams. uses: Designers and developers: quickly turn ideas into UI prototypes, boosting design efficiency.
Product managers: describe requirements in natural language and get instant interface proposals.

zh.tag: Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，基于 GPUI 构建跨平台应用

前端或全栈工程师在 CI/CD 或本地环境中测试不同 Node 版本的兼容性
初学者希望简单安装和管理 Node.js，避免手动配置环境变量

en.tag: Node.js version manager for Windows, written in Go
en.what: nvm-windows is a Node.js version manager for Windows, allowing users to install, switch, and remove multiple Node.js versions. It is officially recommended by Microsoft, npm, and Google, and is a separate project from the Mac/Linux nvm.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, installation scripts, documentation, and release binaries. It provides commands like nvm install and nvm use, downloading Node versions and managing environment variables.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, it relies on the Node.js runtime and npm ecosystem. It operates via a command-line interface, using system environment variables and symbolic links for version switching.
en.hot: With 47k+ stars, it remains the go-to tool for Node version management on Windows. Gaining 115 stars this week and ranking #8 on the Go weekly trending list, its stability and official recommendations keep it popular.
uses: Windows developers managing multiple Node.js projects and switching versions quickly
Frontend or full-stack engineers testing compatibility across Node versions in CI/CD or locally
Beginners seeking a simple way to install and manage Node.js without manual environment setup

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要组件：hub（基于 PocketBase 的 Web 应用，提供仪表盘）和 agent（运行在被监控系统上，收集指标）。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、温度等指标，并提供截图和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，hub 基于 PocketBase，agent 独立运行。支持 Docker/Podman，可通过 Docker 镜像部署，使用 SQLite 存储数据。
zh.hot: 凭借轻量级、简单易用和丰富的功能（如 Docker 统计、告警、多用户）在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 282 颗星，总星数达 24,566，位列 Go 语言周榜第 9 名。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队，需要轻量级服务器监控且不想部署重量级方案
使用 Docker 运行多个容器的用户，希望跟踪每个容器的资源使用历史
需要设置告警（如 CPU、内存、磁盘）并及时收到通知的运维人员
希望通过 OAuth 集成现有身份认证系统的企业用户

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration, and is ready to use out of the box. It supports automatic backup, multi-user, OAuth authentication, and API access.
en.content: The repository contains two main components: the hub (a PocketBase-based web app providing a dashboard) and the agent (runs on monitored systems, collects metrics). It supports metrics like CPU, memory, disk, network, load, temperature, and includes screenshots and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, the hub is built on PocketBase, and the agent runs independently. Supports Docker/Podman, deployable via Docker images, uses SQLite for data storage.
en.hot: It has gained popularity on GitHub due to its lightweight nature, ease of use, and rich features (like Docker stats, alerts, multi-user). It gained 282 stars this week, reaching 24,566 total, ranking 9th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams needing lightweight server monitoring without heavyweight solutions
Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container
Ops personnel who need to set alerts (e.g., CPU, memory, disk) and receive timely notifications
Enterprise users who want to integrate existing authentication via OAuth

zh.tag: 现代跨平台任务运行器，Make 的替代品
zh.what: Task 是一个受 Make 启发但面向现代工作流的快速跨平台构建工具。它使用简单的 YAML 文件定义任务，支持依赖、并行执行和 shell 命令，旨在替代 Make 提供更直观、可维护的自动化体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的命令行工具源码、完整的文档网站（位于 website/ 目录）、示例任务文件以及用于测试的集成测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 YAML 解析库（如 goccy/go-yaml）和 mvdan/sh 用于 shell 解释，支持跨平台编译。
zh.hot: 拥有 16k+ 星标，本周新增 53 星，位列 Go 周榜第 10。作为 Make 的现代替代品，它解决了 Make 的跨平台和语法问题，受到开发者社区的持续关注。
uses: 开发者日常自动化任务，如构建、测试、部署等，替代 Makefile 提供更清晰的语法。
跨平台项目（Windows/macOS/Linux）需要统一任务命令的场景，避免 shell 差异。
CI/CD 流水线中定义和执行步骤，利用并行执行和依赖管理提升效率。

en.tag: A modern cross-platform task runner, a faster and simpler alternative to Make
en.what: Task is a fast, cross-platform build tool inspired by Make, designed for modern workflows. It uses a simple YAML file to define tasks, supports dependencies, parallel execution, and shell commands, aiming to replace Make with a more intuitive and maintainable automation experience.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of the CLI tool written in Go, a full documentation website (in the website/ directory), example task files, and integration tests.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it relies on YAML parsing libraries (e.g., goccy/go-yaml) and mvdan/sh for shell interpretation, with cross-platform compilation support.
en.hot: With 16k+ stars and 53 new stars this week, ranking 10th on the Go weekly trending list. As a modern alternative to Make, it solves Make's cross-platform and syntax issues, gaining sustained attention from the developer community.
uses: Developers automating daily tasks like build, test, and deploy, replacing Makefiles with cleaner syntax.
Cross-platform projects (Windows/macOS/Linux) needing unified task commands, avoiding shell differences.
Defining and executing steps in CI/CD pipelines, leveraging parallel execution and dependency management for efficiency.

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的开源门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证和授权服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）。它作为反向代理的认证门户，保护应用并集中管理用户身份。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Authelia 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置、Docker 镜像构建文件以及用于测试的自动化脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Redis 或 SQLite 作为存储后端，支持 LDAP 和 OAuth2/OIDC 集成。
zh.hot: 因其开源、自托管且通过 OpenID 认证的 SSO/MFA 方案而广受好评，本周新增 89 星，总星数达 28661，位列 Go 周榜第 11。
uses: 希望为家庭或自建服务添加统一登录和双因素认证的开发者
需要为企业内部应用提供集中身份认证和访问控制的管理员
对数据隐私敏感、希望避免使用商业 SSO 服务的组织

en.tag: Open-source SSO and MFA portal for web apps, OpenID Certified
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication and authorization server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication portal behind a reverse proxy, securing apps and centralizing user identity.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, Docker image build files, and automated test scripts for Authelia.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with Redis or SQLite as storage backends, and supports LDAP and OAuth2/OIDC integration.
en.hot: Praised for its open-source, self-hosted, OpenID Certified SSO/MFA solution, it gained 89 stars this week, reaching 28,661 total, ranking #11 on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Developers looking to add unified login and 2FA to home-lab or self-hosted services
Administrators needing centralized authentication and access control for internal enterprise apps
Organizations with data privacy concerns that prefer avoiding commercial SSO services

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理和 IDE 打造的高性能代码智能引擎
zh.what: Gortex 是一个高性能的代码智能引擎，专为 AI 代理和 IDE 设计。它将代码索引为图结构，并通过 CLI、MCP 服务器和 Web UI 提供访问，支持多仓库，默认支持 257 种语言。它通过只暴露必要信息，可将 token 消耗降低最多 50 倍。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用 Go 编写的静态二进制文件，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，无依赖链。它使用 tree-sitter 进行 AST 分析，并为多种语言提供编译器级解析，生成持久化的知识图谱，包含函数、类、调用链、HTTP 路由等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 tree-sitter 进行语法解析，并集成了 MCP 服务器、CLI 和 Web UI。支持 19 种编码代理，提供 175 个可配置的 MCP 工具。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 144 星，位居 Go 语言第 10 名。其亮点是能大幅减少 token 消耗（最高 50 倍），且完全本地化，吸引了 AI 编码代理用户。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者：集成 Gortex 以增强代码理解并减少 token 消耗。
IDE 用户：通过 MCP 或 CLI 获取代码智能，提升编码效率。
多仓库项目团队：利用其多仓库支持进行跨服务分析。
对隐私敏感的用户：完全本地运行，无需云端依赖。

en.tag: High-performance code-intelligence engine for AI agents and IDE
en.what: Gortex is a high-performance code-intelligence engine designed for AI agents and IDEs. It indexes code into a graph and exposes it via CLI, MCP Server, and web UI, with multi-repository support by default and support for 257 languages. By exposing only needed information, it cuts token usage by up to 50x.
en.content: The repository contains a single static binary written in Go, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows with no dependency chain. It uses tree-sitter for AST analysis and compiler-grade resolution for many languages, producing a persistent knowledge graph of functions, classes, call chains, HTTP routes, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging tree-sitter for parsing, with MCP server, CLI, and web UI. Supports 19 coding agents and offers 175 configurable MCP tools.
en.hot: Gained 144 stars today, ranking #10 in Go on GitHub Trending. Its ability to cut token usage by up to 50x and being 100% local attracts AI coding agent users.
uses: AI coding agent developers: integrate Gortex to enhance code understanding and reduce token usage.
IDE users: get code intelligence via MCP or CLI to boost coding efficiency.
Teams with multi-repo projects: leverage its multi-repository support for cross-service analysis.
Privacy-conscious users: runs 100% locally with no cloud dependency.

zh.tag: AI 原生网络安全作战系统，意图驱动、证据留痕、可回放
zh.what: CyberStrikeAI 是一个将规划、执行、人工监督、证据和回放整合在统一可审计工作空间中的 AI 原生网络安全平台。它基于 Go 构建，结合 Eino 驱动的智能体、MCP 原生工具、RAG 知识库、可视化工作流以及攻击链建模与分析，用于授权安全操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台代码、文档（中英文）、安全模型与加固指南，以及丰富的界面截图（仪表盘、Web 控制台、任务管理、漏洞管理、WebShell 管理、MCP 管理、知识库、技能管理等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，集成 Eino（字节跳动开源的 LLM 应用开发框架）驱动的智能体、MCP（模型上下文协议）原生工具、RAG 知识库，以及可视化工作流和攻击链建模。
zh.hot: 本周新增 148 星，总星数达 5879，登上 GitHub Trending（Go 语言）周榜第 14 名。其将 AI 智能体与网络安全操作结合，提供可审计、可回放的工作流，满足了安全领域对自动化与透明度的双重需求。
uses: 红队与渗透测试人员：在授权范围内利用 AI 辅助规划与执行攻击链测试，并保留完整证据。
安全运营团队：通过可视化工作流和人工监督，自动化日常安全任务，提升响应效率。
安全研究人员：利用 RAG 知识库和攻击链建模分析，探索 AI 驱动的安全自动化。
企业安全架构师：评估并部署 AI 原生安全平台，确保合规与可审计性。

en.tag: AI-native cybersecurity system of action: intent-driven, evidence-backed, replayable
en.what: CyberStrikeAI is an AI-native cybersecurity platform that unifies planning, execution, human oversight, evidence, and replay in one auditable workspace. Built in Go, it combines Eino-powered agents, MCP-native tools, RAG knowledge, visual workflows, and attack-chain modeling and analysis for authorized security operations.
en.content: The repository contains full platform code, documentation (EN/CN), security model and hardening guide, and extensive UI screenshots (dashboard, web console, task management, vulnerability management, WebShell management, MCP management, knowledge base, skills management, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily Go, integrating Eino-powered agents (ByteDance's LLM app framework), MCP-native tools, RAG knowledge base, visual workflows, and attack-chain modeling.
en.hot: Gained 148 stars this week, reaching 5,879 total, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending (Go). It merges AI agents with cybersecurity operations, offering auditable and replayable workflows, addressing the dual need for automation and transparency in security.
uses: Red teams and pentesters: use AI-assisted planning and execution for authorized attack-chain testing with full evidence.
Security operations teams: automate routine security tasks with visual workflows and human oversight, improving response efficiency.
Security researchers: leverage RAG knowledge base and attack-chain modeling to explore AI-driven security automation.
Enterprise security architects: evaluate and deploy AI-native security platforms ensuring compliance and auditability.

zh.tag: 极简自托管 OIDC/OAuth2 提供商，支持 Passkey 登录
zh.what: Pocket ID 是一个易于使用的 OpenID Connect Certified™ 和 OAuth 2.0 提供商，允许用户通过 Passkey（如 YubiKey）登录你的应用。它旨在简化自托管身份验证，避免 Keycloak 等复杂方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Pocket ID 的完整源代码，包括后端（Go）、前端界面、Docker 部署配置、文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持 Docker 部署，集成了 OpenID Connect 和 OAuth 2.0 协议，以及 WebAuthn（Passkey）认证。
zh.hot: Pocket ID 因提供极简的 Passkey 优先身份验证方案而受到关注，本周新增 162 星，总星数达 8988，在 GitHub 周榜 Go 语言中排名第 14。
uses: 自托管服务用户：希望用 YubiKey 等 Passkey 统一登录多个自托管应用，无需记住密码。
开发者：需要为应用集成 OIDC/OAuth2 认证，但不想部署和维护 Keycloak 等重量级方案。
小型团队或个人：寻求简单、安全的身份验证解决方案，减少密码泄露风险。

en.tag: Minimal self-hosted OIDC/OAuth2 provider with passkey-only auth
en.what: Pocket ID is an easy-to-use OpenID Connect Certified™ and OAuth 2.0 provider that lets users sign in to your applications with passkeys. It aims to simplify self-hosted authentication, avoiding the complexity of solutions like Keycloak.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Pocket ID, including backend (Go), frontend UI, Docker deployment configs, documentation, and contribution guide.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports Docker deployment, integrates OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 protocols, and WebAuthn (passkey) authentication.
en.hot: Pocket ID gains attention for its minimal passkey-first authentication approach, adding 162 stars this week to reach 8988 total, ranking #14 on GitHub's Go weekly trending.
uses: Self-hosters: Want to use passkeys like YubiKey to sign in to multiple self-hosted apps without passwords.
Developers: Need OIDC/OAuth2 authentication for apps but want a lightweight alternative to Keycloak.
Small teams/individuals: Seek simple, secure auth to reduce password-related risks.

zh.tag: Go 语言高性能并行 Lint 工具
zh.what: golangci-lint 是一个快速运行的 Go 语言 linter 聚合工具，它并行执行多个 linter，利用缓存加速，支持 YAML 配置，并集成主流 IDE。它内置超过一百种 linter，帮助开发者发现代码中的错误、风格问题和潜在缺陷。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、文档（位于 golangci-lint.run）、安装脚本、CI 配置、Docker 镜像以及贡献者列表。核心是一个命令行工具，通过配置文件选择并运行多个 linter。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 生态中的各种 linter 库，支持 YAML 配置，并提供 Docker 镜像和 CI 集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 社区的标准 lint 工具，拥有 19k+ star，今日新增 9 星并登上 Go 日榜，因其高效并行和丰富 linter 集成而广受欢迎。
uses: Go 开发者：在本地开发或 CI 中运行 lint 检查，提升代码质量
团队协作：统一代码风格和规范，减少 review 时间
开源项目维护者：集成到 CI 流程，自动检查 PR 代码

en.tag: Fast parallel linter runner for Go with caching and 100+ linters
en.what: golangci-lint is a fast linter runner for Go that executes linters in parallel, uses caching, supports YAML configuration, and integrates with major IDEs. It includes over a hundred linters to help developers catch errors, style issues, and potential bugs.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, documentation (hosted at golangci-lint.run), installation scripts, CI configs, Docker images, and a contributors list. The core is a CLI tool that runs multiple linters via configuration.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging various linter libraries from the Go ecosystem, supports YAML config, and provides Docker images and CI integration.
en.hot: As the standard lint tool for Go, it has 19k+ stars, gained 9 stars today, and ranked #4 on the Go daily trending list, popular for its parallel efficiency and extensive linter integration.
uses: Go developers: run lint checks locally or in CI to improve code quality
Teams: unify code style and standards, reduce review time
Open-source maintainers: integrate into CI to automatically check PRs

zh.tag: 内网安全扫描与漏洞检测一体化工具
zh.what: fscan 是一款内网综合扫描工具，支持主机发现、端口扫描、服务识别、Web 探测、弱口令爆破、漏洞检测与利用等功能。它旨在通过一条命令实现自动化全方位漏扫，帮助安全人员快速评估内网安全状况。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，提供丰富的扫描、爆破、漏洞检测与利用模块，以及本地信息收集、凭据获取、权限维持等功能。还包含 Web 管理界面（可选编译）、Go SDK（pkg/fscan）、Docker 靶场环境、插件化架构和多种输出格式。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 go-i18n 实现国际化，支持 xray/afrog 格式 POC，集成 grdp 库进行 RDP 认证，使用 CEL 表达式引擎进行 POC 匹配，支持 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理。
zh.hot: fscan 在 GitHub 上拥有 14k+ stars，今日新增 27 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 7。其热度源于功能全面、一键自动化、持续更新（v2.1.0 包含 262 个提交），且内置大量指纹和 POC，深受红队和安全运维人员喜爱。
uses: 红队/渗透测试人员：快速评估内网资产暴露面与漏洞
安全运维/蓝队：定期内网安全巡检与漏洞排查
安全研究学习者：通过内置靶场和插件架构学习扫描与利用技术
安全平台集成：通过 SDK 嵌入 Agent 或自动化流程

en.tag: All-in-one intranet security scanner and vulnerability detection tool
en.what: fscan is an intranet comprehensive scanning tool that supports host discovery, port scanning, service identification, web probing, weak password brute-forcing, vulnerability detection, and exploitation. It aims to automate all-round vulnerability scanning with a single command, helping security professionals quickly assess intranet security posture.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-written CLI tool with extensive scanning, brute-forcing, vulnerability detection, and exploitation modules, plus local information gathering, credential harvesting, and persistence features. It also includes an optional web management UI, a Go SDK (pkg/fscan), Docker lab environments, a plugin architecture, and multiple output formats.
en.stack: Developed in Go, uses go-i18n for internationalization, supports xray/afrog POC formats, integrates grdp for RDP authentication, uses CEL expression engine for POC matching, and supports HTTP/SOCKS5 proxies.
en.hot: fscan has over 14k stars on GitHub, with 27 new stars today, ranking 7th on the Go trending list. Its popularity stems from its comprehensive features, one-click automation, continuous updates (v2.1.0 includes 262 commits), and a large built-in fingerprint and POC database, making it a favorite among red teams and security operations.
uses: Red team/pentesters: quickly assess intranet asset exposure and vulnerabilities
Security ops/blue team: regular intranet security audits and vulnerability checks
Security researchers/learners: use built-in labs and plugin architecture to learn scanning and exploitation
Security platform integration: embed via SDK into agents or automated workflows

zh.tag: 本地终端 AI 编程代理，模型与权限全由你掌控
zh.what: Zero 是一个运行在本地终端中的 AI 编程代理，可以检查仓库、编辑文件、执行命令，并使用浏览器/终端辅助工具。它支持持久化的本地会话，同时让你自由选择模型和权限级别。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Zero 的完整源代码，包括 TUI（终端用户界面）和可脚本化的 `zero exec` 命令，以及安装脚本、文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，要求 Go 1.26.5+。支持多种 AI 模型提供商，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等，并兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 接口。
zh.hot: 今日新增 72 星，总星数 1546，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）第 3 名。其“你拥有”的核心理念——自由选择模型、完全掌控权限、本地存储会话——吸引了追求自主性和隐私的开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在本地终端中使用 AI 编程助手，同时保留对模型和权限的完全控制。
团队需要可脚本化的 AI 代理，用于 CI/CD 流程或自动化任务，支持 JSON 输出和退出码。
注重隐私的用户，希望会话数据仅存储在本地，不进行遥测上传。
需要扩展性的用户，可通过 MCP、技能、插件和子代理定制功能。

en.tag: A terminal coding agent you own: your model, your machine, your rules.
en.what: Zero is an AI coding agent for your local terminal. It can inspect a repository, edit files, run commands, use browser/terminal helpers, and keep durable local sessions while you choose the model and the permission level.

Hardware vendors: provide low-latency, low-power AI inference for smart home and robotics devices.
Edge computing researchers: explore hybrid edge-cloud inference and novel quantization techniques in practice.

Testing and certification bodies: Use test suites to verify device compliance with the Matter specification

zh.tag: 可扩展分布式梯度提升库，支持多语言多平台
zh.what: XGBoost 是一个优化的分布式梯度提升库，旨在高效、灵活且可移植地实现梯度提升框架下的机器学习算法。它提供并行树提升（GBDT、GBM），能快速准确地解决许多数据科学问题，并支持超过数十亿样本的分布式环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、多语言接口（Python、R、Java、Scala、C 等）、分布式集成（Hadoop、Spark、Dask、Flink、DataFlow）、文档、演示和社区资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、R、Java、Scala 等语言的 API，支持多种分布式框架如 Spark、Dask、Flink 等。
zh.hot: XGBoost 是机器学习竞赛和工业界的经典工具，拥有 28687 颗星，本周新增 35 颗，持续活跃。其高效性和广泛的语言支持使其成为数据科学家的首选。
uses: 数据科学家和机器学习工程师用于分类、回归和排序等监督学习任务。
竞赛选手（如 Kaggle）常用 XGBoost 构建高性能模型。
需要在大规模数据上训练模型的团队，利用其分布式能力。
研究者和学生用于学习和实验梯度提升算法。

en.tag: Scalable, portable distributed gradient boosting library for multiple languages and platforms
en.what: XGBoost is an optimized distributed gradient boosting library designed to be highly efficient, flexible, and portable. It implements machine learning algorithms under the Gradient Boosting framework, providing parallel tree boosting (GBDT, GBM) that solves many data science problems fast and accurately, and can handle problems beyond billions of examples in distributed environments.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ implementation, multi-language interfaces (Python, R, Java, Scala, C, etc.), distributed integrations (Hadoop, Spark, Dask, Flink, DataFlow), documentation, demos, and community resources.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with APIs for Python, R, Java, Scala, and more, and supports distributed frameworks like Spark, Dask, Flink, etc.
en.hot: XGBoost is a classic tool in machine learning competitions and industry, with 28,687 stars and 35 new this week, remaining highly active. Its efficiency and broad language support make it a top choice for data scientists.
uses: Data scientists and ML engineers use it for supervised learning tasks like classification, regression, and ranking.
Competition participants (e.g., Kaggle) often use XGBoost to build high-performance models.
Teams needing to train models on massive datasets leverage its distributed capabilities.
Researchers and students use it to learn and experiment with gradient boosting algorithms.

zh.tag: 为 AMD 硬件优化的 llama.cpp 实验性量化格式家族
zh.what: ROCmFPX 为 llama.cpp 添加了针对 AMD 硬件的实验性 2、3、4、6、8 位 GGUF 模型权重格式，包含 CPU 参考路径和加速的 HIP/ROCm 与 Vulkan 内核。它旨在提升 AMD GPU 上的推理性能，并提供了多种量化选项。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ROCmFP2、ROCmFP4 等格式的实现，以及相关的内核、验证工具和基准测试。当前 ROCmFP2 和 ROCmFP4 已优化并验证，而 ROCmFP3、ROCmFP6 和 ROCmFP8 仍处于开发预览阶段。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，依赖 llama.cpp、HIP/ROCm 和 Vulkan 技术栈，用于 AMD GPU 加速。
zh.hot: 本周新增 82 颗星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（C++ 周榜第 11 名）。AMD 官方提供硬件支持，且 ROCmFP2 在 Vulkan 上相比 ROCmFP4 有 18.5% 的性能提升，吸引了 AMD 用户和量化爱好者。
uses: AMD GPU 用户：希望在 llama.cpp 上获得更好推理性能的开发者。
量化研究者：探索新的低比特量化格式和性能优化。
开源 AI 爱好者：关注 AMD 生态和开源大模型推理的进展。

en.tag: Experimental AMD-focused GGUF quantization formats for llama.cpp
en.what: ROCmFPX adds experimental 2-, 3-, 4-, 6-, and 8-bit GGUF model-weight formats to llama.cpp, with CPU reference paths and accelerated HIP/ROCm and Vulkan kernels. It aims to improve inference performance on AMD hardware and offers a range of quantization options.
en.content: The repository contains implementations of formats like ROCmFP2 and ROCmFP4, along with associated kernels, validation tools, and benchmarks. ROCmFP2 and ROCmFP4 are optimized and validated, while ROCmFP3, ROCmFP6, and ROCmFP8 are in development preview.
en.stack: Built on C++, leveraging llama.cpp, HIP/ROCm, and Vulkan for AMD GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Gained 82 stars this week, ranking 11th on GitHub Trending (C++ weekly). AMD officially provides hardware support, and ROCmFP2 shows up to 18.5% performance improvement over ROCmFP4 on Vulkan, attracting AMD users and quantization enthusiasts.
uses: AMD GPU users: developers seeking better inference performance on llama.cpp.
Quantization researchers: exploring new low-bit formats and performance optimizations.
Open-source AI enthusiasts: following AMD ecosystem and open-source LLM inference progress.

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及构建和测试脚本。它提供了预编译的二进制文件，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript，依赖 Chromium 和 Node.js。通过 npm 安装，支持多种平台架构。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 12 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的桌面应用框架之一。今日新增 8 颗星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 开发者：希望用 Web 技术快速构建跨平台桌面应用的开发者
团队：需要为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供一致体验的产品团队
学习者：想学习桌面应用开发或了解 Chromium 和 Node.js 集成的学习者

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
uses: Developers: those who want to quickly build cross-platform desktop apps using web technologies
Teams: product teams needing consistent experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Learners: those interested in desktop app development or the integration of Chromium and Node.js

zh.tag: 用 QtQuick 打造 Wayland/X11 桌面外壳的灵活工具包
zh.what: Quickshell 是一个用于创建桌面外壳（如任务栏、启动器、小部件）的工具包，基于 QtQuick 技术。它支持 Wayland 和 X11 显示服务器，提供灵活的 API 和组件，让开发者能够快速构建自定义的桌面环境界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、QML 模块、示例配置和文档，以及构建和贡献指南（如 HACKING.md、CONTRIBUTING.md、BUILD.md）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 QML（QtQuick），依赖 Qt 框架，支持 Wayland 和 X11 协议。
zh.hot: 随着 Linux 桌面自定义需求的增长，Quickshell 提供了比传统方式更灵活的开发体验，本周新增 72 星，登上 GitHub 周榜 C++ 第 12 名，受到开发者关注。
uses: Linux 桌面用户希望深度定制自己的桌面环境，如创建独特的状态栏或启动器。
Qt/QML 开发者想利用熟悉的技能快速构建跨 Wayland/X11 的桌面组件。
发行版维护者或主题制作者需要为特定桌面环境提供可复用的外壳组件。

en.tag: Flexible toolkit for building desktop shells with QtQuick on Wayland and X11
en.what: Quickshell is a toolkit for creating desktop shells (such as taskbars, launchers, widgets) based on QtQuick. It supports Wayland and X11 display servers, offering flexible APIs and components for developers to quickly build custom desktop environment interfaces.
en.content: The repository contains core libraries, QML modules, example configurations, documentation, and contribution guidelines (HACKING.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, BUILD.md).
en.stack: Primarily uses C++ and QML (QtQuick), depends on Qt framework, supports Wayland and X11 protocols.
en.hot: With growing demand for Linux desktop customization, Quickshell offers a more flexible development experience than traditional methods. It gained 72 stars this week, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending (C++), attracting developer attention.
uses: Linux desktop users who want to deeply customize their desktop environment, such as creating unique status bars or launchers.
Qt/QML developers looking to leverage familiar skills to quickly build desktop components across Wayland/X11.
Distribution maintainers or theme creators needing reusable shell components for specific desktop environments.

zh.tag: 在 AMD Ryzen AI NPU 上快速运行大模型的轻量运行时
zh.what: FastFlowLM 是一个专为 AMD Ryzen AI NPU 深度优化的 LLM 运行时，无需 GPU 即可在 NPU 上运行大模型，支持视觉、音频、嵌入和 MoE 模型，上下文长度可达 256k tokens。它安装快、体积小（17MB），功耗比 GPU 低 10 倍以上，旨在让 AMD NPU 发挥最大潜力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Windows 安装程序（flm-setup.msi）、Linux 入门指南、文档链接、基准测试和模型列表，以及命令行工具（如 flm run llama3.2:1b）。核心是 NPU 优化的内核和运行时，支持通过 HuggingFace 下载模型。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 AMD NPU 驱动（32.0.203.311 或更高版本），模型通过 HuggingFace 获取，支持 Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.hot: 作为 ROCm 官方项目，它填补了 AMD NPU 上运行 LLM 的空白，提供类似 Ollama 的体验但针对 NPU 深度优化，吸引了大量 AMD 用户和 AI 开发者。本周新增 48 星，总星数达 1790，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜。
uses: AMD Ryzen AI 笔记本用户：无需 GPU 即可本地运行大模型，适合隐私敏感或离线场景。
AI 开发者：快速原型验证和部署视觉、音频、MoE 模型，利用 NPU 的能效优势。
边缘计算爱好者：在低功耗设备上运行 LLM，降低能耗和硬件成本。

en.tag: Run LLMs on AMD Ryzen AI NPUs in minutes — lightweight, NPU-first runtime
en.what: FastFlowLM is an NPU-first runtime built exclusively for AMD Ryzen AI NPUs, enabling LLMs to run without a GPU. It supports vision, audio, embedding, and MoE models, with context lengths up to 256k tokens. It is ultra-lightweight (17MB), installs in under 20 seconds, and claims over 10x power efficiency compared to GPUs.
en.content: The repository provides a Windows installer (flm-setup.msi), Linux getting-started guide, docs, benchmarks, and model lists. It includes a CLI tool (e.g., flm run llama3.2:1b) and NPU-optimized kernels, with models downloaded from HuggingFace.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on AMD NPU drivers (32.0.203.311+), fetches models from HuggingFace, and supports Windows and Linux platforms.
en.hot: As an official ROCm project, it fills the gap for running LLMs on AMD NPUs, offering an Ollama-like experience but deeply optimized for NPUs, attracting AMD users and AI developers. With 48 new stars this week and 1790 total, it hit #13 on GitHub Trending C++ weekly.
uses: AMD Ryzen AI laptop users: run LLMs locally without a GPU, ideal for privacy-sensitive or offline scenarios.
AI developers: quickly prototype and deploy vision, audio, and MoE models, leveraging NPU efficiency.
Edge computing enthusiasts: run LLMs on low-power devices, reducing energy consumption and hardware costs.

zh.tag: 用手机指纹/人脸解锁电脑的桌面端应用
zh.what: PC Bio Unlock 是一款桌面应用，让你用 Android 手机上的指纹或人脸识别来解锁电脑，替代在登录界面输入密码。它通过 Wi-Fi、局域网或蓝牙与手机通信，无需互联网连接，并支持自动发现电脑和二维码配对。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端应用源码，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS（实验性），涵盖登录界面、UAC 提示、sudo 和 polkit 等场景。安装指南和发布页面在 README 中提供。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，跨平台支持 x64 和 ARM 架构，并集成 Wake-on-LAN 功能。依赖系统级认证接口和加密通信。
zh.hot: 本周新增 40 颗星，总星数 418，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（C++ 周榜第 14 名）。其新颖的“手机解锁电脑”概念和无需互联网的隐私设计吸引了关注。
uses: 经常忘记密码或希望快速解锁电脑的用户，可用手机生物识别代替输入。
注重安全隐私的用户，因为密码永不离机，且通信加密。
多设备用户，可配对多部手机，并支持不同账户不同手机。

en.tag: Desktop app to unlock your PC with your phone's fingerprint or face
en.what: PC Bio Unlock is a desktop app that lets you unlock your PC using fingerprint or face recognition on your Android phone, replacing password entry at login screens. It communicates over Wi-Fi, LAN, or Bluetooth without needing an internet connection, and supports automatic PC discovery and QR code pairing.
en.content: The repository contains the desktop app source code, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS (experimental), covering login screens, UAC prompts, sudo, and polkit scenarios. Installation guides and release pages are provided in the README.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with cross-platform support for x64 and ARM, and integrated Wake-on-LAN. It relies on system-level authentication interfaces and encrypted communication.
en.hot: Gained 40 stars this week, reaching 418 total, and hit #14 on GitHub Trending (C++ weekly). Its novel 'unlock PC with phone' concept and privacy-focused design without internet requirement attract attention.
uses: Users who often forget passwords or want quick unlocking can use phone biometrics instead of typing.
Security-conscious users benefit from the password never leaving the PC and encrypted communication.
Multi-device users can pair multiple phones, with different phones for different accounts.

zh.tag: Google 跨语言结构化数据序列化协议
zh.what: Protocol Buffers 是 Google 开发的跨语言、跨平台的数据交换格式，用于高效序列化结构化数据。它通过定义 .proto 文件，自动生成多种语言的代码，实现数据的快速编码与解码。
zh.content: 仓库包含协议编译器（protoc）的 C++ 实现、各语言运行时库、以及丰富的文档和构建配置（如 Bazel 和 CMake）。
zh.stack: 核心使用 C++ 编写，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建，并集成 OpenSSF Scorecard 安全评估。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，被无数项目和系统依赖，star 数高达 7 万+，持续稳定更新。
uses: 后端服务间通信协议定义（如 gRPC）
大数据与分布式系统的数据存储与交换
跨语言 API 开发，需要高效序列化的场景
学习高性能序列化设计与实现

en.tag: Google's language-neutral data serialization protocol
en.what: Protocol Buffers is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It uses .proto files to generate code in multiple languages for efficient encoding and decoding.
en.content: The repository contains the C++ implementation of the protocol compiler (protoc), runtime libraries for various languages, and extensive documentation and build configurations (e.g., Bazel and CMake).
en.stack: Core written in C++, built with Bazel and CMake, and integrated with OpenSSF Scorecard for security assessment.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, it is relied upon by countless projects and systems, with over 70k stars and continuous stable updates.
uses: Defining communication protocols between backend services (e.g., gRPC)
Data storage and exchange in big data and distributed systems
Cross-language API development requiring efficient serialization
Learning high-performance serialization design and implementation

zh.tag: 在 Linux 上为 Vulkan 游戏启用帧生成的开源层
zh.what: lsfg-vk 是一个 Vulkan 层，它通过钩住 Vulkan 应用程序，利用 Lossless Scaling 的帧生成算法来生成额外的帧，从而在 Linux 上实现类似 Windows 的 Lossless Scaling 功能。它允许 Linux 用户（尤其是 Steam Deck 等掌机用户）在游戏中使用帧生成技术，提升流畅度。
zh.content: 仓库包含 lsfg-vk 的源代码、预编译的二进制发布包、GUI 配置工具（基于 Qt6）、文档（如配置指南、Flatpak 指南）以及示例配置。还提供了 Decky 插件，方便 Steam Deck 用户安装和配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan API 和 Qt6（用于 GUI）。需要系统安装 Qt6 相关包，并需要 Steam 上的 Lossless Scaling 软件。
zh.hot: 该仓库本周新增 41 个 star，总 star 数达 4690，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜（C++）第 17 名。它填补了 Linux 上帧生成功能的空白，尤其受到 Steam Deck 用户的欢迎。
uses: Linux 游戏玩家，希望在不更换硬件的情况下提升游戏帧率。
Steam Deck 或其他掌机用户，通过 Decky 插件轻松启用帧生成。
对 Vulkan 层开发感兴趣的开发者，可学习如何实现帧生成算法。

en.tag: Open-source Vulkan layer enabling frame generation for Linux games
en.what: lsfg-vk is a Vulkan layer that hooks into Vulkan applications and generates additional frames using Lossless Scaling's frame generation algorithm, bringing the functionality of the Windows-exclusive Lossless Scaling to Linux. It enables Linux users, especially handheld gamers, to use frame generation in games for smoother visuals.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, precompiled release binaries, a Qt6-based GUI configuration tool, documentation (configuration guide, Flatpak guide), and example configs. A Decky plugin is also available for easy installation on Steam Deck.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it relies on the Vulkan API and Qt6 for the GUI. Requires Qt6 packages and the Lossless Scaling software from Steam.
en.hot: With 41 new stars this week and 4690 total, it ranks #17 on GitHub Trending (C++) this week. It fills a gap in frame generation on Linux, especially popular among Steam Deck users.
uses: Linux gamers who want to boost frame rates without upgrading hardware.
Steam Deck and handheld users who can enable frame generation easily via the Decky plugin.
Developers interested in Vulkan layer development and frame generation algorithms.

zh.tag: 自制原生C++魔兽世界客户端，Vulkan渲染器
zh.what: WoWee 是一个开源的《魔兽世界》引擎实验项目，用 C++ 和 Vulkan 实现了自定义客户端。它支持多个经典版本，并兼容多种主流服务端，旨在作为教育和研究用途。
zh.content: 仓库包含客户端源码、文档、资源提取器以及预编译的发布版本。代码组织为模块化结构，涵盖渲染、网络、游戏逻辑和平台适配等部分。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Vulkan 渲染 API，依赖 Unicorn Engine 用于 Warden 模拟，StormLib 用于资源提取。支持 x86-64 和 ARM64 架构，覆盖 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 Android 平台。
zh.hot: 本周新增 54 颗星，总星数达 659，登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 9 名。其独特的自制客户端定位和对多版本、多平台的支持吸引了大量魔兽世界爱好者和技术研究者。
uses: 魔兽世界玩家：体验自定义客户端，探索经典版本的新玩法
游戏开发学习者：研究现代渲染、网络协议和游戏引擎实现
逆向工程爱好者：分析游戏协议和客户端架构
开源贡献者：参与功能开发、测试和文档完善

en.tag: Custom native C++ WoW client with Vulkan renderer
en.what: WoWee is an open-source World of Warcraft engine experiment, implementing a custom client in C++ with a Vulkan renderer. It supports multiple classic expansions and is compatible with several popular server emulators, intended for educational and research purposes.
en.content: The repository contains client source code, documentation, an asset extractor, and prebuilt releases. The code is organized modularly, covering rendering, networking, game logic, and platform adaptation.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Vulkan rendering API, leveraging Unicorn Engine for Warden emulation and StormLib for asset extraction. Supports x86-64 and ARM64 architectures across Linux, macOS, Windows, and Android.
en.hot: Gained 54 stars this week, reaching 659 total, ranking #9 on GitHub's C++ weekly trending. Its unique custom client approach and support for multiple expansions and platforms attract WoW enthusiasts and tech researchers.
uses: WoW players: experience a custom client and explore classic versions
Game dev learners: study modern rendering, networking, and engine implementation
Reverse engineering enthusiasts: analyze game protocols and client architecture
Open source contributors: participate in feature development, testing, and documentation

zh.tag: 单文件分发与运行大模型的工具
zh.what: llamafile 是一个 Mozilla 项目，旨在通过将 llama.cpp 与 Cosmopolitan Libc 结合，将大语言模型打包成单个可执行文件，用户无需安装即可在多种操作系统和 CPU 架构上本地运行。它还包含 whisperfile，一个基于 whisper.cpp 的单文件语音转文字工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 llamafile 的源代码、构建系统、文档以及预构建的 llamafile 示例（如 LLaVA 模型）。项目从 0.10.0 版本开始采用新构建系统，以保持与最新 llama.cpp 的兼容性。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，依赖 llama.cpp、whisper.cpp 和 Cosmopolitan Libc。
zh.hot: llamafile 简化了 LLM 的分发和运行，无需安装即可跨平台使用，star 数达 25k+，本周新增 125，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 11。
uses: 开发者：快速分发和部署 LLM 应用，无需复杂环境配置
终端用户：直接运行预构建的 llamafile，体验本地大模型
语音处理：使用 whisperfile 进行音频转录和翻译

en.tag: Distribute and run LLMs with a single file
en.what: llamafile is a Mozilla project that combines llama.cpp with Cosmopolitan Libc to package large language models into a single executable file, allowing users to run them locally on most OSes and CPU architectures without installation. It also includes whisperfile, a single-file speech-to-text tool based on whisper.cpp.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build system, documentation, and pre-built llamafile examples (e.g., LLaVA models). Starting from version 0.10.0, it uses a new build system to stay aligned with the latest llama.cpp.
en.stack: Built on C++, leveraging llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, and Cosmopolitan Libc.
en.hot: llamafile simplifies LLM distribution and execution with cross-platform, no-install single files, amassing 25k+ stars with 125 new this week, ranking #11 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Developers: quickly distribute and deploy LLM apps without complex setup
End users: run pre-built llamafiles to experience local LLMs

en.tag: Open-source desktop app for sharing AI workflows and cross-agent collaboration
en.what: OpenWork is a free, open-source desktop app for sharing AI workflows. It serves as an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork and Codex for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Users can integrate it via MCP into agents like Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, etc., reusing skills, MCPs, and connected services.
en.content: The repo includes the desktop app source code, MCP integration guides, OpenWork Den organization admin documentation, and installation scripts/config files.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on MCP protocol and remote API, integrates with various AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, it fills the gap in AI workflow sharing. 17k+ Stars indicate strong community demand for cross-agent collaboration tools.
uses: AI developers — reuse skills and MCPs across different agents for efficiency
Team collaboration — manage workflows and permissions via OpenWork Den
Individual users — create and share AI workflows, or use the desktop app locally

zh.tag: 轻量云原生 GIS 平台，跨端运行且数据本地化
zh.what: GeoLibre 是一个免费开源的轻量级云原生 GIS 平台，用于可视化、探索和分析地理空间数据。它可在浏览器、桌面、移动端和 Jupyter 笔记本中运行，同时保持数据本地和私密。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、示例和插件系统，提供 Web 应用、桌面应用、移动应用以及 Python/R 包。内置 1000+ 地理处理工具，基于 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。
zh.stack: 基于 Tauri v2、React、TypeScript、MapLibre GL JS、DuckDB-WASM Spatial 和 deck.gl 构建。支持多平台分发，包括 Microsoft Store、Mac App Store、App Store、Google Play 等。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4325 星，总星数达 6035，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜第 20 名。其跨平台能力、数据隐私保护和丰富的内置工具吸引了大量关注。
uses: GIS 专业人士和地理数据科学家，用于快速可视化和分析空间数据。
开发人员，希望集成地理空间功能到 Web、桌面或移动应用。
教育工作者和学生，在 Jupyter 笔记本中教学和学习 GIS。
需要本地化、隐私保护的地理数据处理场景。

en.tag: Lightweight cloud-native GIS platform, cross-platform with local-first data
en.what: GeoLibre is a free and open-source, lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing, exploring, and analyzing geospatial data. It runs in the web browser, on the desktop, on mobile, and inside Jupyter notebooks, all while keeping your data local and private.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, examples, and a plugin system, offering web, desktop, mobile apps, and Python/R packages. It ships 1,000+ geoprocessing tools that run entirely in the browser via WebAssembly.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, TypeScript, MapLibre GL JS, DuckDB-WASM Spatial, and deck.gl. Distributed across multiple platforms including Microsoft Store, Mac App Store, App Store, Google Play, and more.
en.hot: Gained 4,325 stars this month, reaching 6,035 total, ranking #20 on GitHub Trending monthly. Its cross-platform capability, data privacy, and rich built-in tools have attracted significant attention.
uses: GIS professionals and geospatial data scientists for quick visualization and analysis.
Developers integrating geospatial capabilities into web, desktop, or mobile apps.
Educators and students teaching/learning GIS in Jupyter notebooks.
Scenarios requiring local, privacy-preserving geospatial data processing.

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 基于 WebGPU 的 3D 建筑编辑器
zh.what: Pascal Editor 是一个基于 Web 的 3D 建筑项目编辑器，允许用户创建和分享三维建筑项目。它利用 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU 提供高性能的 3D 渲染，并支持通过 CLI 或 npm 包集成。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Turborepo monorepo，包含多个包：核心（core）负责场景状态和注册表，viewer 负责 3D 渲染，editor 提供编辑工具，nodes 定义内置节点，cli 用于本地安装，mcp 提供模型上下文协议服务器，ui 包含共享 UI 组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU，使用 Next.js 构建应用，Zustand 管理状态，Turborepo 管理 monorepo。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4130 星，总星数达 21541，因其创新的 3D 建筑编辑体验和 WebGPU 技术而受到关注。
uses: 建筑师和设计师：快速创建和分享 3D 建筑概念。
开发者：集成到自己的应用中，或使用 CLI 本地运行编辑器。
教育者：用于教学 3D 建模和建筑可视化。

en.tag: A 3D building editor built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU
en.what: Pascal Editor is a web-based 3D building editor that allows users to create and share 3D architectural projects. It leverages React Three Fiber and WebGPU for high-performance 3D rendering and supports integration via CLI or npm packages.
en.content: The repository is a Turborepo monorepo with packages: core for scene state and registry, viewer for 3D rendering, editor for editing tools, nodes for built-in node definitions, cli for local installation, mcp for Model Context Protocol server, and ui for shared UI components.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on React Three Fiber and WebGPU, uses Next.js for the app, Zustand for state management, and Turborepo for monorepo management.
en.hot: Gained 4130 stars this month, reaching 21541 total, popular for its innovative 3D building editing experience and WebGPU technology.
uses: Architects and designers: quickly create and share 3D architectural concepts.
Developers: integrate into their own apps or run the editor locally via CLI.
Educators: for teaching 3D modeling and architectural visualization.

zh.tag: AI 生产力工作室：智能对话、自主代理与 300+ 助手
zh.what: Cherry Studio 是一个 AI 生产力套件，提供智能聊天、自主代理和超过 300 个预设助手，统一访问前沿大语言模型。它旨在为用户提供一个集成的 AI 工作环境，支持多种任务和场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，包括构建图标、文档、开发指南等。主要使用 TypeScript 开发，并提供多语言支持。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，可能使用 Electron 等桌面框架，集成多种大语言模型 API。
zh.hot: 凭借 5 万+ 星标和月增 2100+ 的势头，Cherry Studio 凭借丰富的助手生态和自主代理功能，成为 AI 生产力工具的热门选择。
uses: 日常用户：需要统一入口使用多种 AI 模型进行聊天和问答
专业人士：利用 300+ 助手提升写作、编程、设计等效率
开发者：通过自主代理实现自动化任务和复杂工作流

en.tag: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants
en.what: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity suite offering smart chat, autonomous agents, and over 300 preset assistants, with unified access to frontier LLMs. It aims to provide an integrated AI workspace for various tasks and scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, including build icons, documentation, and development guides. It is primarily developed in TypeScript and supports multiple languages.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, likely using Electron for desktop, integrating multiple LLM APIs.
en.hot: With 50k+ stars and 2,100+ monthly additions, Cherry Studio's rich assistant ecosystem and autonomous agents make it a popular AI productivity tool.
uses: Everyday users: need a unified entry to chat and Q&A with multiple AI models
Professionals: leverage 300+ assistants to boost writing, coding, design efficiency
Developers: use autonomous agents for automated tasks and complex workflows

zh.tag: TypeScript 生产级应用开发库，提供类型安全、错误处理与依赖注入
zh.what: Effect 是一个用于构建健壮、可维护、类型安全的 TypeScript 应用库。它帮助处理规模化开发中的难题，如类型化错误、依赖注入、结构化并发、调度、追踪和统一 schema 验证。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心的 effect 包以及多个集成包，如 @effect/platform-*（支持浏览器、Bun、Deno、Node.js）和 @effect/sql-*（支持 ClickHouse、D1 等）。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 5.9+，要求严格模式；支持 Node.js 18+，部分集成包需要更高版本。
zh.hot: 本月新增 514 星，总星数 15455，位列 TypeScript 月度趋势榜第 16 名。Effect v4 发布候选版，提供更强大的类型安全和错误处理，吸引开发者关注。
uses: 适合构建大型 TypeScript 应用，需要严格类型安全和错误处理的团队
用于开发跨平台应用，通过 @effect/platform-* 支持浏览器、Node.js、Bun 和 Deno
适合需要结构化并发和依赖注入的复杂后端服务
用于数据访问层，通过 @effect/sql-* 集成多种数据库

en.tag: A TypeScript library for building robust, type-safe, production-grade applications
en.what: Effect is a library for building robust, maintainable, type-safe, and production-grade applications in TypeScript. It helps handle hard problems at scale: typed errors, dependency injection, structured concurrency, scheduling, tracing, and unified schema validation.
en.content: This monorepo contains the core effect package along with integration packages like @effect/platform-* (for browser, Bun, Deno, Node.js) and @effect/sql-* (for ClickHouse, D1, etc.).
en.stack: Built on TypeScript 5.9+ with strict mode; requires Node.js 18+ (some integration packages need newer runtimes).
en.hot: Gained 514 stars this month (total 15,455), ranking #16 on TypeScript monthly trending. The v4 release candidate offers enhanced type safety and error handling, drawing developer attention.
uses: For teams building large TypeScript applications requiring strict type safety and error handling
For cross-platform development with @effect/platform-* supporting browser, Node.js, Bun, and Deno
For complex backend services needing structured concurrency and dependency injection
For data access layers integrating multiple databases via @effect/sql-*

zh.tag: 开源智能体操作系统，让 AI 代理自主运行
zh.what: elizaOS 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架和产品栈，用于构建和运行自主 AI 代理。它提供核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务和原生桥接，支持从聊天、语音到设备控制等多种能力。
zh.content: 该仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务、原生桥接和第一方插件。可引导的 Linux 和 Android 发行版在单独的 elizaOS/os 仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Bun 和 Node.js，使用 Turbo 进行构建，支持子模块和补丁。
zh.hot: 本周新增 115 颗星，总星数达 19064，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 19 名。其“智能体操作系统”的定位和全栈能力吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者：使用 CLI 和文档构建自定义 AI 代理或插件
企业：通过 Eliza Cloud 部署和管理 AI 代理
个人用户：下载 Eliza 应用用于个人助理、自动化等场景
研究者：探索自主代理和操作系统级集成的可能性

en.tag: Open-source agentic operating system for autonomous AI agents
en.what: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for building and running autonomous AI agents. It provides a core runtime, the Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, and native bridges, enabling capabilities from chat and voice to device control.
en.content: This repository is a monorepo containing the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. Bootable Linux and Android distributions live in a separate elizaOS/os repository.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Bun and Node.js dependencies, built using Turbo, supporting submodules and patches.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars this week, reaching 19,064 total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly. Its positioning as an 'agentic operating system' with full-stack capabilities attracts many developers.
uses: Developers: build custom AI agents or plugins using the CLI and docs
Enterprises: deploy and manage AI agents via Eliza Cloud
Individuals: download the Eliza app for personal assistant, automation, etc.
Researchers: explore autonomous agents and OS-level integration

zh.tag: 自托管可视化CMS，输出干净静态页面
zh.what: Instatic 是一个开源的、自托管的 CMS，将可视化编辑器、内容引擎和发布器集成在一个 Bun 服务器中。它旨在替代 Webflow、Framer 和 WordPress，输出简洁的语义化 HTML 和紧凑的 CSS，无框架运行时或构建器属性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CMS 功能：用户、角色、插件、内容、数据库（SQLite 或 Postgres），以及一键部署到 Railway 的模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 Bun 运行时，支持 SQLite 或 Postgres 数据库，使用 MIT 许可证。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4528 星，总星数达 8188，因其作为 Webflow/Framer 的开源替代品，且强调输出干净静态页面而受到关注。
uses: 开发者希望自托管 CMS 并完全掌控数据，避免依赖第三方服务。
设计师或内容创作者需要可视化编辑但要求生成高性能静态网站。
团队寻求替代 WordPress 等传统 CMS，降低维护成本并提高安全性。

en.tag: Self-hosted visual CMS that outputs clean static pages
en.what: Instatic is an open-source, self-hosted CMS that combines a visual editor, content engine, and publisher in one Bun server. It aims to replace Webflow, Framer, and WordPress by outputting clean semantic HTML and compact CSS without framework runtime or builder attributes.
en.content: The repo includes full CMS features: users, roles, plugins, content, database (SQLite or Postgres), and one-click deploy templates for Railway.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Bun runtime, supports SQLite or Postgres databases, MIT licensed.
en.hot: Gained 4528 stars this month, reaching 8188 total, popular as an open-source alternative to Webflow/Framer with a focus on clean static output.
uses: Developers who want a self-hosted CMS with full control over data, avoiding third-party services.
Designers or content creators needing visual editing but requiring high-performance static sites.
Teams looking to replace traditional CMS like WordPress to reduce maintenance and improve security.

zh.tag: 终端里的开源 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Qwen Code 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，直接在终端中运行，提供交互式 UI 和代理功能。它支持自动记忆、自动技能、子代理、代理团队和 MCP，无需配置即可动态工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的核心框架，提供 CLI 工具、交互式终端 UI、IDE 插件、桌面应用、守护进程模式、SDK 以及 IM 机器人（Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu）。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（>=22），支持多种 API 协议（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen），可接入第三方或本地模型（Ollama/vLLM）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 389 星，总星数达 26.9k，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 8 名。其开箱即用的代理特性和多协议支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接使用 AI 编程代理，无需离开命令行。
团队需要支持多种模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen）的灵活工具。
希望利用 MCP 和子代理构建复杂自动化工作流的用户。
对开源、可定制、无供应商锁定的 AI 工具感兴趣的人。

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal
en.what: Qwen Code is an open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, offering an interactive UI and agentic capabilities. It features auto-memory, auto-skills, subagents, agent teams, and MCP, enabling dynamic workflows with zero setup.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based core framework, providing a CLI tool, interactive terminal UI, IDE plugins, desktop app, daemon mode, SDKs, and IM bots (Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu).
en.stack: Built on Node.js (>=22), supports multiple API protocols (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen), and can integrate third-party or local models (Ollama/vLLM).
en.hot: Gained 389 stars this week, reaching 26.9k total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) this week. Its out-of-the-box agentic features and multi-protocol support attract many developers.
uses: Developers who want an AI coding agent directly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Teams needing a flexible tool that supports multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen).
Users who want to build complex automated workflows with MCP and subagents.
Those interested in open-source, customizable, vendor-lock-in-free AI tools.

zh.tag: 开源可观测性平台，替代 Datadog/Splunk，成本降低 140 倍
zh.what: OpenObserve 是一个云原生的可观测性平台，统一处理日志、指标、追踪、前端监控和 LLM 可观测性。它旨在以极低的存储成本和简单的部署方式，替代 Datadog、Splunk 和 Elasticsearch 等传统工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源码，包括前端界面、后端服务、文档、架构说明和快速入门指南。支持单二进制部署，并集成了 OpenTelemetry 原生支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，后端基于 Rust 构建，利用 Parquet 列式存储和 S3 原生架构实现高性能和低成本。
zh.hot: 凭借 140 倍存储成本降低和单二进制部署的卖点，吸引了大量关注，本月新增 1100 星，总星数突破 2.1 万，成为可观测性领域的热门开源项目。
uses: 寻求替代昂贵商业可观测性工具的中小团队，希望降低成本而不牺牲功能。
需要统一管理日志、指标、追踪和前端监控的 DevOps 或 SRE 团队。
对 LLM 应用进行可观测性监控的 AI 工程师，需要追踪模型调用和性能。
希望快速部署自托管可观测性平台，且要求简单运维的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source observability platform, a cost-effective alternative to Datadog/Splunk with 140x lower storage cost
en.what: OpenObserve is a cloud-native observability platform that unifies logs, metrics, traces, frontend monitoring, and LLM observability. It aims to replace traditional tools like Datadog, Splunk, and Elasticsearch with dramatically lower storage costs and simple deployment.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, documentation, architecture overview, and quickstart guides. It supports single-binary deployment and has native OpenTelemetry integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, with a Rust-based backend. It leverages Parquet columnar storage and an S3-native architecture for high performance and low cost.
en.hot: With its 140x storage cost reduction and single-binary deployment, it has gained significant traction, adding 1,100 stars this month and surpassing 21,000 total stars, making it a hot open-source project in the observability space.
uses: Small to medium teams looking for a cost-effective alternative to expensive commercial observability tools without sacrificing features.
DevOps or SRE teams needing to unify logs, metrics, traces, and frontend monitoring in one platform.
AI engineers monitoring LLM applications, requiring tracing of model calls and performance.
Developers who want a self-hosted observability platform with simple deployment and low operational overhead.

zh.tag: Claude Code 全家桶：代理、技能、钩子、规则与 MCP 配置
zh.what: 这是一个由 Anthropic 黑客松获奖者开发的 Claude Code 配置集合，包含生产级的代理、技能、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置。这些配置经过 10 多个月的日常使用打磨，用于构建真实产品。
zh.content: 仓库包含代理、技能、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置等目录，以及配套的速查指南和长文指南，涵盖令牌优化、记忆持久化、持续学习、验证循环、并行化等主题。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/Node.js 编写，支持 TypeScript、Shell 和 Markdown。跨平台支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，自动检测包管理器（npm、pnpm、yarn、bun）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 154 颗星，总星数突破 1000，登上 JavaScript 周榜第 9 名。作为黑客松获奖者的实战配置，吸引了大量 Claude Code 用户寻求高效开发工作流。
uses: Claude Code 用户：希望优化令牌使用、提升开发效率的开发者。
AI 辅助开发团队：需要标准化代理、技能和钩子配置的团队。
学习 AI 编程实践：想了解如何构建高效 AI 开发工作流的学习者。

en.tag: Complete Claude Code toolkit: agents, skills, hooks, rules, and MCP configs
en.what: A collection of Claude Code configurations from an Anthropic hackathon winner, including production-ready agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configs. Evolved over 10+ months of intensive daily use building real products.
en.content: Includes directories for agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configs, along with shorthand and longform guides covering token optimization, memory persistence, continuous learning, verification loops, and parallelization.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript/Node.js, with TypeScript, Shell, and Markdown. Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with automatic package manager detection (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun).
en.hot: Gained 154 stars this week, surpassing 1000 total, ranking #9 on the JavaScript weekly trending. As a hackathon winner's real-world config, it attracts many Claude Code users seeking efficient dev workflows.
uses: Claude Code users: developers looking to optimize token usage and boost productivity.
AI-assisted dev teams: teams needing standardized agents, skills, and hooks.
Learners of AI coding practices: those wanting to build efficient AI dev workflows.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.tag: 微软官方 Power Platform 开发插件市场
zh.what: 这是一个插件市场，为 Claude Code 和 GitHub Copilot 提供 Power Platform 开发插件。包含可复用的技能、代理和命令，帮助开发者构建和部署 Power Platform 解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个插件，如 Power Pages、Model Apps、MCP Apps、Code Apps、Mobile Apps、Canvas Apps 和 Power Automate。每个插件都有独立的 README 和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Claude Code 或 GitHub Copilot CLI。部分插件使用 React、TypeScript、Expo、.NET 等技术栈。
zh.hot: 本周新增 49 颗星，位列 JavaScript 周榜第 3。作为微软官方项目，它填补了 AI 编码助手与 Power Platform 之间的空白，吸引大量低代码开发者。
uses: Power Platform 开发者 —— 使用 AI 助手快速构建和部署应用
低代码/无代码爱好者 —— 结合 Claude Code 或 Copilot 提升开发效率
企业 IT 团队 —— 标准化 Power Platform 开发流程

en.tag: Official Microsoft plugin marketplace for Power Platform development
en.what: This is a plugin marketplace providing Power Platform development plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot. It includes reusable skills, agents, and commands to help developers build and deploy Power Platform solutions.
en.content: The repository contains multiple plugins such as Power Pages, Model Apps, MCP Apps, Code Apps, Mobile Apps, Canvas Apps, and Power Automate. Each plugin has its own README and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, relying on Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI. Some plugins use React, TypeScript, Expo, .NET, etc.
en.hot: Gained 49 stars this week, ranking 3rd in JavaScript weekly trending. As an official Microsoft project, it bridges AI coding assistants and Power Platform, attracting many low-code developers.
uses: Power Platform developers — quickly build and deploy apps using AI assistants
Low-code/no-code enthusiasts — boost development efficiency with Claude Code or Copilot
Enterprise IT teams — standardize Power Platform development workflows

zh.tag: React 组件库，实现 Google Material Design
zh.what: Material UI 是一个全面的 React 组件库，实现了 Google 的 Material Design 系统。它被全球顶级产品团队广泛使用，经过十年以上的开发和数千名开源贡献者的严格测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Material UI 的核心组件、样式解决方案、主题定制工具，以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 TypeScript，使用 Emotion 进行样式处理，支持自定义主题。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的 React UI 库之一，拥有近 10 万 star，持续活跃，本周新增 71 星，稳居趋势榜。
uses: React 开发者快速构建符合 Material Design 的界面
企业级应用开发，需要成熟稳定的组件库
需要高度定制主题的团队

en.tag: React component library implementing Google's Material Design
en.what: Material UI is a comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design system. It is trusted by top product teams worldwide and has been rigorously tested over a decade by thousands of open-source contributors.
en.content: The repository contains the core components, styling solutions, theme customization tools, along with documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built on React and TypeScript, uses Emotion for styling, supports custom theming.
en.hot: As one of the most popular React UI libraries, it has nearly 100k stars, remains highly active, and gained 71 stars this week, staying on the trending list.
uses: React developers building Material Design interfaces quickly
Enterprise application development requiring a mature, stable component library
Teams needing highly customizable theming

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器
zh.what: drawDB 是一个在浏览器中运行的免费数据库实体关系图（ERD）编辑器，用户无需注册即可快速绘制数据库图表、导入导出 SQL 脚本、生成迁移脚本并自定义编辑器。它旨在简化数据库设计流程，让开发者可以直观地可视化和操作数据库结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 drawDB 前端应用源码，包括 React 组件、状态管理、样式和构建配置。还提供了本地开发、生产构建和 Docker 部署的脚本，以及可选的分享功能（需要配套的 drawdb-server）。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 React 构建，使用 npm 进行依赖管理和构建，支持 Docker 容器化部署。主要依赖包括 React 生态、状态管理库（如 Redux 或 MobX）以及代码编辑器组件（如 Monaco）。
zh.hot: drawDB 因其免费、无需注册、直接在浏览器中使用的便捷性而广受欢迎，star 数已达 38k+，今日新增 48 个，在 GitHub 趋势榜 JavaScript 类别中排名第 10。它解决了数据库设计中的常见痛点，提供了简洁直观的界面和强大的 SQL 生成功能。
uses: 数据库开发者：快速可视化数据库结构，生成 SQL 脚本和迁移文件。
软件架构师：在项目初期设计 ER 图，便于团队协作和沟通。
教育场景：用于教学演示数据库设计概念，无需安装复杂软件。
全栈开发者：在开发过程中快速原型化数据库模型，并导出为 SQL 语句。

en.tag: Free, simple, intuitive online database ER diagram editor and SQL generator
en.what: drawDB is a free, browser-based database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that lets users quickly build diagrams, import/export SQL scripts, generate migrations, and customize the editor without creating an account. It simplifies database design by providing an intuitive visual interface for structuring and manipulating database schemas.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the drawDB frontend application, including React components, state management, styles, and build configuration. It provides scripts for local development, production build, and Docker deployment, along with optional sharing features that require a companion drawdb-server.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript and React, using npm for dependency management and build, with Docker support for containerized deployment. Key dependencies include React ecosystem, state management libraries (e.g., Redux or MobX), and code editor components (e.g., Monaco).
en.hot: drawDB has gained popularity for being free, requiring no sign-up, and working directly in the browser, amassing 38k+ stars with 48 new stars today, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending for JavaScript. It addresses common pain points in database design with a clean, intuitive interface and powerful SQL generation capabilities.
uses: Database developers: quickly visualize database schemas and generate SQL scripts and migrations.
Software architects: design ER diagrams in early project phases for team collaboration and communication.
Educational settings: demonstrate database design concepts without installing complex software.
Full-stack developers: prototype database models quickly during development and export to SQL statements.

zh.tag: 自托管有声书与播客服务器
zh.what: Audiobookshelf 是一个自托管的有声书和播客服务器，支持流式播放所有音频格式，自动下载播客，多用户权限管理，跨设备同步播放进度。它提供 Web 应用、Android 和 iOS 应用（测试版），并支持 Chromecast。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码、Vue 前端（正在迁移到 React）、REST API、数据库迁移、Docker 部署文件，以及文档和示例配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Node.js，前端使用 Vue（迁移至 React），数据库使用 SQLite，支持 Docker 部署，集成 Audnexus API 用于章节查找。
zh.hot: 随着自托管和数字隐私意识的增强，Audiobookshelf 提供了开源、功能丰富的替代方案，本月新增 460 星，总星数达 14006，在 JavaScript 趋势榜排名第 18。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望完全掌控自己的有声书和播客库，避免依赖商业服务。
播客重度用户：需要自动下载和管理播客订阅，并支持多设备同步。
家庭或小团体：多用户权限和独立进度，适合共享媒体库。
开发者：可定制和扩展，前端正在迁移到 React，适合贡献代码。

en.tag: Self-hosted audiobook and podcast server
en.what: Audiobookshelf is a self-hosted audiobook and podcast server that streams all audio formats, auto-downloads podcasts, supports multi-user permissions, and syncs progress across devices. It offers a web app, Android and iOS apps (beta), and Chromecast support.
en.content: The repository contains the full server-side code, a Vue frontend (being migrated to React), REST API, database migrations, Docker deployment files, and documentation with sample configurations.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Node.js, frontend in Vue (migrating to React), SQLite database, Docker deployment, integrates Audnexus API for chapter lookup.
en.hot: With rising self-hosting and digital privacy awareness, Audiobookshelf offers an open-source, feature-rich alternative, gaining 460 stars this month and reaching 14,006 total, ranking #18 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: Self-hosters: Want full control over their audiobook and podcast library without relying on commercial services.
Podcast power users: Need automatic downloads and management of subscriptions with multi-device sync.
Families or small groups: Multi-user permissions and per-user progress for shared media libraries.
Developers: Customizable and extensible, frontend migrating to React, suitable for contributing code.

zh.tag: 开源看板项目管理工具，实时协作
zh.what: PLANKA 是一款看板风格的项目管理工具，提供直观的拖拽界面来管理项目、看板、列表和卡片。它支持实时同步、Markdown 编辑和灵活的通知，适合团队协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的看板应用代码，包括前端界面、后端 API、数据库模型，以及 Docker 部署配置。还提供了文档、演示和 API 文档链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Node.js 和 React 构建，使用 PostgreSQL 作为数据库，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 12k+ 星标，本周新增 102，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜。其自托管、实时协作和丰富功能吸引了大量用户。
uses: 团队项目管理，使用看板视图跟踪任务进度
个人任务管理，自托管部署保护数据隐私
需要实时协作和 Markdown 支持的项目团队
希望替代商业看板工具的开源用户

en.tag: Open-source Kanban project management with real-time collaboration
en.what: PLANKA is a Kanban-style project management tool with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for managing projects, boards, lists, and cards. It features real-time sync, Markdown editing, and flexible notifications for team collaboration.
en.content: The repository contains the full Kanban app code, including frontend UI, backend API, database models, and Docker deployment configs. Links to docs, demo, and API docs are also provided.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Node.js and React, uses PostgreSQL for database, supports Docker deployment.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 102 added this week, it's on GitHub Trending weekly. Its self-hosted, real-time collaboration and rich features attract many users.
uses: Team project management with Kanban view for tracking tasks
Personal task management with self-hosted deployment for data privacy
Teams needing real-time collaboration and Markdown support
Open-source users looking to replace commercial Kanban tools

zh.tag: 高效开源广告拦截器，专注隐私与性能
zh.what: uBlock Origin 是一款轻量级、高效的浏览器扩展，用于拦截广告、跟踪器和恶意域名。它通过 CPU 和内存占用极低的方式，为用户提供更干净、更快的网页浏览体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含扩展的完整源代码，包括核心拦截引擎、过滤列表管理、用户界面（如弹出面板和设置页）、以及针对不同浏览器的构建配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，结合 HTML/CSS 构建界面，并利用浏览器扩展 API（如 webRequest 和 declarativeNetRequest）实现网络请求拦截。
zh.hot: 随着主流浏览器逐步淘汰 Manifest V2，uBlock Origin 成为用户对抗广告和跟踪的重要工具，其高效性和可靠性使其在 GitHub 上持续受到关注，本月新增 890 星。
uses: 注重隐私的普通用户，希望拦截广告和跟踪器以加快浏览速度并保护隐私。
技术爱好者，希望自定义过滤规则或研究广告拦截技术。
开发者和维护者，需要参考或贡献于开源广告拦截解决方案。

en.tag: Efficient open-source ad blocker focused on privacy and performance
en.what: uBlock Origin is a lightweight and efficient browser extension that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains. It provides a cleaner and faster browsing experience with minimal CPU and memory usage.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the extension, including the core blocking engine, filter list management, user interface (popup panel and settings pages), and build configurations for various browsers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with HTML/CSS for the UI, and leverages browser extension APIs like webRequest and declarativeNetRequest for network request blocking.
en.hot: As major browsers phase out Manifest V2, uBlock Origin remains a crucial tool for users to fight ads and tracking. Its efficiency and reliability keep it popular on GitHub, gaining 890 stars this month.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to block ads and trackers for faster browsing and privacy protection.
Tech enthusiasts who want to customize filter rules or study ad-blocking techniques.
Developers and maintainers looking to reference or contribute to an open-source ad-blocking solution.

zh.tag: 跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，支持多协议
zh.what: electerm 是一个开源的终端/SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/串口/RDP/VNC/Spice 客户端，支持 Linux、Mac、Windows、Android 和 HarmonyOS。它提供图形化界面，方便用户管理远程连接和文件传输。

zh.hot: 支持 HarmonyOS 和国产 Linux 发行版（如 UOS、麒麟）使其在特定用户群中受欢迎，今日新增 54 星，总星数 14811，持续获得关注。

使用 HarmonyOS 或国产 Linux 系统的用户
偏好开源、可定制终端工具的技术爱好者

en.tag: Cross-platform terminal & remote connection client supporting multiple protocols
en.what: electerm is an open-source terminal/SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice client supporting Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, and HarmonyOS. It provides a graphical interface for managing remote connections and file transfers.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code with multi-tab support, theme customization, settings sync, hotkeys, and offers online, web, and Docker versions.

en.hot: Support for HarmonyOS and Chinese Linux distros (UOS, Kylin) makes it popular among specific users; gained 54 stars today, total 14811, maintaining steady attention.

Users on HarmonyOS or Chinese Linux distributions
Tech enthusiasts preferring open-source, customizable terminal tools

zh.tag: PS4/PS5 WebKit 漏洞利用链
zh.what: 这是一个针对 PlayStation 4/5 上 WebKit 引擎的 CSSFontFace 释放后使用（UAF）漏洞的利用仓库。它提供了从浏览器到内核的完整利用链，支持特定固件版本，并允许用户添加自定义 payload。

zh.tag: 个人智能情报终端，27 个数据源，一条命令本地运行

en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.

en.what: BAML is a programming language designed specifically for AI agents. It provides an agent-specific standard library and testing framework, and can be called from multiple mainstream languages.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust implementation of the BAML compiler, command-line tools (baml), IDE plugins, Python package (baml-py), and documentation/examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings (baml-py), and callable from TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, Java, etc.
en.hot: With the surge in AI agent development, BAML offers a more rigorous programming paradigm that addresses common errors in agent development, quickly gaining attention with nearly 9k stars and growing.

CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer

Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的极速 Python 包与项目管理工具

项目维护者：使用统一锁文件和项目管理功能，简化多环境配置。
DevOps 工程师：在 CI/CD 中加速依赖安装，减少构建时间。

zh.tag: Rust 全栈框架，电池全配，服务端渲染
zh.what: Topcoat 是一个模块化的 Rust 全栈框架，旨在简化 Web 应用开发。它支持服务端渲染，组件可直接异步查询数据库，无需单独 API 层。交互表达式在服务端初始渲染，并自动转换为 JavaScript 在浏览器端运行，无需 WASM 或客户端构建步骤。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架源码、示例代码、文档和路线图。核心特性包括服务端渲染、客户端响应式表达式（$()）、组件和分片（shard）机制。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Tokio 异步运行时，使用自定义的 view! 宏和组件系统。依赖 crates.io 发布，支持 MIT 许可证。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2130 星，总星数达 4654，进入 GitHub Trending 月榜（Rust）第 15 名。作为 Tokio 官方出品，它填补了 Rust 全栈框架的空白，提供开箱即用的体验，吸引了大量关注。

需要服务端渲染和高性能交互的应用，如实时仪表盘或内容密集的网站。
对 Tokio 生态熟悉，希望利用异步优势并减少样板代码的团队。
早期采用者愿意尝试实验性框架，并接受可能的破坏性变更。

en.tag: Batteries-included full-stack Rust framework with server-side rendering
en.what: Topcoat is a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack web apps. It renders all markup on the server, allowing components to query databases directly without a separate API layer. Interactive expressions are evaluated on the server for initial render and translated to JavaScript to run instantly in the browser, eliminating WASM bundles and client build steps.
en.content: The repository contains framework source code, examples, documentation, and a roadmap. Key features include server-side rendering, client-reactive expressions ($()), components, and shard mechanism.
en.stack: Built on Rust and the Tokio async runtime, with a custom view! macro and component system. Published on crates.io under MIT license.
en.hot: Gained 2,130 stars this month, reaching 4,654 total, ranking #15 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly. As an official Tokio project, it fills the gap for a full-stack Rust framework with a batteries-included approach, attracting significant attention.
uses: Rust developers who want to build full-stack web apps in one language, avoiding the complexity of separate frontend and backend.
Applications requiring server-side rendering and high-performance interactivity, such as real-time dashboards or content-heavy sites.
Teams familiar with the Tokio ecosystem who want to leverage async benefits and reduce boilerplate.
Early adopters willing to try an experimental framework and accept potential breaking changes.

zh.tag: 数据中心级分布式推理服务编排层
zh.what: Dynamo 是一个开源的数据中心级推理服务框架，作为推理引擎（如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、vLLM）之上的编排层，将它们整合为协调的多节点推理系统。它通过分离式服务、智能路由、多级 KV 缓存和自动扩展，最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟，适用于 LLM、推理、多模态和视频生成等负载。

en.content: The repository includes a Rust core, Python extensions, documentation, examples, recipes, and container images, along with design proposals and community contribution guidelines.

Platform developers: extending or customizing inference orchestration logic with Rust and Python.
Research and experimentation: testing advanced techniques like disaggregated serving and KV caching at datacenter scale.

zh.tag: 极速 DataFrame 查询引擎，Rust 编写，支持多语言
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供惰性/急切执行、查询优化和流式处理，支持超出内存的数据集。它提供 Python、Rust、Node.js、R 和 SQL 绑定，并可选 GPU 加速。

Python/R/Node.js 开发者：在各自语言环境中利用高性能 DataFrame 操作。

en.tag: Ultra-fast DataFrame query engine in Rust with multi-language bindings
en.what: Polars is an extremely fast DataFrame analytical query engine written in Rust, featuring lazy/eager execution, query optimization, and streaming for larger-than-RAM datasets. It offers bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, R, and SQL, with optional GPU acceleration.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust library, multi-language bindings (Python, Node.js, R), user guide, documentation, and plugin interfaces for I/O and expression extensions.
en.stack: Built on Rust with multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, uses Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and supports optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Polars is highly popular in the data science community for its outstanding performance and ease of use, with nearly 40k stars and 13 new stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Data scientists and analysts: for fast data cleaning and transformation on large datasets.
Data engineers: building efficient data pipelines handling larger-than-RAM data.
Python/R/Node.js developers: leveraging high-performance DataFrame operations in their preferred language.
Users needing GPU acceleration: accelerating data processing with NVIDIA GPUs.

en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, depends on git and the GitHub API.

zh.tag: 电话号OSINT信息收集框架
zh.what: PhoneInfoga 是一个用于扫描国际电话号码的信息收集框架，可获取国家、地区、运营商和线路类型等基本信息，并利用多种技术尝试查找 VoIP 提供商或识别机主。它通过可配置的扫描器集合工作，旨在辅助调查而非自动化一切。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心框架、命令行界面、Web 图形界面以及 REST API 文档，支持通过外部 API、电话簿和搜索引擎进行 OSINT 足迹收集，并检查信誉报告、社交媒体和一次性号码等。
