uses: 安全研究人员进行电话号码情报收集
调查记者验证电话号码相关信息
渗透测试人员辅助社会工程学攻击前侦察
普通用户查询陌生号码的基本信息

en.tag: OSINT framework for phone number reconnaissance
en.what: PhoneInfoga is an information gathering framework for scanning international phone numbers, providing basic details like country, area, carrier, and line type, and using various techniques to find VoIP providers or identify owners. It works with a collection of configurable scanners to assist investigations, not fully automate them.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based core framework, CLI, web GUI, and REST API docs, enabling OSINT footprinting via external APIs, phone books, and search engines, plus checks for reputation reports, social media, and disposable numbers.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, offering a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use, with Docker support and Swagger documentation.
en.hot: Despite being unmaintained, its powerful OSINT capabilities and ease of use keep it at 17k+ stars, with 29 new stars today, ranking #14 on Go trending, showing sustained community demand.
uses: Security researchers for phone number intelligence gathering
Investigative journalists verifying phone-related information
Penetration testers for pre-engagement reconnaissance
General users looking up basic info on unknown numbers

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供持久化结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的分布式图式问题追踪器，提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 Markdown 计划，帮助代理处理长周期任务而不丢失上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Beads CLI 工具源码、安装脚本、文档以及多种代理集成（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。用户通过 `bd` 命令初始化项目、创建/关闭问题、同步远程代理。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，底层依赖 Dolt（分布式版本化数据库）实现图存储和同步。支持通过 npm 和 PyPI 安装 MCP 相关包。
zh.hot: GitHub 日增 95 星，总星数 25601，位列 Go 语言日榜第 11。AI 编码代理的持久记忆需求旺盛，Beads 以轻量 CLI 和分布式图方案解决痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者 —— 为代理提供持久化记忆和任务管理
使用 Codex CLI、Claude Code 等工具的开发者 —— 集成 Beads 以提升长周期任务处理能力
团队协作场景 —— 多代理通过 Dolt 同步工作状态和依赖图

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.
en.content: The repo contains the Beads CLI tool source code, installation scripts, documentation, and integrations for various agents (Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Users interact via `bd` commands to init projects, create/close issues, and sync with remote agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed versioned database) for graph storage and sync. Also provides npm and PyPI packages for MCP integration.
en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.
uses: AI coding agent developers — provide persistent memory and task management for agents
Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

zh.tag: 云原生应用代理，自动发现服务并动态配置路由
zh.what: Traefik 是一个现代 HTTP 反向代理和负载均衡器，旨在简化微服务的部署。它能够与 Docker、Kubernetes 等基础设施组件集成，自动且动态地配置自身，无需手动维护路由规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Traefik 的源代码、文档、示例配置以及 Web UI 资源。主要目录包括 docs（文档）、pkg（核心代码）、cmd（入口命令）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种后端集成库（如 Docker、Kubernetes、Consul 等），并支持 ACME 自动 HTTPS 证书。
zh.hot: 拥有 64k+ star，是云原生领域最受欢迎的反向代理之一。其自动服务发现和动态配置特性极大简化了微服务路由管理，因此持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 微服务架构中作为入口网关，自动路由到 Docker/Kubernetes 等服务
需要动态更新路由规则的场景，如频繁扩缩容或服务变更
希望简化 HTTPS 证书管理的开发者，利用内置 ACME 自动签发证书
边缘代理或 API 网关，支持多种协议和中间件

en.tag: Cloud-native application proxy with automatic service discovery and dynamic routing
en.what: Traefik is a modern HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer that simplifies microservices deployment. It integrates with infrastructure components like Docker and Kubernetes, automatically and dynamically configuring itself without manual route management.
en.content: The repository contains Traefik's source code, documentation, example configurations, and Web UI assets. Key directories include docs, pkg (core code), and cmd (entry commands).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with integrations for various backends (Docker, Kubernetes, Consul, etc.) and support for automatic HTTPS via ACME.
en.hot: With 64k+ stars, it's one of the most popular reverse proxies in cloud-native. Its automatic service discovery and dynamic configuration greatly simplify microservice routing, keeping it in the spotlight.
uses: As an ingress gateway in microservices, automatically routing to services in Docker/Kubernetes
Scenarios needing dynamic route updates, such as frequent scaling or service changes
Developers wanting simplified HTTPS management with built-in ACME auto-certificates
Edge proxy or API gateway supporting multiple protocols and middleware

zh.tag: 默认 HTTPS 的极速可扩展 Web 服务器
zh.what: Caddy 是一个快速、可扩展、跨平台的 Web 服务器，支持 HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3，并默认启用 TLS，自动为站点配置 HTTPS 证书。它旨在让 HTTPS 成为每个网站的默认配置，简化部署和运维。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Caddy 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置和构建脚本。核心是一个基于 Go 的模块化服务器，通过 Caddyfile 或 JSON 配置，支持丰富的插件和中间件。

zh.hot: Caddy 因其自动 HTTPS 和易用性而广受欢迎，本月新增近千 star，总 star 数超过 7.4 万，在 Go 语言趋势榜中名列前茅。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速部署静态网站或反向代理，无需手动配置证书
需要自动 HTTPS 和 HTTP/3 支持的生产环境 Web 服务器
作为微服务或容器化应用的反向代理和负载均衡器
学习和研究 Go 语言高性能服务器开发的参考项目

en.tag: Fast, extensible web server with automatic HTTPS by default
en.what: Caddy is a fast, extensible, multi-platform web server supporting HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, with TLS enabled by default and automatic HTTPS certificate management. It aims to make HTTPS the default for every site, simplifying deployment and operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, and build scripts for Caddy. The core is a modular Go-based server configured via Caddyfile or JSON, supporting a rich ecosystem of plugins and middleware.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the CertMagic library for automatic HTTPS certificate management, and supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: Caddy is popular for its automatic HTTPS and ease of use, gaining nearly a thousand stars this month and over 74k total, ranking high on the Go trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams quickly deploying static sites or reverse proxies without manual certificate setup
Production web servers requiring automatic HTTPS and HTTP/3 support
Reverse proxy and load balancer for microservices or containerized applications
Reference project for learning high-performance server development in Go

zh.tag: DeepSeek 原生终端 AI 编程代理，专注前缀缓存稳定性
zh.what: DeepSeek-Reasonix 是一款面向终端的 AI 编程代理，深度集成 DeepSeek 模型，通过保持前缀缓存稳定来降低推理成本并提升响应速度。它可常驻运行，持续辅助开发者完成编码任务。

en.tag: DeepSeek-native terminal AI coding agent engineered for prefix-cache stability
en.what: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a terminal-based AI coding agent deeply integrated with DeepSeek models. It leverages prefix-cache stability to reduce inference costs and improve response times, and is designed to run persistently to assist developers with coding tasks.

DeepSeek users leveraging efficient inference to reduce API costs.
Automation workflows requiring a persistent AI agent to handle coding tasks continuously.

zh.tag: 零延迟多协议摄像头流媒体服务器
zh.what: go2rtc 是一个终极摄像头流媒体应用，支持数十种格式和协议，提供零延迟的流媒体输入、输出和转码。它既可以作为独立应用运行，也可以集成到其他项目中，如 Home Assistant。

zh.hot: 凭借零延迟、多协议支持和易于集成等特性，go2rtc 在智能家居和安防领域广受欢迎，本月新增 455 星，总星数达 13870。
uses: 智能家居用户：通过 Home Assistant 集成，实现摄像头流媒体管理。
开发者：作为库集成到自己的项目中，或使用其 API 构建自定义流媒体应用。
安防监控：需要低延迟、多协议摄像头流的场景。
直播推流：将摄像头流推送到 YouTube、Telegram 等平台。

en.tag: Zero-latency multi-protocol camera streaming server
en.what: go2rtc is an ultimate camera streaming application supporting dozens of formats and protocols, offering zero-latency streaming input, output, and transcoding. It can run as a standalone app or be integrated into other projects like Home Assistant.
en.content: The repository contains the core Go binary, Docker images, Home Assistant add-on, and frontend resources for the web UI. It supports protocols like RTSP, WebRTC, HLS, and can transcode on-the-fly via FFmpeg.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging the Pion WebRTC library, FFmpeg for transcoding, and supporting various streaming protocols.
en.hot: With zero-latency, multi-protocol support, and easy integration, go2rtc is popular in smart home and security domains, gaining 455 stars this month and reaching 13,870 total.
uses: Smart home users: integrate with Home Assistant for camera stream management.
Developers: embed as a library or use its API to build custom streaming apps.
Security surveillance: scenarios requiring low-latency, multi-protocol camera streams.
Live streaming: push camera feeds to platforms like YouTube and Telegram.

zh.tag: 一键追溯进程/端口/容器/文件来源的 CLI+TUI 工具
zh.what: witr 是一个命令行工具，用于回答“为什么这个在运行？”的问题。它能追溯进程、端口、容器或文件是由谁启动的，并展示完整的启动链，如 systemd → PM2 → node。支持 CLI 输出、机器可读 JSON 和交互式 TUI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 和 TUI 程序，提供安装脚本、文档和浏览器演示。核心功能是解析进程树、服务管理器、容器和文件系统，生成因果链。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖系统工具如 ps、lsof、ss、systemctl、docker 等来收集信息。支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 FreeBSD。
zh.hot: 解决了开发者常遇到的“这个进程/端口是谁启动的”痛点，提供直观的因果链展示，且支持多平台和多种包管理器，上线后迅速获得近 2 万星。
uses: 系统管理员排查异常进程或端口占用，快速定位源头。
开发者在容器或微服务环境中追踪服务启动链，便于调试。
安全分析师调查可疑进程或文件来源，辅助取证。
DevOps 工程师理解系统启动流程，优化服务管理。

en.tag: Trace any process, port, container, or file back to its origin with CLI+TUI
en.what: witr is a CLI tool that answers 'Why is this running?' by tracing any process, port, container, or file back to the exact chain that started it, such as systemd → PM2 → node. It offers CLI output, machine-readable JSON, and an interactive TUI.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI and TUI program, along with installation scripts, documentation, and a browser demo. It parses process trees, service managers, containers, and file systems to generate causal chains.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it leverages system utilities like ps, lsof, ss, systemctl, and docker to gather information. Supports Linux, macOS, Windows, and FreeBSD.
en.hot: It solves the common pain point of 'who started this process/port' with intuitive causal chain visualization, multi-platform support, and multiple package managers, quickly gaining nearly 20k stars.
uses: System admins investigating abnormal processes or port usage to quickly locate the source.
Developers tracing service startup chains in container or microservice environments for debugging.
Security analysts investigating suspicious processes or file origins for forensics.
DevOps engineers understanding system startup flows to optimize service management.

zh.tag: Git 仓库密钥扫描与泄露检测工具
zh.what: Gitleaks 是一个用于检测 Git 仓库、文件或标准输入中是否存在密码、API 密钥、令牌等敏感信息的工具。它通过正则表达式和熵分析来识别潜在的泄露，并输出详细的报告，包括文件、行号、提交等信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，支持通过 Homebrew、Docker、Go 或二进制安装，并可集成到 pre-commit 钩子或 GitHub Action 中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖正则表达式库和熵计算，支持多种平台和容器化部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 215 星，总星数达 28786，位列 GitHub 周榜（Go）第一。其功能完善且维护者宣布转向新项目，引发关注。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中自动扫描代码泄露
安全团队审计历史提交中的敏感信息
个人开发者本地检查仓库泄露风险

en.tag: Scan git repos for secrets, passwords, API keys, and tokens
en.what: Gitleaks is a tool for detecting secrets like passwords, API keys, and tokens in git repos, files, and stdin. It uses regex and entropy analysis to identify potential leaks and outputs detailed reports including file, line, commit, and more.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI tool, installable via Homebrew, Docker, Go, or binaries, and can be integrated into pre-commit hooks or GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging regex and entropy calculation, with support for multiple platforms and containerized deployment.
en.hot: Gained 215 stars this week, total 28,786, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its feature-complete status and maintainer's shift to a new project drew attention.
uses: Developers scanning for leaks in CI/CD pipelines
Security teams auditing historical commits for sensitive data
Individual developers checking repos locally for exposure

zh.tag: 让 AI 助手直接读写小红书数据的 MCP 服务
zh.what: 这是一个为小红书（xiaohongshu.com）打造的 MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务，让 AI 助手能够直接访问小红书的数据。它支持登录、检查登录状态、发布图文内容等功能，并提供了 Docker 部署、浏览器插件等多种使用方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言实现的 MCP 服务端，提供登录、发布图文等工具；同时提供 Docker 镜像、浏览器插件（x-mcp）以及 Openclaw 深度集成方案（xiaohongshu-mcp-skills）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 MCP SDK；支持 Docker 容器化部署，并提供浏览器插件版本（基于 JavaScript/Chrome 扩展）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 669 星，总星数达 1.5 万+，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（Go）第 14 名。其热度源于小红书作为热门内容平台，开发者渴望让 AI 助手直接操作小红书，而该项目提供了简单易用的 MCP 接口和多种部署方式。
uses: 开发者：希望将小红书数据接入 AI 助手（如 Claude、OpenClaw）的开发者，可通过 Docker 或源码部署。
非技术用户：使用浏览器插件版 x-mcp，零配置即可让 AI 助手读取小红书内容。
内容创作者：需要自动化发布图文到小红书的运营人员，可借助 AI 助手批量操作。
AI 应用集成：需要在小红书场景中实现智能问答、内容分析的 AI 应用开发者。

en.tag: MCP server enabling AI assistants to access Xiaohongshu data
en.what: This is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Xiaohongshu (xiaohongshu.com), enabling AI assistants to directly access Xiaohongshu data. It supports login, login status checking, publishing image-text posts, and offers multiple deployment options including Docker and a browser extension.

Its popularity stems from Xiaohongshu being a hot content platform, and developers' desire to let AI assistants operate it directly; this project offers an easy-to-use MCP interface and multiple deployment options.
uses: Developers: those who want to integrate Xiaohongshu data into AI assistants (e.g., Claude, OpenClaw) via Docker or source deployment.
Non-technical users: use the browser extension x-mcp for zero-configuration access to Xiaohongshu content via AI.
Content creators: operations staff who need to automate publishing image-text posts to Xiaohongshu with AI assistance.
AI application integrators: developers building AI apps that require intelligent Q&A or content analysis on Xiaohongshu.

zh.tag: 开源 RAG 引擎，融合 Agent 能力，为 LLM 构建上下文层
zh.what: RAGFlow 是一个领先的开源检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，将前沿的 RAG 技术与 Agent 能力相结合，为大型语言模型（LLM）提供高质量的上下文层。它支持深度文档理解、基于模板的文本切片、可配置的 Agent 工作流，以及基于引用的可追溯回答，确保输出的准确性和可验证性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 RAGFlow 系统，包括后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 界面、Agent 工作流编排、文档解析与索引模块，以及 Docker 部署配置。提供多语言 README、云服务入口和详细文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发后端，前端基于 Web 技术；依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，集成多种 LLM 和向量数据库，支持深度文档理解与 RAG 流程。
zh.hot: RAGFlow 凭借其将 RAG 与 Agent 结合的创新理念，以及强大的文档处理能力和可追溯回答，在 GitHub 上获得 87k+ 星标，今日新增 85 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 20 名，持续受到开发者社区的高度关注。

en.tag: Open-source RAG engine fusing RAG with Agent capabilities for LLM context layer
en.what: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs. It supports deep document understanding, template-based chunking, configurable Agent workflows, and citation-based traceable answers, ensuring accuracy and verifiability.
en.content: The repository contains the full RAGFlow system, including backend services (written in Go), frontend web UI, Agent workflow orchestration, document parsing and indexing modules, and Docker deployment configurations. en.stack: Backend primarily developed in Go, frontend based on web technologies; relies on Docker for containerized deployment, integrates multiple LLMs and vector databases, supporting deep document understanding and RAG pipelines.
en.hot: RAGFlow has gained 87k+ stars on GitHub due to its innovative fusion of RAG with Agent capabilities, powerful document processing, and traceable answers. With 85 new stars today, it ranks #20 on the Go trending list, maintaining high attention from the developer community.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Build internal document Q&A systems to improve information retrieval efficiency.
AI app developers: Integrate RAGFlow as a context layer for LLM applications, enhancing answer accuracy and traceability.
Research institutions: Use for deep parsing and knowledge extraction of academic literature to aid research analysis.
Open-source enthusiasts: Learn the architecture of combining RAG with Agent and contribute to the community.

zh.tag: OpenAI 官方安全 MCP 隧道客户端，连接本地服务到云端

zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的客户端二进制、可嵌入的 Go SDK（支持内存传输）、详细的文档（入门、架构、权限、部署、故障排查、协议）以及示例代码。

需要监控和运维 MCP 连接，使用 /healthz、/metrics 等端点的运维人员。

en.tag: OpenAI's official secure MCP tunnel client for connecting local servers to cloud
en.what: tunnel-client is OpenAI's Secure MCP Tunnel client that securely connects private or localhost MCP servers to OpenAI-hosted services like ChatGPT and Codex without exposing them to the public internet. It establishes a connection through an OpenAI-hosted tunnel endpoint, keeping the MCP server private.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based client binary, an embeddable Go SDK (supporting in-memory transport), comprehensive docs (onboarding, architecture, permissions, deployment, troubleshooting, protocol), and examples.
en.stack: Primarily Go, leveraging the MCP Go SDK and OpenAI tunnel control plane, with deployment support for Docker, Kubernetes, and VMs.
en.hot: Gained 103 stars this month, trending on Go, as it's OpenAI's official solution for securely connecting local MCP servers to AI tools like ChatGPT, addressing a key pain point for developers.
uses: Developers running MCP servers locally or on private networks who want to securely connect to ChatGPT or Codex.
Teams in enterprise environments that cannot open public ports and need compliant AI service connectivity.
Operators who need to monitor and manage MCP connections using endpoints like /healthz and /metrics.
Go developers who want to embed an MCP server in-process without extra network configuration.

zh.tag: 把AI编码代理当队友分配任务的协作工作台
zh.what: Multica 是一个开源工作台，让你像给队友派活一样把 issue 分配给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 20 种编码代理。代理会自动接单、在可控运行时中工作、实时评论并交回审查，所有上下文和决策都关联到同一 issue。支持自托管，无锁定。

技术负责人：将代理分配为团队成员，通过看板跟踪进度和审查结果

en.tag: Assign issues to AI coding agents like teammates in an open-source workspace
en.what: Multica is an open-source workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 20 others, just as you would to a teammate. Agents pick up issues, work in a runtime you control, comment as they go, and hand back for review, keeping context and decisions tied to the issue. Self-hostable with no lock-in.
en.content: The repo contains the core Go backend, a web frontend (board UI), documentation (README, self-hosting guide, vision), and runtime adapters for integrating 20 agent CLIs.
en.stack: Built primarily with Go for the backend, with a web frontend, and integrations for multiple agent CLIs; supports self-hosting.
en.hot: With 44.5k stars and +274 today, ranking #2 on Go trending, it solves the pain of context loss and repeated explanations when managing multiple agents, integrating them into team workflows.
uses: Dev teams: manage multiple coding agents in one place, reducing context switching and repeated explanations
Tech leads: assign agents as team members, track progress and review via board
Self-hosters: need data privacy and full control over agent runtimes

zh.tag: 基于 Matrix 房间的协作式多智能体操作系统
zh.what: AgentTeams 是一个开源协作式多智能体运行时平台，支持多个智能体在可控、可审计的房间中协作，全程提供人工可见性和干预能力。它采用 Manager-Workers 架构，由 Manager 集中编排多个 Worker，专注于企业环境中人机协作和智能体间协作场景。

研究多智能体系统、人机协作交互的研究人员和学生。
需要可审计、可控的智能体协作平台的团队，如 DevOps 或运维部门。

en.tag: Collaborative multi-agent OS for transparent, human-in-the-loop task coordination via Matrix rooms
en.what: AgentTeams is an open-source collaborative multi-agent runtime platform that enables multiple agents to collaborate in a controlled and auditable room, with full human visibility and intervention capabilities throughout the process. en.hot: Gained 324 stars this month, reaching 5,460 total, and ranked #20 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its unique Manager-Workers architecture and emphasis on human oversight in multi-agent collaboration attract developers interested in enterprise-grade agent orchestration.

Developers who want to leverage the strengths of different agent runtimes (e.g., code execution, task planning).
Researchers and students studying multi-agent systems and human-agent interaction.
Teams needing an auditable and controlled agent collaboration platform, such as DevOps or operations departments.

zh.tag: 开源统一XDR与SIEM安全平台，保护端点与云负载

合规审计人员：利用文件完整性监控和日志分析满足PCI DSS等合规要求。
云原生环境：保护容器和云工作负载，集成威胁情报识别风险。
开源爱好者：学习大型C++安全项目架构和实现。

en.tag: Open-source unified XDR and SIEM platform for endpoint and cloud workload protection
en.what: Wazuh is a free and open-source security platform for threat prevention, detection, and response. It consists of an endpoint security agent deployed on monitored systems and a management server that collects and analyzes agent data, fully integrated with the Elastic Stack for search and visualization.
en.content: The repository contains core components of Wazuh, including agents, manager, rulesets, documentation, and installation scripts. It supports intrusion detection, log analysis, file integrity monitoring, and vulnerability detection.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) for data storage and visualization, and supports cross-platform deployment (Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.).
en.hot: With 431 stars added this month and a total of 16,485, it ranks 25th on the C++ trending list. As a leading open-source security platform, its unified XDR and SIEM capabilities attract significant attention.

Compliance auditors: leveraging file integrity monitoring and log analysis to meet regulatory requirements like PCI DSS.
Cloud-native environments: protecting containers and cloud workloads with integrated threat intelligence.
Open-source enthusiasts: learning the architecture and implementation of a large-scale C++ security project.

en.tag: Open-source runtime powering Cloudflare Workers for self-hosting and local dev
en.what: workerd is the JavaScript/Wasm server runtime that powers Cloudflare Workers, built on V8. It lets you self-host Workers applications, develop and test locally, or use it as a programmable HTTP proxy.

Local development and testing: simulate Workers environment locally before deployment
Programmable HTTP proxy: intercept, modify, and route network requests
Learn Workers runtime internals: study its design principles and implementation

zh.tag: 实时分析型列式数据库管理系统

嵌入式开发者：用配置文件代替传统固件开发，提高效率
Home Assistant 用户：无缝集成，实现自动化控制

en.what: ESPHome is a system to control microcontrollers like ESP32, ESP8266, BK72xx, RP2040 via simple yet powerful configuration files, and control them remotely through home automation systems. Home Assistant users: seamless integration for automation

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库

zh.stack: 基于 C++11/14/17 标准库实现，无需外部依赖，仅依赖 STL 容器和模板元编程，支持通过 CMake 构建测试与示例。
zh.hot: 凭借超 5 万 Star 和今日新增 17 Star 登上 C++ 日榜第 10，它已成为 C++ 生态的事实标准 JSON 库。其“像 STL 一样直观”的 API 设计和单头文件即用的便捷性持续吸引开发者。
uses: C++ 后端/客户端开发者需要轻量、高性能 JSON 解析与序列化
嵌入式与游戏项目团队希望以单头文件引入依赖，简化构建流程
基础设施开发者在微服务、配置系统或协议网关中进行结构化数据交换

en.tag: Modern C++ JSON parsing and serialization library
en.what: A widely-adopted, header-only JSON library for C++ offering an intuitive, STL-like API to parse, generate, and manipulate JSON. It enables seamless mapping between JSON and C++ data structures, dramatically simplifying JSON handling in modern C++ projects.
en.content: The repository centers around a single-header distribution (json.hpp), complemented by comprehensive tests, benchmarks, documentation site sources, and package manager integrations like Conan and vcpkg.
en.stack: Built on C++11/14/17 with zero external dependencies, relying solely on STL containers and template metaprogramming; tests and examples are built via CMake.
en.hot: With over 50k stars and 17 new stars today, ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list, it has become the de facto standard JSON library in the C++ ecosystem. Its STL-intuitive API design and single-header convenience continue to attract developers.
uses: C++ backend and client developers needing lightweight, high-performance JSON parsing and serialization
Embedded and game teams looking to simplify builds with a single-header dependency
Infrastructure developers performing structured data exchange in microservices, config systems, or protocol gateways

zh.tag: ARM64 Linux 上运行 x86 应用的高性能模拟器
zh.what: FEX 是一个快速的用户态模拟器，允许在 ARM64 Linux 设备上运行 x86 和 x86-64 应用程序。它兼容 32 位和 64 位二进制，可与 Wine/Proton 结合运行 Windows 游戏，并支持将 API 调用转发到宿主系统库以减少模拟开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心源码、FEXConfig 图形配置工具、FEXRootFSFetcher 根文件系统下载工具，以及详细的文档和 Wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ARMv8.0+ 硬件，支持多种 Linux 发行版，并利用 OpenGL/Vulkan 等宿主库进行 API 转发。
zh.hot: 随着 ARM 设备（如树莓派、ARM 服务器）的普及，用户对在 ARM 上运行 x86 应用的需求增加。FEX 提供了高性能解决方案，本月新增 172 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 23 名。
uses: ARM64 Linux 用户希望在 ARM 设备上运行 x86 专属软件或游戏
开发者测试 x86 应用在 ARM 环境下的兼容性
游戏玩家通过 Wine/Proton 在 ARM 设备上玩 Windows 游戏

en.tag: High-performance x86/x86-64 emulator for ARM64 Linux
en.what: FEX is a fast usermode emulator that allows running x86 and x86-64 applications on ARM64 Linux devices. It supports both 32-bit and 64-bit binaries, can be used with Wine/Proton to play Windows games, and forwards API calls to host libraries to reduce overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the emulator core source, FEXConfig GUI tool, FEXRootFSFetcher for downloading RootFS, and extensive documentation with wiki links.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, requires ARMv8.0+ hardware, supports multiple Linux distributions, and leverages host libraries like OpenGL/Vulkan for API forwarding.
en.hot: With the rise of ARM devices (e.g., Raspberry Pi, ARM servers), there's growing demand to run x86 apps on ARM. FEX offers a high-performance solution, gaining 172 stars this month and ranking #23 on the C++ trending list.
uses: ARM64 Linux users wanting to run x86-only software or games on ARM devices
Developers testing x86 app compatibility on ARM environments
Gamers playing Windows games on ARM devices via Wine/Proton

zh.tag: 统一跨平台AI客户端，无缝切换云端与本地离线模型
zh.what: PrivateLM 是一个生产就绪的跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，支持在 Android 设备上本地运行 GGUF 模型（GPU 加速，离线可用），并可无缝切换到 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等云端 API。它提供多模态聊天、持久会话、自动配置和任务管理功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Flutter 应用源码，涵盖 UI 层（聊天、任务、模型、设置视图）、GetX 控制器、服务层（本地推理、云端调用、模型下载）以及 Firebase 集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Flutter 3.x（Dart >=3.3.0），使用 GetX 状态管理、Hive 本地存储、Dio 网络库，以及 flutter_background_service 和 Firebase Messaging 实现后台任务与推送。
zh.hot: 本月新增 366 星，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 月榜第 15 名。它解决了 AI 聊天中隐私与云端能力的两难，提供真正的本地离线推理，同时支持主流云 API，吸引了注重隐私和灵活性的开发者。
uses: 隐私敏感用户：希望在不联网的情况下使用 AI 聊天，确保数据不出设备。
开发者：需要跨平台 AI 客户端参考实现，或想集成本地 GGUF 推理与云 API 切换。
移动端用户：在 Android 手机上体验 GPU 加速的本地模型，如 Qwen2-VL 多模态。

en.tag: Unified cross-platform AI client with seamless cloud-to-on-device model switching
en.what: PrivateLM is a production-ready cross-platform AI chat client that runs GGUF models locally on Android (GPU-accelerated, offline) and seamlessly switches to cloud APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Kimi. It offers multimodal chat, persistent sessions, auto-configuration, and task management.
en.content: The repository contains the full Flutter app source code, including UI layer (chat, task, model, settings views), GetX controllers, service layer (local inference, cloud calls, model download), and Firebase integration.
en.stack: Built with Flutter 3.x (Dart >=3.3.0), using GetX for state management, Hive for local storage, Dio for networking, and flutter_background_service plus Firebase Messaging for background tasks and push notifications.
en.hot: Gained 366 stars this month, ranking #15 on GitHub Trending C++ monthly. It addresses the privacy-vs-cloud dilemma in AI chat by offering true on-device offline inference while supporting major cloud APIs, appealing to privacy-conscious and flexible developers.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want AI chat without internet, ensuring data stays on-device.
Developers seeking a cross-platform AI client reference implementation with local GGUF inference and cloud API switching.
Mobile users who want to experience GPU-accelerated local models like Qwen2-VL on Android.

zh.tag: 基于机器学习的视频超分辨率与补帧工具
zh.what: Video2X 是一个利用机器学习模型对视频进行超分辨率放大和帧插值的框架。它通过调用 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN 等算法提升视频画质，并支持补帧使播放更流畅。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C/C++ 重写代码，提供 Windows 和 Linux 的跨平台支持，带有 GUI 和安装程序，以及命令行工具。支持多种超分辨率和补帧模型，如 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN、Real-CUGAN 和 RIFE。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C/C++ 编写，依赖 ncnn 和 Vulkan 进行 GPU 加速，支持自定义 GLSL 着色器。需要支持 AVX2 的 CPU 和支持 Vulkan 的 GPU。
zh.hot: 6.0 版本完全重写，性能大幅提升，跨平台支持更好，输出质量显著改善，吸引了大量用户。目前 star 数已超过 2 万，今日新增 31，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。
uses: 动漫爱好者：提升动漫视频分辨率和流畅度
视频创作者：修复老旧视频或低清素材
技术爱好者：探索机器学习在视频处理中的应用

en.tag: ML-based video upscaling and frame interpolation framework
en.what: Video2X is a framework that uses machine learning models to upscale videos and interpolate frames. It enhances video quality with algorithms like Anime4K and Real-ESRGAN, and supports frame interpolation for smoother playback.
en.content: The repository contains a complete C/C++ rewrite with cross-platform support for Windows and Linux, including a GUI, installer, and command-line tools. It supports various upscaling and interpolation models like Anime4K, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, and RIFE.
en.stack: Written primarily in C/C++, it leverages ncnn and Vulkan for GPU acceleration, and supports custom GLSL shaders. Requires AVX2-capable CPU and Vulkan-capable GPU.
en.hot: The 6.0 rewrite brought significant performance improvements, better cross-platform support, and enhanced output quality, attracting many users. With over 20k stars and 31 new stars today, it ranks #3 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Anime fans: upscale and smooth anime videos
Video creators: restore old or low-res footage
Tech enthusiasts: explore ML in video processing

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎，社区驱动
zh.what: Godot 是一个功能全面的跨平台游戏引擎，提供统一的界面来创建 2D 和 3D 游戏。它内置了丰富的常用工具，用户无需重复造轮子，可以专注于游戏开发。游戏可一键导出到多个平台，包括桌面、移动、网页和主机。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎的完整源代码、编辑器、文档和示例项目。主要目录包括核心引擎代码（C++）、场景系统、渲染器、脚本语言（GDScript）、编辑器界面以及导出模板。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种脚本语言（如 GDScript、C#、VisualScript）。依赖包括 OpenGL/Vulkan 渲染、音频库等，并支持跨平台构建。
zh.hot: Godot 因其完全免费、开源且无版税的特点而广受欢迎，社区活跃，持续更新。本月新增 1876 星，总星数达 116k，在 C++ 趋势榜中排名第 17，显示出其强大的吸引力和用户基础。
uses: 独立游戏开发者：利用 Godot 的免费开源特性，低成本开发并发布跨平台游戏。
教育场景：作为教学工具，学习游戏开发、编程和引擎架构。
游戏工作室：用于原型设计和快速迭代，支持从 2D 到 3D 的多样化项目。
开源贡献者：参与引擎开发，通过社区协作改进功能和修复问题。

en.tag: Free & open-source cross-platform 2D/3D game engine, community-driven
en.what: Godot is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, allowing users to focus on making games without reinventing the wheel. Games can be exported with one click to multiple platforms, including desktop, mobile, web, and consoles.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source code, editor, documentation, and demos. Key directories include core engine code (C++), scene system, renderers, scripting language (GDScript), editor UI, and export templates.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with support for multiple scripting languages (e.g., GDScript, C#, VisualScript). Dependencies include OpenGL/Vulkan rendering, audio libraries, and cross-platform build support.
en.hot: Godot is popular for being completely free, open-source, and royalty-free, with an active community and continuous updates. With 1,876 new stars this month and 116k total, ranking #17 on the C++ trending list, it demonstrates strong appeal and a solid user base.
uses: Indie game developers: Leverage Godot's free and open-source nature to develop and publish cross-platform games at low cost.
Educational settings: Use as a teaching tool to learn game development, programming, and engine architecture.
Game studios: For prototyping and rapid iteration, supporting diverse projects from 2D to 3D.
Open-source contributors: Participate in engine development, improving features and fixing issues through community collaboration.

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: 真正独立的现代网页浏览器，基于全新引擎
zh.what: Ladybird 是一个真正独立的网页浏览器，采用基于 Web 标准的新颖引擎，旨在构建完整、可用的现代浏览器。它目前处于预 alpha 阶段，仅适合开发者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器的主要源代码，采用多进程架构，包括 UI 主进程、多个 WebContent 渲染进程、ImageDecoder 进程和 RequestServer 进程。核心库组件继承自 SerenityOS，如 LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SerenityOS 的多个库（LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等），支持 Linux、macOS、Windows（WSL2）等平台。
zh.hot: 作为真正独立的浏览器项目，Ladybird 在开发者中引起广泛关注，star 数已达 64,842，今日新增 42，位列 C++ 日榜第一。
uses: 对浏览器引擎感兴趣的开发者，可以学习其架构和实现。
希望参与开源浏览器项目贡献的开发者。
关注 Web 标准和技术前沿的技术爱好者。

en.tag: A truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine
en.what: Ladybird is a truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine, aiming to build a complete, usable browser for the modern web. It is currently in pre-alpha state and only suitable for developers.
en.content: The repository contains the main source code of the browser, using a multi-process architecture with a main UI process, several WebContent renderer processes, an ImageDecoder process, and a RequestServer process. Core library components are inherited from SerenityOS, such as LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on several SerenityOS libraries (LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.), supporting Linux, macOS, Windows (with WSL2), and other *NIXes.
en.hot: As a truly independent browser project, Ladybird has gained significant attention among developers, with 64,842 stars and 42 new stars today, ranking first on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers interested in browser engines, to learn its architecture and implementation.
Developers who want to contribute to an open-source browser project.
Tech enthusiasts following web standards and cutting-edge technology.

zh.tag: 开源离网 LoRa 网格通信设备固件
zh.what: Meshtastic 是一个开源项目，旨在通过 LoRa 技术实现无需互联网或蜂窝网络的远距离、低功耗通信。该固件支持多种硬件平台，提供短信、位置共享和遥测功能，适用于户外探险、应急准备和远程作业。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源代码、构建说明、刷机指南以及社区贡献的文档。支持 ESP32、nRF52、RP2040/RP2350 和 Linux 设备。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 PlatformIO 和 Arduino 框架，依赖 LoRa 库和多种硬件抽象层。
zh.hot: 本月新增 217 星，总星数达 8141，位列 GitHub 趋势榜 C++ 第 20 名。其去中心化、离网通信的特性在自然灾害或网络中断时极具价值，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 户外爱好者：在无信号区域进行团队通信和位置共享
应急响应人员：在灾害导致网络中断时保持联络
技术爱好者：学习 LoRa 和网状网络开发，参与开源贡献

en.tag: Open-source firmware for off-grid LoRa mesh communication devices
en.what: Meshtastic is an open-source project enabling long-range, low-power communication without internet or cellular via LoRa. This firmware supports multiple hardware platforms, offering text messaging, location sharing, and telemetry over a decentralized mesh network, ideal for outdoor adventures, emergency preparedness, and remote operations.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, build instructions, flashing guides, and community-contributed documentation. It supports ESP32, nRF52, RP2040/RP2350, and Linux devices.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, built on PlatformIO and Arduino frameworks, with dependencies on LoRa libraries and various hardware abstraction layers.
en.hot: Gained 217 stars this month, reaching 8,141 total, ranking #20 on GitHub Trending for C++. Its decentralized, off-grid communication capability is highly valuable during disasters or network outages, attracting significant attention.
uses: Outdoor enthusiasts: team communication and location sharing in no-signal areas
Emergency responders: staying connected when networks fail during disasters
Tech hobbyists: learning LoRa and mesh networking development, contributing to open source

zh.tag: 跨平台 Android 实时投屏与远控工具
zh.what: QtScrcpy 是一款基于 Qt 的 Android 设备投屏与控制软件，支持通过 USB 或网络连接，无需 root 权限。它能在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上以低延迟、高帧率显示设备屏幕，并支持键盘鼠标映射，方便游戏操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Qt 工程源码、跨平台构建脚本（Windows/macOS/Ubuntu）、详细的文档（含中文 README）、按键映射脚本示例（如 PUBG Mobile）以及截图资源。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 adb 与 Android 的 screen 捕获/注入协议，支持 GPU 渲染以提升性能。
zh.hot: 31.6k 星标，本月新增 1001，因其免费、开源、跨平台且无需 root 的投屏方案，在开发者与游戏玩家中广受欢迎。
uses: 开发者调试 Android 应用，实时查看屏幕和模拟操作
游戏玩家通过键盘鼠标映射在电脑上玩手机游戏
需要批量管理多台 Android 设备的测试或运维人员

en.tag: Cross-platform Android real-time display and control tool
en.what: QtScrcpy is a Qt-based Android screen mirroring and control software that works over USB or network without root. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, offering low-latency, high-quality display, and supports keyboard/mouse mapping for gaming.
en.content: The repo includes full Qt project source, cross-platform build scripts (Windows/macOS/Ubuntu), detailed docs (including Chinese README), key mapping script examples (e.g., PUBG Mobile), and screenshots.
en.stack: Built with C++ and Qt, leveraging adb and Android's screen capture/input injection, with GPU rendering for performance.
en.hot: With 31.6k stars and +1001 this month, it's popular among developers and gamers for being free, open-source, cross-platform, and root-free.
uses: Developers debugging Android apps with real-time screen view and simulated input
Gamers playing mobile games on PC via keyboard/mouse mapping
Testers or admins managing multiple Android devices in batches

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整 C++ 源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持 Python、R、Java 等客户端，并与 pandas、dplyr 等库深度集成。
zh.hot: DuckDB 因其嵌入式、零配置的分析查询能力而广受欢迎，今日新增 58 星，总星数超 4 万，在 C++ 趋势榜排名第一。
uses: 数据科学家：在 Python 中快速分析大型数据集，无需复杂数据库设置。
数据分析师：直接查询 CSV/Parquet 文件，简化数据导入流程。
应用开发者：将 DuckDB 嵌入应用，提供高性能本地分析功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database for fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect with complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Written in C++17, built with CMake, supports Python, R, Java clients, and integrates deeply with pandas and dplyr.
en.hot: DuckDB is popular for its embedded, zero-configuration analytical querying; it gained 58 stars today, with over 40k total, ranking #1 on C++ trending.
uses: Data scientists: quickly analyze large datasets in Python without complex database setup.
Data analysts: directly query CSV/Parquet files, simplifying data import.
Application developers: embed DuckDB for high-performance local analytics.

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing
